        if (!isAdded()) return;
        Context ctx = requireContext();
        android.app.Dialog d = new android.app.Dialog(ctx, R.style.TakeOneCenterDialog);
        d.requestWindowFeature(android.view.Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE);

        float density = getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density;
        int pad = Math.round(18 * density);
        android.widget.LinearLayout root = new android.widget.LinearLayout(ctx);
        root.setOrientation(android.widget.LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        root.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_modal);
        root.setPadding(pad, pad, pad, pad);

        TextView title = new TextView(ctx);
        title.setText("Add Effect");
        title.setTextSize(17f);
        title.setTextColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
        title.setGravity(android.view.Gravity.CENTER);
        title.setTypeface(android.graphics.Typeface.create(
                "sans-serif-medium", android.graphics.Typeface.NORMAL));
        root.addView(title);

        android.widget.EditText searchBox = new android.widget.EditText(ctx);
        searchBox.setHint("Search effects (e.g. noise, de-ess, warm)...");
        searchBox.setHintTextColor(0xFF5D6672);
        searchBox.setTextColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
        searchBox.setTextSize(13.5f);
        searchBox.setSingleLine(true);
        searchBox.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_search);
        int sPad = Math.round(10 * density);
        searchBox.setPadding(sPad, sPad, sPad, sPad);
        android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams sLp =
                new android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                        ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                        ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        sLp.topMargin = Math.round(10 * density);
        root.addView(searchBox, sLp);

        android.widget.ScrollView listScroll = new android.widget.ScrollView(ctx);
        android.widget.LinearLayout listCol = new android.widget.LinearLayout(ctx);
        listCol.setOrientation(android.widget.LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        listScroll.addView(listCol);
        android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams scLp =
                new android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                        ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                        Math.round(240 * density));
        scLp.topMargin = Math.round(10 * density);
        root.addView(listScroll, scLp);

        // Category filter chips: the catalog now spans eight families, so a
        // search box alone is not enough to find an effect quickly.
        final FxCategory[] categories = {
                null, FxCategory.EQUALIZER, FxCategory.DYNAMICS,
                FxCategory.RESTORATION, FxCategory.SPATIAL, FxCategory.TIME,
                FxCategory.CREATIVE, FxCategory.TOOLS, FxCategory.ANALYZER};
        final String[] categoryLabels = {
                "All", "EQ & Filters", "Dynamics", "Restoration",
                "Spatial", "Pitch & Time", "Creative", "Tools", "Analyzers"};
        final FxCategory[] selected = {null};
        final android.widget.HorizontalScrollView chipScroll =
                new android.widget.HorizontalScrollView(ctx);
        chipScroll.setHorizontalScrollBarEnabled(false);
        android.widget.LinearLayout chipRow =
                new android.widget.LinearLayout(ctx);
        chipRow.setOrientation(android.widget.LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        chipScroll.addView(chipRow);
        android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams chipLp =
                new android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                        ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                        ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        chipLp.topMargin = Math.round(8 * density);
        root.addView(chipScroll, chipLp);
        final android.widget.TextView[] chipViews =
                new android.widget.TextView[categories.length];

        Runnable populateList = () -> {
            String q = searchBox.getText().toString().trim().toLowerCase(Locale.US);
            FxCategory filter = selected[0];
            listCol.removeAllViews();
            // The catalog is listed alphabetically so a long effect list stays
            // navigable.
            java.util.List<DspChain.EffectType> catalog =
                    new java.util.ArrayList<>(java.util.Arrays.asList(
                            DspChain.EffectType.values()));
            java.util.Collections.sort(catalog,
                    new java.util.Comparator<DspChain.EffectType>() {
                        @Override
                        public int compare(DspChain.EffectType a,
                                           DspChain.EffectType b) {
                            return a.title.compareToIgnoreCase(b.title);
                        }
                    });
            for (DspChain.EffectType t : catalog) {
                if (filter != null
                        && DspChain.categoryOf(t) != filter) {
                    continue;
                }
                if (!q.isEmpty()
                        && !t.title.toLowerCase(Locale.US).contains(q)
                        && !t.description.toLowerCase(Locale.US).contains(q)) {
                    continue;
                }
                android.widget.LinearLayout row = new android.widget.LinearLayout(ctx);
                row.setOrientation(android.widget.LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
                row.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_pill_option);
                row.setPadding(sPad, sPad, sPad, sPad);
                android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams rLp =
                        new android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
                rLp.topMargin = Math.round(6 * density);

                TextView rTitle = new TextView(ctx);
                rTitle.setText(t.title);
                rTitle.setTextSize(13.5f);
                rTitle.setTextColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
                rTitle.setTypeface(android.graphics.Typeface.create(
                        "sans-serif-medium", android.graphics.Typeface.NORMAL));

                TextView rSub = new TextView(ctx);
                rSub.setText(t.description);
                rSub.setTextSize(11f);
                rSub.setTextColor(0xFF9AA3AF);

                row.addView(rTitle);
                row.addView(rSub);
                PressAnim.applySoft(row, 0.97f);
                row.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                    if (!isAdded() || dspConfig == null) return;
                    if (dspSubRangeBaked) lastEditWasSubRangeBake = true;
                    dspBakedToRaw = false;
                    dspSubRangeBaked = false;
                    dspConfig.addOrFocusSlot(t);
                    dspConfig.save(ctx);
                    if (livePreviewDsp != null) {
                        livePreviewDsp.updateConfig(dspConfig);
                    }
                    refreshFxPreviewPeaks();
                    rebuildFxRackList();
                    paintFxPanelControls();
                    paintEditorStrip();
                    d.dismiss();
                });
                listCol.addView(row, rLp);
            }
        };

        for (int i = 0; i < categories.length; i++) {
            final int index = i;
            TextView chip = makeFxChip(ctx, categoryLabels[i], density);
            chipViews[i] = chip;
            android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams clp =
                    new android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                            ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT,
                            ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
            clp.rightMargin = Math.round(5 * density);
            chipRow.addView(chip, clp);
            chip.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                selected[0] = categories[index];
                for (int k = 0; k < chipViews.length; k++) {
                    boolean on = k == index;
                    chipViews[k].setTextColor(on ? 0xFFFFFFFF : 0xFF9AA3AF);
                    chipViews[k].setBackgroundResource(on
                            ? R.drawable.bg_pill_option_selected
                            : R.drawable.bg_pill_option);
                }
                populateList.run();
            });
        }
        // "All" starts selected.
        chipViews[0].setTextColor(0xFFFFFFFF);
        chipViews[0].setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_pill_option_selected);
        populateList.run();

        searchBox.addTextChangedListener(new android.text.TextWatcher() {
            @Override public void beforeTextChanged(CharSequence s, int st, int c, int a) {}
            @Override public void onTextChanged(CharSequence s, int st, int b, int c) {
                populateList.run();
            }
            @Override public void afterTextChanged(android.text.Editable s) {}
        });

        TextView cancelBtn = new TextView(ctx);
        cancelBtn.setText(R.string.cancel);
        cancelBtn.setGravity(android.view.Gravity.CENTER);
        cancelBtn.setTextColor(0xFF9AA3AF);
        cancelBtn.setTextSize(13.5f);
        cancelBtn.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_btn_ghost);
        cancelBtn.setPadding(sPad, sPad, sPad, sPad);
        cancelBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> d.dismiss());
        root.addView(cancelBtn, sLp);

        d.setContentView(root);
        OptionsSheet.styleAsCentered(d);
        d.show();
    }


    /**
     * Applies enabled effects from the FX rack to the selected audio region
     * when a selection is active, or to the entire take when no region is
     * selected. Works identically on both the normal recording and the
     * Select & Replace sub-editor recording.
     */
    private boolean commitDspFx() {
        if (!ensurePausedForEditing()) return false;
        if (replaceModeArmed) {
            Toast.makeText(requireContext(),
                    "Disable Replace mode before applying effects",
                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            return false;
        }
        stopStudioPreview();
        if (dspConfig == null) return false;
        dspConfig.syncLegacyFieldsFromSlots();
        if (!dspConfig.isActive()) {
            Toast.makeText(requireContext(),
                    "Enable at least one effect (checkmark) first",
                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            return false;
        }
        // Apply works on the selection when there is one and on the WHOLE TAKE
        // otherwise — the old forced "enable selection first" return aborted
        // silently and made the full-take branch below unreachable.
        if (waveform == null) return false;
        // In effects mode the target is the region that was selected before
        // the rack opened, so re-selecting a range (to learn a noise profile,
        // say) cannot silently change what Stop commits to.
        boolean hadSel = fxPanelOpen
                ? fxApplyTargetHasSelection
                : waveform.hasSelection();
        File raw = engine.rawFile;
        if (raw == null || !raw.exists()) return false;
        if (!hadSel && dspBakedToRaw && !dspSubRangeBaked) {
            Toast.makeText(requireContext(),
                    "Effects already applied to entire take (tap Undo or adjust a parameter first)",
                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            return false;
        }
        boolean peaksPushed = false;
        try {
            // Config.isActive() can disagree with the processor chain (e.g. a
            // Stage 3 slot whose parameters are neutral); probe the real chain
            // BEFORE any undo bookkeeping so an inaudible rack never pushes a
            // waveform peak snapshot without a matching audio snapshot.
            try {
                FormatConverter.WavInfo preInfo =
                        FormatConverter.readFloatWav(raw);
                DspChain probeChain = new DspChain(preInfo.channels, dspConfig);
                if (!probeChain.isActive()) {
                    Toast.makeText(requireContext(),
                            "Adjust an effect parameter away from 0 dB first",
                            Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                    return false;
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                return false;
            }
            EditEngine.UndoJournal uj = activeUndoJournal();
            // If a sub-selection was just baked with this exact rack — even if
            // a knob tweak has since cleared dspSubRangeBaked — restore the
            // pre-sub-bake snapshot first so the selected region is not baked
            // twice!
            if (!hadSel && (dspSubRangeBaked || lastEditWasSubRangeBake)
                    && uj != null && uj.canUndo()) {
                if (uj.undo(raw)) {
                    waveform.popUndoPeaks();
                    engine.dataBytes = RecordingEngine.payloadBytesOf(raw);
                    dspBakedToRaw = false;
                    dspSubRangeBaked = false;
                    lastEditWasSubRangeBake = false;
                }
            }
            FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(raw);
            long totalFrames = info.dataBytes / 4 / Math.max(1, info.channels);
            if (totalFrames <= 0) return false;
            long start = 0L;
            long end = totalFrames;
            if (hadSel) {
                float startFrac = fxPanelOpen
                        ? fxApplyTargetStart
                        : waveform.selectionStartFraction();
                float endFrac = fxPanelOpen
                        ? fxApplyTargetEnd
                        : waveform.selectionEndFraction();
                start = Math.round(startFrac * totalFrames);
                end = Math.round(endFrac * totalFrames);
                if (end <= start) {
                    Toast.makeText(requireContext(),
                            "Select a valid audio region first",
                            Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                    return false;
                }
            }
            // The file is about to change: stop the live region render and
            // drop its dry baseline so the reloaded bars become the new truth.
            fxPreviewGeneration++;
            handler.removeCallbacks(fxPreviewRefresh);
            waveform.clearFxRegionPeaks();
            waveform.recordUndoPeaks();
            peaksPushed = true;
            DspChain chain = new DspChain(info.channels, dspConfig);
            // Duration-changing tools (Change Tempo, Change Speed, Repeat,
            // Truncate Silence, ...) render the region offline and rewrite the
            // file, so they take a different path than the in-place chain.
            // They run first; the in-place chain then processes whatever
            // region came out of them.
            java.util.List&lt;AudioProcessor&gt; offline =
                    chain.offlineProcessors();
            if (!offline.isEmpty()) {
                long regionEnd = end;
                boolean firstOffline = true;
                for (AudioProcessor proc : offline) {
                    FormatConverter.WavInfo curInfo = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(raw);
                    long curTotalBefore = curInfo.dataBytes / 4 / Math.max(1, curInfo.channels);
                    long newTotal = EditEngine.applyLengthChangingEffectToRange(
                            raw, start, regionEnd, proc, firstOffline ? uj : null);
                    if (newTotal < 0) {
                        if (firstOffline) {
                            waveform.discardTopUndoPeaks();
                        } else if (uj != null && uj.canUndo()) {
                            uj.undo(raw);
                            waveform.discardTopUndoPeaks();
                        }
                        peaksPushed = false;
                        Toast.makeText(requireContext(),
                                "This effect could not be applied here",
                                Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                        return false;
                    }
                    firstOffline = false;
                    regionEnd = start + (newTotal - (curTotalBefore - regionEnd));
                }
                // The offline pass rewrote the region: run the remaining
                // in-place processors over the new boundaries.
                if (chain.hasInPlaceProcessors()) {
                    DspChain inPlace = new DspChain(info.channels, dspConfig);
                    inPlace.clearOfflineProcessors();
                    EditEngine.applyDspToRange(raw, start, regionEnd, inPlace, null);
                }
                engine.abortStreaming();
                engine.dataBytes = RecordingEngine.payloadBytesOf(raw);
                long newTotalFrames = engine.totalFrames();
                long nextCursor = Math.min(newTotalFrames, Math.max(0L, regionEnd));
                engine.seekCursorFrame(nextCursor);
                dspBakedToRaw = true;
                dspSubRangeBaked = hadSel;
                lastEditWasSubRangeBake = false;
                waveform.reloadFullFromWavSync(raw);
                waveform.syncFramesPerBar(newTotalFrames);
                if (newTotalFrames > 0) {
                    waveform.setPlayheadFraction(
                            nextCursor / (float) newTotalFrames);
                }
                refreshZoomValue();
                if (timerText != null) {
                    timerText.setText(formatTimer(engine.cursorMs()));
                }
                resetFxRackAfterApply();
                waveform.clearSelection();
                syncFxBakeRequired();
                OptionsSheet.showTopPopup(requireContext(), "Effects applied");
                paint();
                paintFxPanelControls();
                return true;
            }
            boolean snapshotRecorded =
                    EditEngine.applyDspToRange(raw, start, end, chain, uj);
            if (!snapshotRecorded) {
                waveform.discardTopUndoPeaks();
                peaksPushed = false;
            }
            lastEditWasSubRangeBake = false;
            // The raw now carries the chain for the applied range: the
            // incremental pump must not keep encoding unprocessed audio, and
            // neither preview nor save may process these samples a second time.
            engine.abortStreaming();
            engine.dataBytes = RecordingEngine.payloadBytesOf(raw);
            if (!hadSel) {
                // Whole take baked: mark it so preview (livePreviewDsp) and
                // save never process these samples a second time.
                dspBakedToRaw = true;
                dspSubRangeBaked = false;
                waveform.reloadSelectionPeaksFromWav(raw, 0f, 1f);
            } else {
                waveform.reloadSelectionPeaksFromWav(raw,
                        fxPanelOpen ? fxApplyTargetStart
                                : waveform.selectionStartFraction(),
                        fxPanelOpen ? fxApplyTargetEnd
                                : waveform.selectionEndFraction());
                // Only the selected region was baked. The raw file now carries
                // that bake, so preview/save must not process it again even
                // though the rest of the take remains dry.
                dspBakedToRaw = true;
                dspSubRangeBaked = true;
            }
            // Apply is the single commit point: the raw file and waveform now
            // carry the processed audio, so start a fresh, blank rack. Keeping
            // the old slots enabled would leave the UI implying the effects
            // are still pending and invite a second bake.
            resetFxRackAfterApply();
            syncFxBakeRequired();
            waveform.clearSelection();
            OptionsSheet.showTopPopup(requireContext(), "Effects applied");
        } catch (Exception e) {
            if (peaksPushed && waveform != null) waveform.discardTopUndoPeaks();
            Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "FX failed",
                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            return false;
        }
        paint();
        paintFxPanelControls();
        return true;
    }

    /** Preserves the user's FX rack after a bake while marking the audio committed. */
    private void resetFxRackAfterApply() {
        if (dspConfig == null) return;
        try {
            dspConfig.save(requireContext());
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        if (livePreviewDsp != null) {
            livePreviewDsp.updateConfig(dspConfig);
        }
        refreshFxPreviewPeaks();
        rebuildFxRackList();
    }

    private void paint() {
        if (getView() == null || !isAdded()) return;
        syncFxBakeRequired();
        // A capture paused outside the studio (call, notification, mic
        // disconnect) must park the prompter too — and a resume must
        // release it — even though no studio button was involved.
        if (lastPaintedState == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING
                && engine.state != RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING) {
            setTelePaused(true);
        } else if (lastPaintedState == RecordingEngine.State.PAUSED
                && engine.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING) {
            setTelePaused(false);
        }
        lastPaintedState = engine.state;
        lastPaintedName = String.valueOf(displayName());
        boolean hasSession = engine.hasSession();
        boolean rec = engine.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING;
        boolean paused = engine.state == RecordingEngine.State.PAUSED;

        String name = displayName();
        if (name != null) {
            statusText.setText(name);
            takeNameView.setText(name);
        } else {
            statusText.setText(R.string.studio_ready);
            takeNameView.setText(nextTakeName());
        }

        stateLabel.setText(!hasSession ? getString(R.string.studio_ready)
                : rec ? getString(R.string.studio_recording)
                : paused ? getString(R.string.studio_paused)
                : getString(R.string.studio_ready));
        statusText.setAlpha(name != null ? 1f : 0.7f);

        if (!hasSession) {
            hintText.setText(name != null
                    ? getString(R.string.studio_tap_to_start)
                    : getString(R.string.studio_hint));
        } else if (rec) {
            hintText.setText(R.string.studio_recording_hint);
        } else if (paused) {
            hintText.setText(R.string.studio_paused_hint);
        } else {
            hintText.setText(editSourceId != -1
                    ? getString(R.string.studio_tap_to_start)
                    : getString(R.string.studio_recovered));
        }

        // Unfinalised indicator: the pending marker means raw 32-bit float
        // bytes are streamed but the take is not finalised yet.
        boolean unfin = hasSession && isUnfinalised();
        draftBadge.setVisibility(unfin ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);

        formatBadge.setText(preset.shortLabel + " → "
                + TakeSaver.labelFor(preset, saveFormat));
        formatBadge.setEnabled(!saving);
        formatBadge.setClickable(!saving);
        formatBadge.setAlpha(saving ? 0.35f : 1f);
        settingsName.setText(preset.titleRes);
        settingsSub.setText(preset.shortLabel + " → "
                + TakeSaver.labelFor(preset, saveFormat));
        settingsRow.setEnabled(!saving);
        settingsRow.setClickable(!saving);
        settingsRow.setAlpha(saving ? 0.45f : 1f);
        setTeleActive(telePanel.getVisibility() == View.VISIBLE);

        statusDot.setBackgroundResource(rec ? R.drawable.dot_live : R.drawable.bg_round_btn);
        if (rec) startDotPulse(); else stopDotPulse();
        statusDot.setAlpha(rec ? 1f : 0.35f);
        paintEditorStrip();

        syncStudioFabIcon();
    }

    private boolean isUnfinalised() {
        try {
            File raw = engine.rawFile;
            if (raw == null) return false;
            return new File(raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".pending").exists();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    private void startDotPulse() {
        stopDotPulse();
        statusDot.setAlpha(1f);
        dotPulse = ObjectAnimator.ofFloat(statusDot, View.ALPHA, 1f, 0.25f);
        dotPulse.setDuration(700);
        dotPulse.setRepeatCount(ObjectAnimator.INFINITE);
        dotPulse.setRepeatMode(ObjectAnimator.REVERSE);
        dotPulse.start();
    }

    private void stopDotPulse() {
        if (dotPulse != null) {
            dotPulse.cancel();
            dotPulse = null;
        }
    }

    // ---- files ----

    private String nextTakeName() {
        // A take still converting is not in the repository yet, so counting
        // rows alone handed the next recording the same "Take N" as the one
        // already encoding. Count those and never reuse a live title.
        List&lt;Take&gt; existing = TakesRepository.all();
        List&lt;ConversionJob&gt; converting = ConversionJobs.active();
        int n = existing.size() + converting.size() + 1;
        while (true) {
            String candidate = "Take " + n;
            boolean taken = false;
            for (Take t : existing) {
                if (candidate.equalsIgnoreCase(t.title)) { taken = true; break; }
            }
            if (!taken) {
                for (ConversionJob j : converting) {
                    if (candidate.equalsIgnoreCase(j.title)) { taken = true; break; }
                }
            }
            if (!taken) return candidate;
            n++;
        }
    }

    private static String prettyBase(File f) {
        return f.getName().replaceFirst("\\.[^.]+$", "").replace('_', ' ');
    }

    /** Centisecond timer (one more decimal place than before). */
    static String formatTimer(long ms) {
        return TimeFmt.formatTimer(ms);
    }

    private MainActivity activity() {
        return (MainActivity) requireActivity();
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import android.content.Context;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.LinearGradient;
import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.graphics.PorterDuff;
import android.graphics.PorterDuffXfermode;
import android.graphics.Shader;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.View;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Teleprompter surface.
 *
 * &lt;p&gt;Renders the script itself rather than an EditText so it can wrap strictly
 * to what actually fits, centre every line, and fade the copy out linearly
 * towards the top and bottom so the performer's eye is pulled to the opaque
 * centre line.
 *
 * &lt;p&gt;The script is split once into &lt;b&gt;segments&lt;/b&gt; — one segment per display
 * line. Rendering then draws only the {@link #visibleLineCount()} segments that
 * fall inside the viewport, padded with empty segments at both ends, so the
 * last line of the script still reaches the centre line and never scrolls off
 * past the end.
 */
public class TeleprompterView extends View {

    /** Line height as a fraction of the rendered text size. */
    private static final float LINE_HEIGHT_EM = 1.5f;

    private final Paint textPaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final Paint maskPaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);

    /** One entry per display line. Never null; blank lines are "". */
    private final List&lt;String&gt; segments = new ArrayList<>();

    private String script = "";
    private float textSizePx = 44f;
    private int wordsPerLine = TeleMath.MIN_WORDS_PER_LINE;
    private int textColor = 0xFFF2F4F7;
    private boolean mirror;

    private float fadePx = 0f;

    /**
     * Downward shift of the reading centre, in pixels. The control chrome
     * overlays the top of the panel, so the brightest line must sit at the
     * middle of the *visible* area — not the middle of the view.
     */
    private float centerShiftPx = 0f;

    private float scrollOffset = 0f;
    private float maxScroll = 0f;

    /** Cache key for the wrap, so scrolling never re-wraps the script. */
    private int wrapWidth = -1;
    private int wrapHeight = -1;
    private float wrapSizePx = -1f;
    private int wrapWpl = -1;

    public TeleprompterView(Context context) {
        super(context);
        init();
    }

    public TeleprompterView(Context context, AttributeSet attrs) {
        super(context, attrs);
        init();
    }

    private void init() {
        textPaint.setTextAlign(Paint.Align.CENTER);
        textPaint.setSubpixelText(true);
        textPaint.setLinearText(true);
        setWillNotDraw(false);
        // Without this the view never receives touch events for dragging.
        setClickable(true);
        setFocusable(true);
    }

    public void setTextColor(int color) {
        textColor = color;
        invalidate();
    }

    public void setMirror(boolean m) {
        mirror = m;
        invalidate();
    }

    public void setScript(String text) {
        script = text == null ? "" : text;
        // A new script always starts at the top; preserving an old fractional
        // line across unrelated content would show an arbitrary position.
        scrollOffset = 0f;
        wrapWidth = -1; // force a re-split
        rewrap();
        invalidate();
    }

    public String getScript() {
        return script;
    }

    public void setTextSizePx(float px) {
        if (px > 0f && Math.abs(px - textSizePx) > 0.5f) {
            float linePosition = linePosition();
            textSizePx = px;
            rewrap();
            restoreLinePosition(linePosition);
            invalidate();
        }
    }

    public float getTextSizePx() {
        return textSizePx;
    }

    /** Size actually being drawn. Kept while live scrubbing commits go through
     * {@link #setTextSizePx(float)} on every move. */
    public float renderedTextSizePx() {
        return textSizePx;
    }

    /**
     * Shifts the reading centre down so the focused line lands in the middle
     * of the visible area when chrome overlays the top of the panel.
     */
    public void setCenterShiftPx(float px) {
        float clamped = Math.max(0f, px);
        if (Math.abs(clamped - centerShiftPx) > 0.5f) {
            centerShiftPx = clamped;
            invalidate();
        }
    }

    public void setWordsPerLine(int wpl) {
        int w = Math.max(TeleMath.MIN_WORDS_PER_LINE, wpl);
        if (w != wordsPerLine) {
            float linePosition = linePosition();
            wordsPerLine = w;
            rewrap();
            restoreLinePosition(linePosition);
            invalidate();
        }
    }

    public int getWordsPerLine() {
        return wordsPerLine;
    }

    /**
     * Words actually shown on a wrapped line. The requested count is clamped
     * to the measured width during {@link #rewrap()}, so callers must use this
     * value—not the requested value—when converting reading speed into pixels.
     */
    public int effectiveWordsPerLine() {
        int width = getWidth();
        if (width <= 0) {
            return Math.max(TeleMath.MIN_WORDS_PER_LINE,
                    Math.min(TeleMath.MAX_WORDS_PER_LINE, wordsPerLine));
        }
        float pad = getPaddingLeft() + getPaddingRight();
        return TeleMath.wordsPerLine(Math.round(Math.max(1f, width - pad)),
                textSizePx, wordsPerLine);
    }

    public float lineHeight() {
        return renderedTextSizePx() * LINE_HEIGHT_EM;
    }

    /** Current scroll position measured in lines, independent of text size. */
    public float linePosition() {
        float lh = lineHeight();
        return lh > 0f ? scrollOffset / lh : 0f;
    }

    public void restoreLinePosition(float linePosition) {
        setScrollOffset(linePosition * lineHeight());
    }

    /** How many display lines fit in the viewport right now. */
    public int visibleLineCount() {
        int h = getHeight();
        if (h <= 0) return 0;
        return (int) Math.ceil(h / lineHeight());
    }

    /** Number of segments the script was split into. */
    public int segmentCount() {
        return segments.size();
    }

    public String segmentAt(int i) {
        return (i < 0 || i >= segments.size()) ? "" : segments.get(i);
    }

    public float contentHeight() {
        return Math.max(0, segments.size()) * lineHeight();
    }

    public float maxScroll() {
        return maxScroll;
    }

    public float scrollOffset() {
        return scrollOffset;
    }

    public void setScrollOffset(float px) {
        float clamped = Math.max(0f, Math.min(maxScroll, px));
        if (Math.abs(clamped - scrollOffset) > 0.0005f) {
            scrollOffset = clamped;
            invalidate();
        }
    }

    public void scrollBy(float dy) {
        setScrollOffset(scrollOffset + dy);
    }

    public void rewind() {
        setScrollOffset(0f);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onSizeChanged(int w, int h, int oldw, int oldh) {
        float preservedLine = (oldw > 0 && oldh > 0 && scrollOffset > 0f)
                ? linePosition() : -1f;
        super.onSizeChanged(w, h, oldw, oldh);
        fadePx = h * 0.44f;
        // Height feeds the scroll bounds, so the cached split is only reusable
        // when the height is unchanged too.
        rewrap();
        if (preservedLine > 0f) {
            restoreLinePosition(preservedLine);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Splits the script into display-line segments.
     *
     * &lt;p&gt;Widths are measured with {@link Paint#measureText} rather than
     * estimated from a character count. That matters: an estimate makes the
     * same words wrap differently between layout passes, which is what makes
     * the prompter look like it is flickering when you scroll.
     */
    private void rewrap() {
        int width = getWidth();
        if (width <= 0 || script.trim().isEmpty()) {
            if (segments.size() != 0 || !script.trim().isEmpty()) {
                segments.clear();
            }
            wrapWidth = width;
            wrapHeight = getHeight();
            wrapSizePx = textSizePx;
            wrapWpl = wordsPerLine;
            recomputeMaxScroll();
            return;
        }
        // Nothing changed — keep the existing split so scrolling is stable.
        // The bounds are still recomputed below because they depend on height,
        // which is not part of the split itself.
        if (width == wrapWidth && getHeight() == wrapHeight
                && textSizePx == wrapSizePx && wordsPerLine == wrapWpl
                && !segments.isEmpty()) {
            recomputeMaxScroll();
            return;
        }

        textPaint.setTextSize(textSizePx);
        float padL = getPaddingLeft();
        float padR = getPaddingRight();
        float avail = Math.max(1f, width - padL - padR);

        int wpl = TeleMath.wordsPerLine(Math.round(avail), textSizePx,
                wordsPerLine);

        segments.clear();
        String space = " ";
        float spaceW = textPaint.measureText(space);
        for (String paragraph : script.split("\\n", -1)) {
            String trimmed = paragraph.trim();
            if (trimmed.isEmpty()) {
                segments.add("");
                continue;
            }
            String[] words = trimmed.split("\\s+");
            int i = 0;
            while (i < words.length) {
                StringBuilder line = new StringBuilder(words[i]);
                float lineW = textPaint.measureText(words[i]);
                int take = 1;
                while (i + take < words.length && take < wpl) {
                    float nextW = lineW + spaceW
                            + textPaint.measureText(words[i + take]);
                    if (nextW > avail) break;
                    line.append(space).append(words[i + take]);
                    lineW = nextW;
                    take++;
                }
                segments.add(line.toString());
                i += take;
            }
        }

        wrapWidth = width;
        wrapHeight = getHeight();
        wrapSizePx = textSizePx;
        wrapWpl = wordsPerLine;
        recomputeMaxScroll();
    }

    /**
     * Scroll bounds. The last segment must be able to reach the centre line,
     * otherwise the tail of the script scrolls past the bottom and the panel
     * goes blank.
     *
     * &lt;p&gt;First baseline is {@code h/2 - scrollOffset} and segment k sits at
     * {@code h/2 - scrollOffset + k*lh}. Requiring the final segment
     * (k = n-1) to land on the centre line gives
     * {@code scrollOffset = (n-1)*lh - centreOffset}.
     */
    private void recomputeMaxScroll() {
        int h = getHeight();
        if (h <= 0 || segments.isEmpty()) {
            maxScroll = 0f;
            return;
        }
        float lh = lineHeight();
        float centreOffset = lh * 0.36f;
        float total = contentHeight();
        maxScroll = Math.max(0f, total - lh - centreOffset);
        if (scrollOffset > maxScroll) scrollOffset = maxScroll;
    }

    /**
     * Baseline for the beginning of the visible window.
     *
     * &lt;p&gt;The absolute baseline of segment {@code absoluteIndex} is always
     * {@code centreY - scrollOffset + absoluteIndex * lineHeight}. When
     * only the visible window is drawn, its first segment is therefore not at
     * the nominal first baseline: the window start must retain
     * {@code firstSegment * lineHeight}. Omitting that term is what used to
     * make every line snap upward by one full line each time scrolling crossed
     * a line boundary.
     */
    static float windowStartBaseline(float centreY, float scrollOffset,
                                     int firstSegment, float lineHeight) {
        return centreY - scrollOffset + firstSegment * lineHeight;
    }

    /**
     * First segment to draw for a scroll position: one line above the top
     * edge, so the uppermost line slides smoothly out of the panel instead
     * of popping out of existence while still well inside it.
     */
    static int drawStartForScroll(float centreY, float scrollOffset,
                                  float lineHeight) {
        return (int) Math.floor((scrollOffset - centreY) / lineHeight) - 1;
    }

    /**
     * How many segments to draw starting at {@code drawFrom} (whose baseline
     * is {@code drawBaseline}) so the window reaches past the bottom edge
     * with one line of margin.
     */
    static int drawCountForScroll(float drawBaseline, float lineHeight,
                                  int viewHeight) {
        int n = (int) Math.ceil(
                (viewHeight + lineHeight - drawBaseline) / lineHeight) + 1;
        return Math.max(0, n);
    }

    /**
     * Returns exactly {@code visibleLines} segments starting at
     * {@code firstSegment}, substituting {@code ""} for any index outside the
     * script.
     */
    static String[] windowForScroll(List&lt;String&gt; segments, int visibleLines,
                                    int firstSegment) {
        if (visibleLines <= 0) return new String[0];
        String[] out = new String[visibleLines];
        for (int i = 0; i < visibleLines; i++) {
            int idx = firstSegment + i;
            // Empty segments at both ends instead of crashing.
            out[i] = (idx < 0 || idx >= segments.size()) ? "" : segments.get(idx);
        }
        return out;
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDraw(Canvas canvas) {
        super.onDraw(canvas);
        int w = getWidth();
        int h = getHeight();
        if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return;

        float lh = lineHeight();
        int count = visibleLineCount();

        // Reading centre: the middle of the visible area, pushed down when
        // chrome overlays the top of the panel.
        float centreY = h / 2f + centerShiftPx;
        int drawFrom;
        float drawBaseline;
        int drawCount;
        if (segments.isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }
        if (totalLinesFits(count)) {
            drawFrom = 0;
            drawBaseline = centreY - (segments.size() - 1) * lh / 2f
                    + lh * 0.36f;
            drawCount = segments.size();
        } else {
            // The window starts at the top edge — not one line above the
            // reading centre. Starting at the scroll position only drew a
            // single line above the centre, so every line vanished abruptly
            // a couple of lines above the middle instead of travelling up
            // to the top of the panel.
            drawFrom = drawStartForScroll(centreY, scrollOffset, lh);
            drawBaseline = windowStartBaseline(centreY, scrollOffset,
                    drawFrom, lh);
            drawCount = drawCountForScroll(drawBaseline, lh, h);
        }
        String[] window = windowForScroll(segments, drawCount, drawFrom);

        int save = canvas.save();
        if (mirror) {
            canvas.translate(w, 0);
            canvas.scale(-1f, 1f);
        }
        int layer = canvas.saveLayer(0, 0, w, h, null);

        textPaint.setColor(textColor);
        textPaint.setTextSize(renderedTextSizePx());
        textPaint.setTextAlign(Paint.Align.CENTER);
        textPaint.setShader(null);
        textPaint.setXfermode(null);

        float centreX = w / 2f;
        float baseline = drawBaseline;
        float baselineAlphaFloor = 0.30f;
        for (String line : window) {
            // Fade is symmetric about the reading centre, not the view
            // centre, so the brightest line is always the middle one.
            float a = TeleMath.fadeAlpha(baseline - centerShiftPx, h, fadePx);
            if (!line.isEmpty() && a > 0.01f) {
                textPaint.setAlpha(Math.round(255f
                        * Math.max(baselineAlphaFloor, a)));
                canvas.drawText(line, centreX, baseline, textPaint);
            }
            baseline += lh;
        }
        textPaint.setAlpha(255);

        maskPaint.setXfermode(new PorterDuffXfermode(PorterDuff.Mode.DST_IN));
        // Opaque band follows the reading centre: 30% of the height each
        // side, clamped into the view.
        float opaqueTop = Math.max(0f, (centreY - h * 0.30f) / h);
        float opaqueBottom = Math.min(1f, (centreY + h * 0.30f) / h);
        maskPaint.setShader(new LinearGradient(0, 0, 0, h,
                new int[]{0x00000000, 0xFF000000, 0xFF000000, 0x00000000},
                new float[]{0f, opaqueTop, opaqueBottom, 1f},
                Shader.TileMode.CLAMP));
        canvas.drawRect(0, 0, w, h, maskPaint);
        maskPaint.setShader(null);
        maskPaint.setXfermode(null);
        canvas.restoreToCount(layer);
        canvas.restoreToCount(save);
    }

    /**
     * True when the whole script is shorter than the viewport.
     */
    private boolean totalLinesFits(int count) {
        return segments.size() <= 1 && scrollOffset <= 0.01f;
    }

    // ---- dragging the script by hand ----

    private float downX;
    private float downY;
    private float lastTouchY;
    private int activePointer = -1;
    private boolean dragging;

    /** True only while the user's finger is actively dragging the script. */
    public boolean isDragging() {
        return dragging;
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDetachedFromWindow() {
        dragging = false;
        activePointer = -1;
        super.onDetachedFromWindow();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onTouchEvent(MotionEvent event) {
        if (maxScroll() <= 0f) {
            // Nothing to scroll: let taps through, but do not claim drags.
            return super.onTouchEvent(event);
        }
        switch (event.getActionMasked()) {
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN:
                activePointer = event.getPointerId(0);
                downX = event.getX();
                downY = event.getY();
                lastTouchY = event.getY();
                dragging = false;
                if (getParent() != null) {
                    getParent().requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(true);
                }
                return true;
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE: {
                int idx = event.findPointerIndex(activePointer);
                if (idx < 0) return true;
                float y = event.getY(idx);
                float dy = y - lastTouchY;
                // A4-11: the horizontal term used event.getX() - event.getX(0),
                // which is always 0, so any horizontal swipe with a little
                // vertical movement started a scroll. Compare against the
                // recorded downX instead.
                if (!dragging && Math.abs(y - downY) > touchSlopPx()
                        && Math.abs(y - downY)
                        > Math.abs(event.getX(idx) - downX)) {
                    dragging = true;
                    // Re-anchor so the first frames of travel do not jump by
                    // the slop that was just crossed.
                    lastTouchY = y;
                }
                if (dragging) {
                    // Drag down moves the text down, i.e. back through the script.
                    scrollBy(-dy);
                    lastTouchY = y;
                }
                return true;
            }
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_UP:
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL:
                activePointer = -1;
                if (!dragging) performClick();
                dragging = false;
                if (getParent() != null) {
                    getParent().requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(false);
                }
                return true;
            default:
                return true;
        }
    }

    private float touchSlopPx() {
        return getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density * 8f;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean performClick() {
        return super.performClick();
    }

    private String[] windowOf(int count, int from) {
        return windowForScroll(segments, count, from);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.pm.ActivityInfo;
import android.view.View;
import android.widget.FrameLayout;
import android.widget.TextView;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.junit.After;
import org.junit.Before;
import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.Robolectric;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

/**
 * Verifies TakeOne's ad-supported free-release configuration:
 * &lt;ul&gt;
 *   &lt;li&gt;Paywall is disabled by default ({@link TrialAndBillingManager#isPaywallEnabled()}
 *       is {@code false} and {@link TrialAndBillingManager#hasProAccess()} is
 *       {@code true} for all takes without showing the billing sheet).</li>
 *   &lt;li&gt;Official Google AdMob Android Test App ID and Ad Unit IDs are wired
 *       for Adaptive Banner, Standard Banner, Interstitial, Native Advanced,
 *       App Open, and Rewarded formats.</li>
 *   &lt;li&gt;Post-Save Interstitial fires on the very first save EVEN while
 *       {@link RecordingEngine#hasSession()} is still {@code true} and
 *       {@link RecordingEngine#isSaving()} is {@code true} during background
 *       save dispatch.</li>
 *   &lt;li&gt;Share-from-Export menu ({@link AdMobManager#onShareRequested}) triggers
 *       interstitial eligibility and always runs the share chooser callback.</li>
 *   &lt;li&gt;Offline House Ad fallback renders into {@code libraryAdContainer} when
 *       the device is offline.</li>
 *   &lt;li&gt;MainActivity enforces portrait-only orientation and TeleprompterView
 *       preserves reading line position across size changes.</li>
 * &lt;/ul&gt;
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class AdMobManagerTest {

    private Context ctx;
    private AdMobManager adMob;

    @Before
    public void setUp() {
        ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        TrialAndBillingManager.setTestOverridePro(null);
        AdMobManager.setTestOverrideAdsEnabled(true);
        RecordingEngine.get().abortAndDelete();
        adMob = AdMobManager.get(ctx);
        adMob.resetForTesting();
    }

    @After
    public void tearDown() {
        AdMobManager.setTestOverrideAdsEnabled(null);
        TrialAndBillingManager.setTestOverridePro(null);
        RecordingEngine.get().abortAndDelete();
        if (adMob != null) {
            adMob.resetForTesting();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void officialGoogleTestAdUnitIdsAreConfigured() {
        assertEquals("ca-app-pub-3940256099942544~3347511713",
                AdMobManager.TEST_APP_ID);
        assertEquals("ca-app-pub-3940256099942544/9214589741",
                AdMobManager.TEST_ADAPTIVE_BANNER_ID);
        assertEquals("ca-app-pub-3940256099942544/6300978111",
                AdMobManager.TEST_BANNER_ID);
        assertEquals("ca-app-pub-3940256099942544/1033173712",
                AdMobManager.TEST_INTERSTITIAL_ID);
        assertEquals("ca-app-pub-3940256099942544/2247696110",
                AdMobManager.TEST_NATIVE_ADVANCED_ID);
        assertEquals("ca-app-pub-3940256099942544/9257395921",
                AdMobManager.TEST_APP_OPEN_ID);
        assertEquals("ca-app-pub-3940256099942544/5224354917",
                AdMobManager.TEST_REWARDED_ID);
    }

    @Test
    public void paywallIsDisabledAndAllStudioFeaturesAreFreeByDefault() {
        assertFalse("Paywall must be disabled in ad-supported release",
                TrialAndBillingManager.isPaywallEnabled());
        TrialAndBillingManager billing = TrialAndBillingManager.get(ctx);
        assertTrue("All Studio tools must be unlocked for free",
                billing.hasProAccess());

        Activity activity = Robolectric.buildActivity(Activity.class).setup().get();
        final boolean[] ran = {false};
        boolean allowed = TrialAndBillingManager.requireProOrShowPaywall(
                activity, "Effects", () -> ran[0] = true);
        assertTrue("requireProOrShowPaywall must allow action without paywall",
                allowed);
        assertTrue("onAllowed callback must execute immediately", ran[0]);
    }

    @Test
    public void postSaveInterstitialIsEligibleOnFirstSaveWhileEngineIsSaving()
            throws Exception {
        RecordingEngine engine = RecordingEngine.get();
        engine.startNewSession(ctx, "SaveAdTest", 2);
        engine.state = RecordingEngine.State.PAUSED;
        engine.setSaving(true);
        try {
            assertTrue("Engine still holds session while background save starts",
                    engine.hasSession());
            long t0 = 1_000_000L;
            assertTrue("First save must be eligible for post-save interstitial even while engine.hasSession() is true during save handoff",
                    adMob.recordActionAndEvaluateInterstitialEligibility(t0));
            adMob.recordFullScreenAdShown(t0, false);

            // Immediate back-to-back trigger within 15s cooldown is blocked
            assertFalse("Second trigger within 15s cooldown must be blocked",
                    adMob.recordActionAndEvaluateInterstitialEligibility(t0 + 5_000L));

            // Next save/export after 15s cooldown is eligible
            long afterCooldown = t0 + AdMobManager.INTERSTITIAL_COOLDOWN_MS + 1_000L;
            assertTrue("Next save/export after cooldown must be eligible",
                    adMob.recordActionAndEvaluateInterstitialEligibility(afterCooldown));
        } finally {
            engine.setSaving(false);
            engine.abortAndDelete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void shareFromExportMenuTriggersAdCheckAndRunsShareChooserCallback() {
        Activity activity = Robolectric.buildActivity(Activity.class).setup().get();
        final boolean[] shareLaunched = {false};
        adMob.onShareRequested(activity, () -> shareLaunched[0] = true);
        assertTrue("Share chooser callback must run after onShareRequested",
                shareLaunched[0]);
    }

    @Test
    public void offlineHouseAdFallbackRendersIntoLibraryContainer() {
        Activity activity = Robolectric.buildActivity(Activity.class).setup().get();
        FrameLayout container = new FrameLayout(activity);
        adMob.bindOfflineHouseAdFallback(activity, container);

        assertEquals(View.VISIBLE, container.getVisibility());
        assertTrue(adMob.isShowingOfflineHouseAd());
        TextView headline = container.findViewById(R.id.adHeadline);
        assertNotNull(headline);
        assertTrue(headline.getText().toString().contains("TakeOne Pro Studio"));
    }

    @Test
    public void mainActivityEnforcesPortraitAndTeleprompterPreservesLineOnResize() {
        MainActivity main = Robolectric.buildActivity(MainActivity.class).create().get();
        assertEquals("MainActivity must lock orientation to PORTRAIT",
                ActivityInfo.SCREEN_ORIENTATION_PORTRAIT,
                main.getRequestedOrientation());

        TeleprompterView tv = new TeleprompterView(main);
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < 200; i++) sb.append("word").append(i).append(' ');
        tv.setScript(sb.toString());
        tv.measure(
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(900, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY),
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(600, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY));
        tv.layout(0, 0, 900, 600);

        float targetLine = 5.0f;
        tv.setScrollOffset(targetLine * tv.lineHeight());
        assertEquals(targetLine, tv.linePosition(), 0.05f);

        // Simulate a viewport size change: line position must not reset to 0
        tv.measure(
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(600, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY),
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(900, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY));
        tv.layout(0, 0, 600, 900);
        assertTrue("Teleprompter must not reset to 0 on size change",
                tv.scrollOffset() > 0f);
        assertEquals(targetLine, tv.linePosition(), 0.1f);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;
import android.os.SystemClock;

import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4;
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;

/**
 * Roadmap Phase 4 on-device: selection-range preview stops at the range end
 * (not the file end) and the live DSP chain previews without errors through
 * a real AudioTrack.
 */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4.class)
public class AudioEditorDeviceTest {

    private File makeRaw(Context ctx, String tag, int frames) throws Exception {
        File takes = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx);
        File f = new File(takes,
                "edit_" + tag + "_" + System.nanoTime() + ".wav");
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(2, 48000, (long) frames * 2 * 4));
            float[] buf = new float[frames * 2];
            for (int i = 0; i < buf.length; i++) {
                buf[i] = (float) Math.sin(i * 0.03) * 0.5f;
            }
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, buf, 0, buf.length);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        return f;
    }

    @Test
    public void playRangeStopsAtRangeEnd() throws Exception {
        Context ctx = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
                .getTargetContext();
        File raw = makeRaw(ctx, "range", 48000 * 6);
        final boolean[] done = {false};
        RawFloatPlayer player = null;
        long start = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
        try {
            player = new RawFloatPlayer(raw, ok -> {
                done[0] = ok;
            });
            player.playRange(0, 48000);
            long deadline = start + 8000;
            while (!done[0] && SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() < deadline) {
                Thread.sleep(200);
            }
            long elapsed = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - start;
            assertTrue("range preview never completed", done[0]);
            assertTrue("range preview took " + elapsed
                            + "ms (played past the range?)",
                    elapsed < 5000);
            assertTrue("position " + player.positionMs(),
                    Math.abs(player.positionMs() - 1000) < 400);
        } finally {
            if (player != null) player.stop();
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            raw.delete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void dspChainPreviewCompletes() throws Exception {
        Context ctx = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
                .getTargetContext();
        File raw = makeRaw(ctx, "dsp", 48000 * 2);
        final boolean[] done = {false};
        RawFloatPlayer player = null;
        long start = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
        try {
            player = new RawFloatPlayer(raw, ok -> {
                done[0] = ok;
            });
            player.setDspChain(
                    new DspChain(2, DspChain.Config.voicePolish()));
            player.play();
            long deadline = start + 10000;
            while (!done[0] && SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() < deadline) {
                Thread.sleep(200);
            }
            assertTrue("dsp preview never completed", done[0]);
        } finally {
            if (player != null) player.stop();
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            raw.delete();
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4;
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;

/**
 * BUG-01 + BUG-08 on device: compressed imports land at 48 kHz with the
 * right duration/pitch (no 3x/6x chipmunking), and mono sources stay mono.
 */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4.class)
public class AudioImportResampleTest {

    private File makeFloatWav(Context ctx, String name, int frames, int ch,
                              int rate, double freq) throws Exception {
        File f = new File(ctx.getCacheDir(), name);
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(ch, rate, (long) frames * ch * 4));
            float[] buf = new float[frames * ch];
            for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) {
                float v = (float) (0.4 * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * freq * i
                        / rate));
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) buf[i * ch + c] = v;
            }
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, buf, 0, buf.length);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        return f;
    }

    private static float peakAbs(File wav) throws Exception {
        FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(wav);
        RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(wav, "r");
        try {
            int ch = info.channels;
            long frames = info.dataBytes / 4 / ch;
            int n = (int) Math.min(frames, 48000);
            byte[] raw = new byte[n * ch * 4];
            r.seek(info.dataStart);
            r.readFully(raw);
            java.nio.FloatBuffer fb = java.nio.ByteBuffer.wrap(raw)
                    .order(java.nio.ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).asFloatBuffer();
            float peak = 0f;
            for (int i = 0; i < n * ch; i++) {
                float a = Math.abs(fb.get(i));
                if (a > peak) peak = a;
            }
            return peak;
        } finally {
            r.close();
        }
    }

    private static double pitchHz(File wav) throws Exception {
        FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(wav);
        RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(wav, "r");
        try {
            int ch = info.channels;
            long frames = info.dataBytes / 4 / ch;
            byte[] raw = new byte[(int) Math.min(frames, 48000) * ch * 4];
            r.seek(info.dataStart);
            r.readFully(raw);
            java.nio.FloatBuffer fb = java.nio.ByteBuffer.wrap(raw)
                    .order(java.nio.ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).asFloatBuffer();
            int n = raw.length / 4 / ch;
            int crossings = 0;
            float prev = fb.get(0);
            for (int f = 1; f < n; f++) {
                float cur = fb.get(f * ch);
                if ((prev <= 0f && cur > 0f) || (prev >= 0f && cur < 0f)) {
                    crossings++;
                }
                prev = cur;
            }
            return crossings / 2.0 / (n / (double) info.sampleRate);
        } finally {
            r.close();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void monoFloatStaysMono() throws Exception {
        Context ctx = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
                .getTargetContext();
        File src = makeFloatWav(ctx, "imp_mono.wav", 48000, 1, 48000, 440.0);
        File dstParent = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx);
        File out = null;
        try {
            out = AudioImporter.takeToFloatWav(src, dstParent,
                    "Import Mono", null);
            FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(out);
            assertEquals("mono was upmixed to stereo", 1, info.channels);
            assertEquals(48000, info.sampleRate);
            assertEquals(440.0, pitchHz(out), 5.0);
        } finally {
            if (src.exists()) src.delete();
            if (out != null && out.exists()) out.delete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void rate44kM4aImportsAt48kWithRightDurationAndPitch()
            throws Exception {
        Context ctx = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
                .getTargetContext();
        // 2 s of 440 Hz at 44.1 kHz, AAC-encoded on device.
        File float44 = makeFloatWav(ctx, "imp44.wav", 88200, 2, 44100, 440.0);
        File m4a = new File(ctx.getCacheDir(), "imp44.m4a");
        File dstParent = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx);
        File out = null;
        try {
            FormatConverter.toM4a(float44, m4a, 128000, null);
            out = AudioImporter.takeToFloatWav(m4a, dstParent,
                    "Import 44k", null);
            FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(out);
            assertEquals(48000, info.sampleRate);
            assertEquals(2, info.channels);
            long frames = info.dataBytes / 4 / 2;
            // 2.0 s, tolerant of AAC encoder/decoder padding.
            assertTrue("duration " + frames + " frames",
                    Math.abs(frames - 96000) < 14400);
            // The old bug played this back ~9% fast; pitch must be 440 Hz.
            assertEquals(440.0, pitchHz(out), 8.0);
            // NEW-02: byte-swapped PCM would decode to erratic full-scale
            // garbage instead of a 0.4 sine.
            assertTrue("peak " + peakAbs(out),
                    peakAbs(out) > 0.25f && peakAbs(out) < 0.6f);
        } finally {
            if (float44.exists()) float44.delete();
            if (m4a.exists()) m4a.delete();
            if (out != null && out.exists()) out.delete();
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4;
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;

/**
 * Punch-in import on a real device: float WAV passthrough and compressed
 * (M4A) decode into a fresh 32-bit float session.
 */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4.class)
public class AudioImportTest {

    private File makeFloatWav(Context ctx, String name, int frames, int ch)
            throws Exception {
        File f = new File(ctx.getCacheDir(), name);
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(ch, 48000, (long) frames * ch * 4));
            float[] buf = new float[frames * ch];
            for (int i = 0; i < frames * ch; i++) {
                buf[i] = (float) Math.sin(i * 0.05) * 0.4f;
            }
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, buf, 0, buf.length);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        return f;
    }

    @Test
    public void floatWavPassthroughIsStereoFloat() throws Exception {
        Context ctx = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
                .getTargetContext();
        File src = makeFloatWav(ctx, "imp_float.wav", 48000, 2);
        File dstParent = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx);
        try {
            File out = AudioImporter.takeToFloatWav(src, dstParent,
                    "Import Float", null);
            try {
                FormatConverter.WavInfo info =
                        FormatConverter.readFloatWav(out);
                assertEquals(2, info.channels);
                assertEquals(48000, info.sampleRate);
                assertEquals(48000L * 2 * 4, info.dataBytes);
            } finally {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                out.delete();
            }
        } finally {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            src.delete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void monoFloatWavStaysMono() throws Exception {
        Context ctx = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
                .getTargetContext();
        File src = makeFloatWav(ctx, "imp_mono.wav", 24000, 1);
        File dstParent = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx);
        try {
            File out = AudioImporter.takeToFloatWav(src, dstParent,
                    "Import Mono", null);
            try {
                FormatConverter.WavInfo info =
                        FormatConverter.readFloatWav(out);
                assertEquals(1, info.channels);
                assertEquals(24000L * 1 * 4, info.dataBytes);
            } finally {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                out.delete();
            }
        } finally {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            src.delete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void m4aDecodesToFloatSession() throws Exception {
        Context ctx = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
                .getTargetContext();
        File src = makeFloatWav(ctx, "imp_src.wav", 48000, 2);
        File m4a = new File(ctx.getCacheDir(),
                "imp_src_" + System.nanoTime() + ".m4a");
        File dstParent = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx);
        try {
            FormatConverter.toM4a(src, m4a, 128000, null);
            File out = AudioImporter.takeToFloatWav(m4a, dstParent,
                    "Import M4A", null);
            try {
                FormatConverter.WavInfo info =
                        FormatConverter.readFloatWav(out);
                assertEquals(2, info.channels);
                assertEquals(48000, info.sampleRate);
                assertTrue("empty import", info.dataBytes > 0);
            } finally {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                out.delete();
            }
        } finally {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            src.delete();
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            m4a.delete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void garbageFileIsRejected() throws Exception {
        Context ctx = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
                .getTargetContext();
        File src = new File(ctx.getCacheDir(), "imp_garbage.bin");
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(src, "rw");
        try {
            w.write(new byte[500]);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        File dstParent = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx);
        try {
            boolean threw = false;
            try {
                AudioImporter.takeToFloatWav(src, dstParent, "Garbage", null);
            } catch (Exception expected) {
                threw = true;
            }
            assertTrue("garbage must be rejected", threw);
        } finally {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            src.delete();
        }
    }

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;

import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4;
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Regression coverage for the reported "background converter completely
 * stops" behaviour. The old worker parked forever while a take was open for
 * editing (or while any reader held its raw); editing the same take and
 * previewing its raw must now both leave the conversion running to
 * completion in the background.
 */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4.class)
public class BackgroundConversionResilienceTest {

    private Context ctx() {
        return InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().getTargetContext();
    }

    private File makeRaw(Context ctx, String name) throws Exception {
        File takes = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx);
        File f = new File(takes, name + "_" + System.nanoTime() + ".wav");
        int frames = 48000 * 2;
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(2, 48000, (long) frames * 2 * 4));
            float[] buf = new float[frames * 2];
            for (int i = 0; i < frames * 2; i++) {
                buf[i] = (float) Math.sin(i * 0.05) * 0.4f;
            }
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, buf, 0, buf.length);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        return f;
    }

    private void launchActivity() {
        android.app.Instrumentation instr =
                InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation();
        Intent i = new Intent(instr.getTargetContext(), MainActivity.class);
        i.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK
                | Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TASK);
        instr.startActivitySync(i);
    }

    @Test
    public void conversionFinishesWhileTheSameTakeIsOpenForEditing()
            throws Exception {
        launchActivity();
        Context ctx = ctx();
        RecordingEngine engine = RecordingEngine.get();
        engine.abortAndDelete();
        File raw = makeRaw(ctx, "Background edit");
        ConversionJob job = null;
        Take finished = null;
        try {
            job = ConversionJobs.enqueue(ctx, raw, "Background edit",
                    RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.M4A, 2000);
            assertNotNull("job was not enqueued", job);
            // Exactly the old park condition: an edit session for the same
            // synthetic take id, plus a live raw reader (preview/import).
            EditLink.save(ctx, job.takeId(), "Background edit",
                    raw.getAbsolutePath());
            engine.attachExisting(ctx, raw, "Background edit", 2,
                    RecordingEngine.payloadBytesOf(raw));
            ConversionJobs.beginRawRead(raw.getAbsolutePath());
            assertTrue("session should be open", engine.hasSession());
            assertTrue("raw should be marked as read",
                    ConversionJobs.rawIsBeingRead(raw.getAbsolutePath()));

            ConversionService.startJob(ctx, job.jobId);

            long deadline = System.currentTimeMillis() + 60_000L;
            while (ConversionJobs.get(job.jobId) != null
                    && System.currentTimeMillis() < deadline) {
                Thread.sleep(100);
            }
            assertNull("conversion stalled while the take was being edited",
                    ConversionJobs.get(job.jobId));

            List<Take> takes = TakesRepository.all();
            for (Take t : takes) {
                if ("Background edit".equals(t.title)) finished = t;
            }
            assertNotNull("finished take not in library", finished);
            assertTrue("finished file missing", finished.hasFile());
            assertTrue("reader must defer raw deletion until it closes",
                    raw.exists());
        } finally {
            ConversionJobs.endRawRead(raw.getAbsolutePath());
            engine.clearSession();
            EditLink.clear(ctx);
            if (job != null) ConversionJobs.cancel(job.jobId, true);
            if (finished != null) TakesRepository.delete(finished.id);
            if (finished != null) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                new File(finished.filePath).delete();
            }
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            raw.delete();
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            new File(raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".pending").delete();
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;
import android.util.Log;

import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4;
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;

/**
 * Throughput probe for the save path. Prints MB/s per conversion so the
 * effect of the bulk-conversion work is measurable rather than asserted.
 *
 * <p>Runs on whatever device/emulator it is pushed to; emulator numbers are
 * pessimistic, so treat them as a floor.
 */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4.class)
public class ConversionBenchTest {

    private static final String TAG = "CONVBENCH";
    private static final double SECONDS = 20.0;
    private static final int SR = 48000;
    private static final int CH = 2;

    private File makeSource(String name) throws Exception {
        Context ctx = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
                .getTargetContext();
        File f = new File(ctx.getCacheDir(), name);
        int frames = (int) (SR * SECONDS);
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(CH, SR, (long) frames * CH * 4));
            float[] buf = new float[8192 * CH];
            double phase = 0;
            for (int off = 0; off < frames; off += 8192) {
                int n = Math.min(8192, frames - off);
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    // Mix of tones + noise so it is not trivially compressible.
                    float v = (float) (0.30 * Math.sin(phase)
                            + 0.15 * Math.sin(phase * 2.7)
                            + 0.05 * (Math.random() * 2 - 1));
                    buf[i * 2] = v;
                    buf[i * 2 + 1] = v * 0.9f;
                    phase += 2 * Math.PI * 220 / SR;
                }
                Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, buf, 0, n * CH);
            }
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        return f;
    }

    private void bench(String label, File src, long rawBytes, Runner r)
            throws Exception {
        File out = new File(src.getParentFile(), "bench_" + label + ".tmp");
        // warm the page cache / JIT
        long t0 = System.nanoTime();
        r.run(src, out);
        long ms = (System.nanoTime() - t0) / 1_000_000L;
        double mb = rawBytes / 1048576d;
        double mbps = (mb / (ms / 1000d));
        Log.i(TAG, String.format(java.util.Locale.US,
                "%s: %d bytes in %d ms = %.1f MB/s (%.2fx realtime)", label,
                rawBytes, ms, mbps, SECONDS / (ms / 1000d)));
        long outBytes = out.exists() ? out.length() : 0L;
        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
        out.delete();
        assertTrue(label + " produced no output (" + outBytes + " bytes)",
                outBytes > 0);
    }

    private interface Runner {
        void run(File src, File dst) throws Exception;
    }

    @Test
    public void conversionThroughput() throws Exception {
        File src = makeSource("bench_in.wav");
        long rawBytes = src.length();
        Log.i(TAG, String.format(java.util.Locale.US,
                "source: %.1f MB, %.0fs of 48k stereo",
                rawBytes / 1048576d, SECONDS));

        bench("wav16", src, rawBytes, (a, b) ->
                FormatConverter.toWav16(a, b, null));
        bench("wav24", src, rawBytes, (a, b) ->
                FormatConverter.toWav24(a, b, null));
        bench("m4a", src, rawBytes, (a, b) ->
                FormatConverter.toM4a(a, b, 256000, null));
        bench("flac", src, rawBytes, (a, b) ->
                FormatConverter.toFlac(a, b, null));

        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
        src.delete();
    }
}

FILE: app/src/androidTest/java/com/example/hello/ConversionConcurrencyTest.java
