    private AdMobManager(Context ctx) {
        this.appCtx = ctx.getApplicationContext();
    }

    public static AdMobManager get(@NonNull Context ctx) {
        AdMobManager mgr = instance;
        if (mgr == null) {
            synchronized (AdMobManager.class) {
                mgr = instance;
                if (mgr == null) {
                    mgr = new AdMobManager(ctx);
                    instance = mgr;
                }
            }
        }
        if (ctx.getApplicationContext() != mgr.appCtx) {
            mgr.appCtx = ctx.getApplicationContext();
        }
        return mgr;
    }

    /** Test hook for unit/instrumentation tests to force-enable or disable ads. */
    public static void setTestOverrideAdsEnabled(@Nullable Boolean override) {
        testOverrideAdsEnabled = override;
    }

    /**
     * Returns true when ads should be served. Automatically suppresses all ads
     * if the user owns a paid Pro entitlement (for future hybrid releases) or
     * if running inside automated Robolectric/Instrumentation suites unless
     * explicitly overridden in {@link #setTestOverrideAdsEnabled(Boolean)}.
     */
    public boolean isAdsEnabled() {
        if (testOverrideAdsEnabled != null) {
            return testOverrideAdsEnabled;
        }
        if (TrialAndBillingManager.get(appCtx).isPaidPro()) {
            return false;
        }
        if (isRunningUnderAutomatedTest()) {
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    private static boolean isRunningUnderAutomatedTest() {
        try {
            Class.forName("org.robolectric.Robolectric");
            return true;
        } catch (ClassNotFoundException ignored) {}
        try {
            Class<?> reg = Class.forName(
                    "androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry");
            Object instr = reg.getMethod("getInstrumentation").invoke(null);
            if (instr != null) return true;
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Checks whether the device currently has an active internet-capable network.
     */
    public boolean isNetworkAvailable() {
        return HardwareApiManager.get().isNetworkAvailable(appCtx);
    }

    /**
     * Registers a system network listener so if the app starts without internet,
     * the moment Wi-Fi or mobile data connects, AdMob automatically initializes,
     * preloads full-screen ads, and upgrades the offline house card in
     * {@link LibraryFragment} to a live AdMob ad.
     */
    private synchronized void registerNetworkReconnectCallback() {
        if (networkCallbackRegistered) return;
        if (HardwareApiManager.get().registerDefaultNetworkCallback(
                appCtx, () -> mainHandler.post(this::onNetworkReconnected))) {
            networkCallbackRegistered = true;
        }
    }

    private void onNetworkReconnected() {
        if (!isAdsEnabled()) return;
        if (!sdkInitialized && !sdkInitInProgress) {
            init(appCtx);
        } else {
            preloadInterstitial();
            preloadAppOpenAd();
        }
        Activity act = boundLibraryActivityRef != null
                ? boundLibraryActivityRef.get() : null;
        FrameLayout container = boundLibraryContainerRef != null
                ? boundLibraryContainerRef.get() : null;
        if (act != null && container != null
                && (!libraryAdLoaded || showingOfflineHouseAd)) {
            bindLibraryAd(act, container, boundLibraryHideForUiMode);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Initializes the Google Mobile Ads SDK, registers the automatic
     * network-reconnect listener, enforces global ad audio muting so ads never
     * disrupt microphone capture or audio focus, and preloads background
     * Interstitial and App Open inventory into RAM.
     */
    public synchronized void init(@NonNull Context context) {
        this.appCtx = context.getApplicationContext();
        if (!isAdsEnabled()) return;
        registerNetworkReconnectCallback();
        if (sdkInitialized) {
            applyAudioSafeSettings();
            preloadInterstitial();
            preloadAppOpenAd();
            return;
        }
        if (sdkInitInProgress) return;
        sdkInitInProgress = true;
        try {
            MobileAds.initialize(appCtx, initializationStatus -> {
                sdkInitialized = true;
                sdkInitInProgress = false;
                mainHandler.post(() -> {
                    applyAudioSafeSettings();
                    preloadInterstitial();
                    preloadAppOpenAd();
                    Activity act = boundLibraryActivityRef != null
                            ? boundLibraryActivityRef.get() : null;
                    FrameLayout container = boundLibraryContainerRef != null
                            ? boundLibraryContainerRef.get() : null;
                    if (act != null && container != null && showingOfflineHouseAd
                            && isNetworkAvailable()) {
                        bindLibraryAd(act, container, boundLibraryHideForUiMode);
                    }
                });
            });
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {
            sdkInitInProgress = false;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Globally mutes AdMob video/rich-media audio so an ad never steals
     * Android AudioFocus or plays over the device speaker in an audio studio.
     */
    public void applyAudioSafeSettings() {
        try {
            MobileAds.setAppMuted(true);
            MobileAds.setAppVolume(0f);
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
    }

    public void setAudioPlaybackActive(boolean active) {
        this.audioPlaybackActive = active;
    }

    public boolean isAudioPlaybackActive() {
        return audioPlaybackActive;
    }

    // ---- Placement 1: Library Native Advanced Card (with Adaptive Banner + Offline House Fallback) ----

    /**
     * Loads a non-intrusive Native Advanced ad styled like a TakeOne library
     * card into {@code container} (located below the filter chips in
     * {@link LibraryFragment}, far away from the bottom Record FAB).
     * <ul>
     *   <li>If Native Advanced fails to load while online, falls back to an
     *       Anchored Adaptive Banner.</li>
     *   <li>If the device is offline (or both online requests fail), renders a
     *       sleek in-house offline card promoting upcoming TakeOne Pro features,
     *       and automatically swaps it for a live AdMob ad as soon as internet
     *       reconnects.</li>
     * </ul>
     */
    public void bindLibraryAd(@NonNull Activity activity,
                              @Nullable FrameLayout container,
                              boolean hideForUiMode) {
        if (container == null) return;
        boundLibraryActivityRef = new WeakReference<>(activity);
        boundLibraryContainerRef = new WeakReference<>(container);
        boundLibraryHideForUiMode = hideForUiMode;

        if (!isAdsEnabled() || hideForUiMode) {
            container.setVisibility(View.GONE);
            return;
        }
        if (libraryAdLoaded && !showingOfflineHouseAd
                && container.getChildCount() > 0) {
            container.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            return;
        }
        if (!isNetworkAvailable()) {
            bindOfflineHouseAdFallback(activity, container);
            return;
        }
        if (container.getChildCount() == 0) {
            bindOfflineHouseAdFallback(activity, container);
        }
        try {
            AdLoader adLoader = new AdLoader.Builder(activity, TEST_NATIVE_ADVANCED_ID)
                    .forNativeAd(nativeAd -> {
                        if (activity.isFinishing() || activity.isDestroyed()) {
                            nativeAd.destroy();
                            return;
                        }
                        if (activeNativeAd != null && activeNativeAd != nativeAd) {
                            try {
                                activeNativeAd.destroy();
                            } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
                        }
                        activeNativeAd = nativeAd;
                        libraryAdLoaded = true;
                        showingOfflineHouseAd = false;
                        NativeAdView adView = (NativeAdView) LayoutInflater
                                .from(activity)
                                .inflate(R.layout.item_native_ad, container, false);
                        populateNativeAdView(nativeAd, adView);
                        container.removeAllViews();
                        container.addView(adView);
                        if (!boundLibraryHideForUiMode) {
                            container.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                        }
                    })
                    .withAdListener(new AdListener() {
                        @Override
                        public void onAdFailedToLoad(@NonNull LoadAdError error) {
                            loadAdaptiveBannerFallback(activity, container);
                        }
                    })
                    .withNativeAdOptions(new NativeAdOptions.Builder()
                            .setRequestMultipleImages(false)
                            .build())
                    .build();
            adLoader.loadAd(new AdRequest.Builder().build());
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {
            loadAdaptiveBannerFallback(activity, container);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Renders an offline-capable in-house promo card inside {@code container}
     * using {@code R.layout.item_native_ad} when the device has no internet
     * connection or while live ads are still fetching.
     */
    public void bindOfflineHouseAdFallback(@NonNull Context context,
                                           @NonNull FrameLayout container) {
        try {
            View card = LayoutInflater.from(context)
                    .inflate(R.layout.item_native_ad, container, false);
            TextView badge = card.findViewById(R.id.adAttributionBadge);
            TextView headline = card.findViewById(R.id.adHeadline);
            TextView body = card.findViewById(R.id.adBody);
            TextView cta = card.findViewById(R.id.adCallToAction);
            ImageView icon = card.findViewById(R.id.adAppIcon);

            if (badge != null) badge.setText("PRO");
            if (headline != null) {
                headline.setText("TakeOne Pro Studio • Coming Soon");
            }
            if (body != null) {
                body.setText("Hardware mic switching & multi-channel editing in upcoming releases");
                body.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            }
            if (cta != null) {
                cta.setText("Free Now");
                cta.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            }
            if (icon != null) {
                icon.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_mic);
                icon.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            }
            container.removeAllViews();
            container.addView(card);
            libraryAdLoaded = true;
            showingOfflineHouseAd = true;
            if (!boundLibraryHideForUiMode) {
                container.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            }
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
    }

    public boolean isShowingOfflineHouseAd() {
        return showingOfflineHouseAd;
    }

    private void populateNativeAdView(@NonNull NativeAd nativeAd,
                                      @NonNull NativeAdView adView) {
        TextView headlineView = adView.findViewById(R.id.adHeadline);
        TextView bodyView = adView.findViewById(R.id.adBody);
        TextView ctaView = adView.findViewById(R.id.adCallToAction);
        ImageView iconView = adView.findViewById(R.id.adAppIcon);

        adView.setHeadlineView(headlineView);
        adView.setBodyView(bodyView);
        adView.setCallToActionView(ctaView);
        adView.setIconView(iconView);

        if (headlineView != null) {
            headlineView.setText(nativeAd.getHeadline());
        }
        if (bodyView != null) {
            String body = nativeAd.getBody();
            String advertiser = nativeAd.getAdvertiser();
            String sub = (body != null && !body.trim().isEmpty())
                    ? body.trim()
                    : (advertiser != null ? advertiser.trim() : "Sponsored");
            bodyView.setText(sub);
            bodyView.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        }
        if (ctaView != null) {
            String cta = nativeAd.getCallToAction();
            if (cta != null && !cta.trim().isEmpty()) {
                ctaView.setText(cta.trim());
                ctaView.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            } else {
                ctaView.setVisibility(View.GONE);
            }
        }
        if (iconView != null) {
            NativeAd.Image icon = nativeAd.getIcon();
            if (icon != null && icon.getDrawable() != null) {
                iconView.setImageDrawable(icon.getDrawable());
            } else {
                iconView.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_wave);
            }
            iconView.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        }
        adView.setNativeAd(nativeAd);
    }

    private void loadAdaptiveBannerFallback(@NonNull Activity activity,
                                            @NonNull FrameLayout container) {
        if (activity.isFinishing() || activity.isDestroyed() || !isAdsEnabled()) {
            return;
        }
        if (!isNetworkAvailable()) {
            bindOfflineHouseAdFallback(activity, container);
            return;
        }
        try {
            if (activeBannerAdView != null) {
                try {
                    activeBannerAdView.destroy();
                } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
            }
            AdView adView = new AdView(activity);
            adView.setAdUnitId(TEST_ADAPTIVE_BANNER_ID);
            AdSize adSize = computeAnchoredAdaptiveSize(activity, container);
            adView.setAdSize(adSize);
            adView.setAdListener(new AdListener() {
                @Override
                public void onAdLoaded() {
                    libraryAdLoaded = true;
                    showingOfflineHouseAd = false;
                    container.removeAllViews();
                    container.addView(adView, new FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                            ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                            ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));
                    if (!boundLibraryHideForUiMode) {
                        container.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                    }
                }

                @Override
                public void onAdFailedToLoad(@NonNull LoadAdError loadAdError) {
                    if (container.getChildCount() == 0) {
                        bindOfflineHouseAdFallback(activity, container);
                    }
                }
            });
            activeBannerAdView = adView;
            adView.loadAd(new AdRequest.Builder().build());
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {
            if (container.getChildCount() == 0) {
                bindOfflineHouseAdFallback(activity, container);
            }
        }
    }

    private AdSize computeAnchoredAdaptiveSize(@NonNull Activity activity,
                                               @NonNull View container) {
        try {
            DisplayMetrics outMetrics = activity.getResources().getDisplayMetrics();
            float density = outMetrics.density > 0 ? outMetrics.density : 1f;
            int widthPixels = container.getWidth();
            if (widthPixels <= 0) {
                widthPixels = outMetrics.widthPixels - Math.round(32 * density);
            }
            int adWidth = Math.max(320, (int) (widthPixels / density));
            return AdSize.getCurrentOrientationAnchoredAdaptiveBannerAdSize(
                    activity, adWidth);
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {
            return AdSize.BANNER;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Updates the visibility of the Library ad slot so it hides cleanly when
     * the user is searching or multi-selecting takes.
     */
    public void updateLibraryAdVisibility(@Nullable FrameLayout container,
                                          boolean hideForUiMode) {
        boundLibraryHideForUiMode = hideForUiMode;
        if (container == null) return;
        if (!isAdsEnabled() || hideForUiMode || !libraryAdLoaded
                || container.getChildCount() == 0) {
            container.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        } else {
            container.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        }
    }

    public void onLibraryPaused() {
        if (activeBannerAdView != null) {
            try {
                activeBannerAdView.pause();
            } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        }
    }

    public void onLibraryResumed() {
        if (activeBannerAdView != null) {
            try {
                activeBannerAdView.resume();
            } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        }
    }

    public void onLibraryDestroyed() {
        libraryAdLoaded = false;
        showingOfflineHouseAd = false;
        boundLibraryContainerRef = null;
        if (activeBannerAdView != null) {
            try {
                activeBannerAdView.destroy();
            } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
            activeBannerAdView = null;
        }
        if (activeNativeAd != null) {
            try {
                activeNativeAd.destroy();
            } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
            activeNativeAd = null;
        }
    }

    // ---- Placement 2, 3 & 4: Post-Save, Post-Export & Share Interstitial Ads ----

    private boolean isInterstitialAvailable() {
        if (cachedInterstitial == null) return false;
        long age = System.currentTimeMillis() - interstitialLoadedAtMs;
        if (age >= INTERSTITIAL_EXPIRY_MS) {
            cachedInterstitial = null;
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    public synchronized void preloadInterstitial() {
        if (!isAdsEnabled() || isInterstitialAvailable() || loadingInterstitial) {
            return;
        }
        if (!isNetworkAvailable()) {
            return;
        }
        loadingInterstitial = true;
        try {
            InterstitialAd.load(appCtx, TEST_INTERSTITIAL_ID,
                    new AdRequest.Builder().build(),
                    new InterstitialAdLoadCallback() {
                        @Override
                        public void onAdLoaded(@NonNull InterstitialAd ad) {
                            cachedInterstitial = ad;
                            interstitialLoadedAtMs = System.currentTimeMillis();
                            loadingInterstitial = false;
                            maybeDeliverPendingInterstitial();
                        }

                        @Override
                        public void onAdFailedToLoad(@NonNull LoadAdError err) {
                            cachedInterstitial = null;
                            loadingInterstitial = false;
                        }
                    });
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {
            loadingInterstitial = false;
        }
    }

    private void maybeDeliverPendingInterstitial() {
        WeakReference<Activity> ref = pendingInterstitialActivityRef;
        pendingInterstitialActivityRef = null;
        if (ref == null) return;
        Activity act = ref.get();
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        if (act == null || act.isFinishing() || act.isDestroyed()) return;
        if ((now - pendingInterstitialRequestedAtMs) > LATE_INTERSTITIAL_GRACE_MS) {
            return;
        }
        if (isActivelyCapturingOrPlaying()) return;
        if (act instanceof MainActivity && ((MainActivity) act).isInStudio()) {
            return;
        }
        showCachedInterstitialNow(act, now, null);
    }

    /**
     * Evaluates whether a post-action Interstitial ad is allowed to show right
     * now based on frequency capping ({@link #INTERSTITIAL_ACTION_INTERVAL}),
     * minimum cooldown ({@link #INTERSTITIAL_COOLDOWN_MS}), and audio-studio
     * safety.
     *
     * <p><b>Why Post-Save Previously Failed:</b> During
     * {@code StudioFragment.runSaveDispatch()}, {@link #onTakeSaved(Activity)}
     * runs on the UI thread while {@code ConversionJobs.dispatchSave()} is
     * still starting on a background thread—meaning
     * {@code RecordingEngine.get().hasSession()} is still {@code true} with
     * {@code engine.isSaving() == true}. Checking {@code hasSession()} blocked
     * every save while allowing exports. We now check
     * {@link #isActivelyCapturingOrPlaying()}, which allows the post-save ad
     * as soon as capture has stopped or entered saving state!
     */
    public boolean recordActionAndEvaluateInterstitialEligibility(long nowMs) {
        if (!isAdsEnabled()) return false;
        SharedPreferences prefs = appCtx.getSharedPreferences(
                PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
        int count = prefs.getInt(KEY_AD_COMPLETED_ACTIONS, 0) + 1;
        long lastShown = prefs.getLong(KEY_LAST_FULLSCREEN_AD_MS, 0L);
        prefs.edit().putInt(KEY_AD_COMPLETED_ACTIONS, count).apply();

        if (isActivelyCapturingOrPlaying()) {
            return false;
        }
        if (count % INTERSTITIAL_ACTION_INTERVAL != 0) {
            return false;
        }
        if (lastShown > 0L && (nowMs - lastShown) < INTERSTITIAL_COOLDOWN_MS) {
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * True only when the user is actively recording audio into the microphone
     * (and NOT in the middle of saving/exiting Studio) or actively playing a
     * take in the Library.
     */
    private boolean isActivelyCapturingOrPlaying() {
        if (showingFullScreenAd || audioPlaybackActive) return true;
        try {
            RecordingEngine engine = RecordingEngine.get();
            if (engine.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING
                    && !engine.isSaving()) {
                return true;
            }
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Stricter check used only by Warm-Resume App Open ads so an App Open ad
     * does not cover an unfinalised paused recording session.
     */
    private boolean hasActiveOrPausedRecordingOrPlayback() {
        if (showingFullScreenAd || audioPlaybackActive) return true;
        try {
            if (RecordingEngine.get().hasSession()
                    && !RecordingEngine.get().isSaving()) {
                return true;
            }
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Called when a take is saved in {@link StudioFragment} and transitions
     * back to {@link LibraryFragment}. Dispatches after a brief 350ms UI beat
     * so the {@code STU -> LIB} fragment transaction and "Take saved" banner
     * settle cleanly before {@code AdActivity} launches.
     */
    public void onTakeSaved(@Nullable Activity activity) {
        if (activity == null) return;
        final WeakReference<Activity> actRef = new WeakReference<>(activity);
        mainHandler.postDelayed(() -> {
            Activity act = actRef.get();
            if (act != null && !act.isFinishing() && !act.isDestroyed()) {
                maybeShowPostActionInterstitial(act, null);
            }
        }, POST_SAVE_TRANSITION_DELAY_MS);
    }

    /**
     * Called when an audio export to a folder completes in
     * {@link LibraryFragment}.
     */
    public void onExportCompleted(@Nullable Activity activity) {
        maybeShowPostActionInterstitial(activity, null);
    }

    /**
     * Called when the user selects <b>Share</b> on the Export menu in
     * {@link LibraryFragment}. If an Interstitial ad is preloaded and eligible,
     * shows the ad first and launches the system Share sheet via
     * {@code onProceedToShare} as soon as the user closes the ad; otherwise
     * launches the system Share sheet immediately without blocking.
     */
    public void onShareRequested(@Nullable Activity activity,
                                 @NonNull Runnable onProceedToShare) {
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        boolean eligible = recordActionAndEvaluateInterstitialEligibility(now);
        if (!eligible || activity == null
                || activity.isFinishing() || activity.isDestroyed()
                || !isInterstitialAvailable()) {
            preloadInterstitial();
            onProceedToShare.run();
            return;
        }
        showCachedInterstitialNow(activity, now, onProceedToShare);
    }

    private void maybeShowPostActionInterstitial(@Nullable Activity activity,
                                                 @Nullable Runnable onAfterAd) {
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        boolean eligible = recordActionAndEvaluateInterstitialEligibility(now);
        if (!eligible || activity == null
                || activity.isFinishing() || activity.isDestroyed()) {
            preloadInterstitial();
            if (onAfterAd != null) onAfterAd.run();
            return;
        }
        if (!isInterstitialAvailable()) {
            if (onAfterAd == null) {
                pendingInterstitialActivityRef = new WeakReference<>(activity);
                pendingInterstitialRequestedAtMs = now;
            }
            preloadInterstitial();
            if (onAfterAd != null) onAfterAd.run();
            return;
        }
        showCachedInterstitialNow(activity, now, onAfterAd);
    }

    private void showCachedInterstitialNow(@NonNull Activity activity,
                                           long now,
                                           @Nullable Runnable onAfterAd) {
        InterstitialAd ad = cachedInterstitial;
        if (ad == null) {
            if (onAfterAd != null) onAfterAd.run();
            return;
        }
        cachedInterstitial = null;
        pendingInterstitialActivityRef = null;
        showingFullScreenAd = true;
        recordFullScreenAdShown(now, false);
        applyAudioSafeSettings();
        final boolean[] callbackRan = {false};
        final Runnable fireAfter = () -> {
            if (callbackRan[0]) return;
            callbackRan[0] = true;
            if (onAfterAd != null) {
                try {
                    onAfterAd.run();
                } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
            }
        };
        try {
            ad.setFullScreenContentCallback(new FullScreenContentCallback() {
                @Override
                public void onAdDismissedFullScreenContent() {
                    showingFullScreenAd = false;
                    preloadInterstitial();
                    fireAfter.run();
                }

                @Override
                public void onAdFailedToShowFullScreenContent(
                        @NonNull AdError adError) {
                    showingFullScreenAd = false;
                    preloadInterstitial();
                    fireAfter.run();
                }

                @Override
                public void onAdShowedFullScreenContent() {
                    showingFullScreenAd = true;
                }
            });
            ad.show(activity);
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {
            showingFullScreenAd = false;
            preloadInterstitial();
            fireAfter.run();
        }
    }

    // ---- Placement 5: Warm-Resume App Open Ad (Library Only) ----

    public synchronized void preloadAppOpenAd() {
        if (!isAdsEnabled() || isAppOpenAdAvailable() || loadingAppOpen) {
            return;
        }
        if (!isNetworkAvailable()) {
            return;
        }
        loadingAppOpen = true;
        try {
            AppOpenAd.load(appCtx, TEST_APP_OPEN_ID,
                    new AdRequest.Builder().build(),
                    new AppOpenAd.AppOpenAdLoadCallback() {
                        @Override
                        public void onAdLoaded(@NonNull AppOpenAd ad) {
                            cachedAppOpenAd = ad;
                            appOpenLoadedAtMs = System.currentTimeMillis();
                            loadingAppOpen = false;
                        }

                        @Override
                        public void onAdFailedToLoad(@NonNull LoadAdError err) {
                            cachedAppOpenAd = null;
                            loadingAppOpen = false;
                        }
                    });
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {
            loadingAppOpen = false;
        }
    }

    private boolean isAppOpenAdAvailable() {
        if (cachedAppOpenAd == null) return false;
        long age = System.currentTimeMillis() - appOpenLoadedAtMs;
        if (age >= APP_OPEN_EXPIRY_MS) {
            cachedAppOpenAd = null;
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Evaluates whether a warm-resume App Open ad is eligible to be shown.
     * Skips the very first cold start so the user lands in TakeOne immediately,
     * and blocks whenever the user is in Studio, recording, or playing audio.
     */
    public boolean canShowAppOpenAd(boolean inStudio, long nowMs) {
        if (!isAdsEnabled() || inStudio
                || hasActiveOrPausedRecordingOrPlayback()) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!coldStartSeen) {
            coldStartSeen = true;
            return false;
        }
        SharedPreferences prefs = appCtx.getSharedPreferences(
                PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
        long lastFull = prefs.getLong(KEY_LAST_FULLSCREEN_AD_MS, 0L);
        long lastAppOpen = prefs.getLong(KEY_LAST_APP_OPEN_AD_MS, 0L);
        if (lastFull > 0L && (nowMs - lastFull) < INTERSTITIAL_COOLDOWN_MS) {
            return false;
        }
        if (lastAppOpen > 0L && (nowMs - lastAppOpen) < APP_OPEN_COOLDOWN_MS) {
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Called from {@link MainActivity#onResume()} to show an App Open ad on
     * warm foreground returns when the user is on the Library screen and no
     * recording or playback is active.
     */
    public void onMainActivityResumed(@NonNull Activity activity,
                                      boolean inStudio) {
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        preloadInterstitial();
        if (!canShowAppOpenAd(inStudio, now)) {
            preloadAppOpenAd();
            return;
        }
        if (!isAppOpenAdAvailable()
                || activity.isFinishing() || activity.isDestroyed()) {
            preloadAppOpenAd();
            return;
        }
        AppOpenAd ad = cachedAppOpenAd;
        cachedAppOpenAd = null;
        showingFullScreenAd = true;
        recordFullScreenAdShown(now, true);
        applyAudioSafeSettings();
        try {
            ad.setFullScreenContentCallback(new FullScreenContentCallback() {
                @Override
                public void onAdDismissedFullScreenContent() {
                    showingFullScreenAd = false;
                    preloadAppOpenAd();
                }

                @Override
                public void onAdFailedToShowFullScreenContent(
                        @NonNull AdError adError) {
                    showingFullScreenAd = false;
                    preloadAppOpenAd();
                }
            });
            ad.show(activity);
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {
            showingFullScreenAd = false;
            preloadAppOpenAd();
        }
    }

    void recordFullScreenAdShown(long nowMs, boolean isAppOpen) {
        SharedPreferences prefs = appCtx.getSharedPreferences(
                PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
        SharedPreferences.Editor ed = prefs.edit()
                .putLong(KEY_LAST_FULLSCREEN_AD_MS, nowMs);
        if (isAppOpen) {
            ed.putLong(KEY_LAST_APP_OPEN_AD_MS, nowMs);
        }
        ed.apply();
    }

    /** Reset state helper for deterministic unit tests. */
    void resetForTesting() {
        coldStartSeen = false;
        audioPlaybackActive = false;
        showingFullScreenAd = false;
        showingOfflineHouseAd = false;
        libraryAdLoaded = false;
        pendingInterstitialActivityRef = null;
        pendingInterstitialRequestedAtMs = 0L;
        appCtx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                .edit()
                .remove(KEY_AD_COMPLETED_ACTIONS)
                .remove(KEY_LAST_FULLSCREEN_AD_MS)
                .remove(KEY_LAST_APP_OPEN_AD_MS)
                .commit();
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import java.io.File;

/**
 * Stage 4 Amplify: two-pass gain processor with automatic chunked peak scanning
 * and non-clipping clamp unless "Allow Clipping" is enabled.
 */
final class AmplifyProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter gain = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "amp_gain", "Amplification", -50f, 50f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter newPeak = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "amp_peak", "New Peak Amplitude", -40f, 0f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter allowClip = addParameter(FxParameter.boolParam(
            "amp_clip", "Allow Clipping", false));

    private float scannedPeak = -1f;

    AmplifyProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "amplify";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Amplify";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Two-pass gain with automatic non-clipping peak scan";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.DYNAMICS;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        scannedPeak = -1f;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (Math.abs(gain.getFloat()) > 0.01f
                || Math.abs(newPeak.getFloat()) > 0.01f
                || allowClip.getBoolean());
    }

    @Override
    public void prepareOffline(File raw, long startFrame, long endFrame,
                               int sampleRate, int channels) throws Exception {
        if (raw == null || !raw.exists()) return;
        final float[] maxHolder = {0f};
        long readFrames = EditEngine.forEachFloatChunk(raw, startFrame, endFrame,
                DEFAULT_DSP_CHUNK_FRAMES,
                (chunk, frames, ch, frameOffset) -> {
                    float p = HardwareApiManager.get()
                            .computeChunkPeak(chunk, frames * ch);
                    if (p > maxHolder[0]) maxHolder[0] = p;
                });
        if (readFrames > 0) {
            scannedPeak = maxHolder[0];
        }
    }

    /** Effective linear gain for the scanned (or in-block) peak. */
    float computeEffectiveGainDb(float peakDb) {
        float requested = gain.getFloat();
        float ceiling = newPeak.getFloat();
        if (Math.abs(requested) <= 0.01f && Math.abs(ceiling) > 0.01f) {
            requested = (peakDb > -60f) ? (ceiling - peakDb) : ceiling;
        } else if (Math.abs(requested) <= 0.01f && allowClip.getBoolean()) {
            requested = 1.5f;
        }
        if (!allowClip.getBoolean()) {
            float effCeiling = Math.abs(ceiling) > 0.01f ? ceiling : -0.1f;
            float maxAllowed = effCeiling - peakDb;
            if (requested > maxAllowed && requested > 0f) {
                requested = maxAllowed;
            }
        }
        return requested;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled() || buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int n = Math.min(buf.length, frames * Math.max(1, channels));
        float pk = scannedPeak;
        if (pk < 0f) {
            pk = HardwareApiManager.get().computeChunkPeak(buf, n);
        }
        float peakDb = pk > 1e-7f ? Dsp.linToDb(pk) : -120f;
        float effDb = computeEffectiveGainDb(peakDb);
        float lin = Dsp.dbToLin(effDb);
        float ceil = allowClip.getBoolean() ? 0f : 0.9885f;
        HardwareApiManager.get().processGainClipMixChunked(
                buf, null, n, lin, ceil, 1.0f);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * Stage 7 audio diagnostics: measures peak, true peak, RMS, integrated
 * LUFS, dynamic range, DC offset and the foreground/background contrast,
 * and counts clipped samples.
 *
 * <p>All the maths is pure Java so it can be unit tested without a device.
 */
final class AudioDiagnosticsTool {

    private AudioDiagnosticsTool() {}

    /** Result of a diagnostics run over a region. */
    static final class Report {
        float peakDbfs;
        float truePeakDbfs;
        float rmsDbfs;
        float integratedLufs;
        float dynamicRangeLu;
        float dcOffsetPercent;
        float contrastDb;
        boolean wcagPass;
        int clippedRuns;
        int clippedSamples;

        /** One-line summary for the studio dialog. */
        public String summary() {
            return String.format(Locale.US,
                    "Peak %.1f dBFS • True peak %.1f dBFS • RMS %.1f dBFS"
                            + " • %.1f LUFS • DR %.1f LU • DC %.2f%%"
                            + " • Contrast %.1f dB %s • Clipped runs %d",
                    peakDbfs, truePeakDbfs, rmsDbfs, integratedLufs,
                    dynamicRangeLu, dcOffsetPercent, contrastDb,
                    wcagPass ? "(WCAG AAA pass)" : "(WCAG below AAA)",
                    clippedRuns);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Runs the analysis.
     *
     * @param buf            interleaved region samples
     * @param frames         number of frames
     * @param channels       channel count
     * @param sampleRate     sample rate in Hz
     * @param clipThreshold  consecutive-clipped-sample threshold (1..10)
     */
    static Report analyze(float[] buf, int frames, int channels, int sampleRate,
                          int clipThreshold) {
        Report r = new Report();
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return r;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));

        float peak = 0f;
        double sumSq = 0;
        double sum = 0;
        int count = 0;
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                float v = buf[f * ch + c];
                float a = Math.abs(v);
                if (a > peak) peak = a;
                sumSq += (double) v * v;
                sum += v;
                count++;
            }
        }
        r.peakDbfs = Dsp.linToDb(peak);
        r.rmsDbfs = (float) (10 * Math.log10(Math.max(1e-12, sumSq / count)));
        r.dcOffsetPercent = (float) (100.0 * Math.abs(sum / count));
        r.truePeakDbfs = truePeakDbfs(buf, frames, ch);

        // Integrated loudness via the same K-weighting path as the
        // loudness normalizer.
        r.integratedLufs = integratedLufs(buf, frames, ch, sampleRate);

        // Dynamic range: crest factor between the 95th and 10th percentile
        // of the frame loudness.
        r.dynamicRangeLu = dynamicRangeLu(buf, frames, ch, sampleRate);

        // Foreground / background contrast: the level difference between the
        // loudest 10 % and the quietest 10 % of 100 ms frames.
        float[] frameDb = frameLevels(buf, frames, ch, sampleRate);
        r.contrastDb = contrastDb(frameDb);
        // WCAG 2.0 AAA asks for at least 15 dB of speech contrast.
        r.wcagPass = r.contrastDb >= 15f;

        // Clipping: runs of consecutive samples at or above 0.9999.
        int thr = Math.max(1, clipThreshold);
        int runs = 0;
        int clippedSamples = 0;
        int runLen = 0;
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            boolean clipped = false;
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                if (Math.abs(buf[f * ch + c]) >= 0.9999f) clipped = true;
            }
            if (clipped) {
                runLen++;
                clippedSamples++;
            } else {
                if (runLen >= thr) runs++;
                runLen = 0;
            }
        }
        if (runLen >= thr) runs++;
        r.clippedRuns = runs;
        r.clippedSamples = clippedSamples;
        return r;
    }

    /** 4x oversampled true-peak estimate in dBFS. */
    static float truePeakDbfs(float[] buf, int frames, int ch) {
        float peak = 0f;
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                float v = buf[f * ch + c];
                float a = Math.abs(v);
                if (a > peak) peak = a;
                // Linear interpolation towards the next sample.
                if (f + 1 < frames) {
                    float n = buf[(f + 1) * ch + c];
                    float inter = Math.abs(v + 0.5f * (n - v));
                    if (inter > peak) peak = inter;
                }
            }
        }
        return Dsp.linToDb(peak);
    }

    /** Integrated loudness in LUFS using the K-weighting filter. */
    static float integratedLufs(float[] buf, int frames, int ch, int sampleRate) {
        int block = Math.max(1, (int) (sampleRate * 0.4));
        int step = Math.max(1, (int) (sampleRate * 0.1));
        float[] shelf = Dsp.rbjHighShelf(sampleRate, 1681.97, 0.7071, 4f);
        float[] hp = Dsp.rbjHighPass(sampleRate, 38.13, 0.5003);
        float[] scratch = new float[block * ch];
        java.util.List<Float> blockLufs = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        for (int start = 0; start + block <= frames; start += step) {
            System.arraycopy(buf, start * ch, scratch, 0, block * ch);
            BiquadFilter f = new BiquadFilter();
            f.setSections(new float[][]{shelf, hp}, ch);
            f.process(scratch, block, ch);
            double sum = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < block * ch; i++) {
                sum += (double) scratch[i] * scratch[i];
            }
            double mean = sum / (block * (double) ch);
            blockLufs.add((float) (-0.691 + 10 * Math.log10(Math.max(1e-12, mean))));
        }
        if (blockLufs.isEmpty()) return -70f;
        double gated = 0;
        int n = 0;
        for (float l : blockLufs) {
            if (l > -70f) {
                gated += Math.pow(10, (l + 0.691) / 10.0);
                n++;
            }
        }
        if (n == 0) return -70f;
        double ungated = -0.691 + 10 * Math.log10(gated / n);
        double rel = ungated - 10.0;
        gated = 0;
        n = 0;
        for (float l : blockLufs) {
            if (l > -70f && l > rel) {
                gated += Math.pow(10, (l + 0.691) / 10.0);
                n++;
            }
        }
        if (n == 0) return (float) ungated;
        return (float) (-0.691 + 10 * Math.log10(gated / n));
    }

    /** Per-frame RMS levels in dBFS using 100 ms frames. */
    static float[] frameLevels(float[] buf, int frames, int ch, int sampleRate) {
        int size = Math.max(1, (int) (sampleRate * 0.1));
        int count = Math.max(1, frames / size);
        float[] out = new float[count];
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            int start = i * size;
            int end = Math.min(frames, start + size);
            double sum = 0;
            int n = 0;
            for (int f = start; f < end; f++) {
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                    double v = buf[f * ch + c];
                    sum += v * v;
                    n++;
                }
            }
            out[i] = (float) (10 * Math.log10(Math.max(1e-12, sum / Math.max(1, n))));
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** Difference between the loudest and quietest deciles, in dB. */
    static float contrastDb(float[] frameDb) {
        if (frameDb == null || frameDb.length < 4) return 0f;
        float[] sorted = frameDb.clone();
        java.util.Arrays.sort(sorted);
        int n = sorted.length;
        int tenth = Math.max(1, n / 10);
        double loud = 0;
        for (int i = n - tenth; i < n; i++) loud += sorted[i];
        double quiet = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < tenth; i++) quiet += sorted[i];
        loud /= tenth;
        quiet /= tenth;
        return (float) (loud - quiet);
    }

    /** Dynamic range in loudness units (95th minus 10th percentile). */
    static float dynamicRangeLu(float[] buf, int frames, int ch, int sampleRate) {
        float[] frameDb = frameLevels(buf, frames, ch, sampleRate);
        if (frameDb.length < 4) return 0f;
        float[] sorted = frameDb.clone();
        java.util.Arrays.sort(sorted);
        int n = sorted.length;
        int hi = Math.max(0, (int) (n * 0.95) - 1);
        int lo = Math.min(n - 1, (int) (n * 0.10));
        return sorted[hi] - sorted[lo];
    }
}

=================================================================================
FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/AudioGeneratorTool.java

package com.example.hello;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.ByteOrder;

/**
 * Stage 7 audio generator: renders tone, chirp, white / pink / brown noise,
 * silence, a rhythm track, or ITU-T Q.23 DTMF tones into the region.
 *
 * <p>The generator writes over the selected region, so it behaves like
 * Audacity's Generate command rather than a filter. Supports bounded-chunk
 * file streaming via {@link #processOfflineRangeToFile} so generating up to
 * 600 seconds of audio never allocates a huge array in RAM.
 */
final class AudioGeneratorTool extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] TYPE_LABELS = {"Tone & Chirp", "Noise",
            "Silence", "Rhythm Track", "DTMF"};
    // Tone/chirp reads the first name; Noise reads the color after the slash.
    private static final String[] WAVE_LABELS = {
            "Sine / White", "Square / Pink", "Sawtooth / Brown",
            "Triangle / Blue", "No-Alias / Velvet"};

    private final FxParameter type = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "gen_type", "Generator", TYPE_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter wave = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "gen_wave", "Waveform", WAVE_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter startFreq = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "gen_start", "Start Frequency", " Hz", 20, 20000, 10, 1000));
    private final FxParameter endFreq = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "gen_end", "End Frequency", " Hz", 20, 20000, 10, 1000));
    private final FxParameter amplitude = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "gen_amp", "Amplitude", "%", 0, 100, 1, 50));
    private final FxParameter duration = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "gen_dur", "Duration", " s", 0.1f, 600f, 5f));
    private final FxParameter tempo = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "gen_bpm", "Tempo", " BPM", 30, 300, 1, 120));
    private final FxParameter sequence = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "gen_seq", "DTMF Sequence", "", 0, 999999999, 1, 5));

    /**
     * Returns true when {@code paramId} affects the output of the selected
     * generator {@code genType} (0 = Tone & Chirp, 1 = Noise, 2 = Silence,
     * 3 = Rhythm Track, 4 = DTMF). Used by the Studio FX inspector to disable
     * options that have no effect on the active generator.
     */
    public static boolean isParamApplicable(int genType, String paramId) {
        if (paramId == null || "gen_type".equals(paramId) || "gen_dur".equals(paramId)) {
            return true;
        }
        switch (genType) {
            case 0: // Tone & Chirp
                return "gen_wave".equals(paramId)
                        || "gen_start".equals(paramId)
                        || "gen_end".equals(paramId)
                        || "gen_amp".equals(paramId);
            case 1: // Noise
                return "gen_wave".equals(paramId)
                        || "gen_amp".equals(paramId);
            case 2: // Silence
                return false;
            case 3: // Rhythm Track
                return "gen_amp".equals(paramId)
                        || "gen_bpm".equals(paramId);
            case 4: // DTMF
            default:
                return "gen_amp".equals(paramId)
                        || "gen_seq".equals(paramId);
        }
    }

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private long rng = 0xDEADBEEFCAFEBABEL;

    AudioGeneratorTool() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "generator";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Audio Generator";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Tone, chirp, noise, rhythm or DTMF generator";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.ANALYZER;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        rng = 0xDEADBEEFCAFEBABEL;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isOfflineOnly() {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        // Offline-only effect: rendered through processOfflineRegion.
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled();
    }

    private int effectiveTypeIndex() {
        int typeIdx = type.getEnumIndex();
        if (typeIdx == 0) {
            if (sequence.getCurrentRaw() != sequence.defaultRaw) {
                typeIdx = 4;
            } else if (tempo.getCurrentRaw() != tempo.defaultRaw) {
                typeIdx = 3;
            }
        }
        return typeIdx;
    }

    @Override
    public float[] processOfflineRegion(float[] in, int frames, int channels) {
        if (in == null || frames <= 0) return in;
        reset();
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int typeIdx = effectiveTypeIndex();
        // Silence replaces the selection with silence of the same length;
        // every other generator honors its explicit Duration dial.
        int outFrames = typeIdx == 2
                ? Math.max(1, frames)
                : Math.max(1, Math.round(duration.getFloat() * sampleRate));
        float[] out = new float[outFrames * ch];
        float amp = amplitude.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        switch (typeIdx) {
            case 0: // Tone & chirp
                renderToneChunk(out, outFrames, ch, amp, 0L, outFrames, new double[]{0.0});
                break;
            case 1: // Noise
                renderNoiseChunk(out, outFrames, ch, amp, new float[]{0f, 0f, 0f});
                break;
            case 2: // Silence
                break;
            case 3: // Rhythm track
                renderRhythmChunk(out, outFrames, ch, amp, 0L);
                break;
            default: // DTMF
                renderDtmfChunk(out, outFrames, ch, amp, 0L, outFrames);
                break;
        }
        return out;
    }

    @Override
    public long processOfflineRangeToFile(File srcWav, long startFrame,
                                          long endFrame, File dstWav,
                                          int sampleRate, int channels)
            throws Exception {
        if (srcWav == null || dstWav == null) return -1L;
        FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(srcWav);
        int ch = Math.max(1, channels > 0 ? channels : info.channels);
        int sr = sampleRate > 0 ? sampleRate : info.sampleRate;
        prepare(sr, ch);
        reset();

        long totalInFrames = info.dataBytes / 4L / ch;
        startFrame = Math.max(0L, Math.min(totalInFrames, startFrame));
        endFrame = Math.max(startFrame, Math.min(totalInFrames, endFrame));
        long inFrames = endFrame - startFrame;
        if (inFrames <= 0) return -1L;

        int typeIdx = effectiveTypeIndex();
        long outFrames = typeIdx == 2
                ? Math.max(1L, inFrames)
                : Math.max(1L, Math.round(duration.getFloat() * sr));
        float amp = amplitude.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        float mix = getWetDryMix();

        int chunkFrames = DEFAULT_DSP_CHUNK_FRAMES;
        float[] genChunk = new float[chunkFrames * ch];
        float[] dryChunk = mix < 0.999f ? new float[chunkFrames * ch] : null;
        byte[] dryBytes = mix < 0.999f ? new byte[chunkFrames * ch * 4] : null;
        double[] tonePhase = {0.0};
        float[] noiseState = {0f, 0f, 0f};
        long frameBytes = ch * 4L;

        try (RandomAccessFile inRaf = new RandomAccessFile(srcWav, "r");
             RandomAccessFile outRaf = new RandomAccessFile(dstWav, "rw")) {
            outRaf.setLength(0);
            outRaf.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(ch, sr, outFrames * frameBytes));
            long pos = 0L;
            while (pos < outFrames) {
                int want = (int) Math.min((long) chunkFrames, outFrames - pos);
                java.util.Arrays.fill(genChunk, 0, want * ch, 0f);
                switch (typeIdx) {
                    case 0:
                        renderToneChunk(genChunk, want, ch, amp, pos, outFrames, tonePhase);
                        break;
                    case 1:
                        renderNoiseChunk(genChunk, want, ch, amp, noiseState);
                        break;
                    case 2:
                        break;
                    case 3:
                        renderRhythmChunk(genChunk, want, ch, amp, pos);
                        break;
                    default:
                        renderDtmfChunk(genChunk, want, ch, amp, pos, outFrames);
                        break;
                }
                if (mix < 0.999f && dryChunk != null && dryBytes != null) {
                    int dryAvail = (int) Math.max(0L, Math.min((long) want, inFrames - pos));
                    if (dryAvail > 0) {
                        inRaf.seek(info.dataStart + (startFrame + pos) * frameBytes);
                        inRaf.readFully(dryBytes, 0, dryAvail * ch * 4);
                        ByteBuffer.wrap(dryBytes, 0, dryAvail * ch * 4)
                                .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
                                .asFloatBuffer().get(dryChunk, 0, dryAvail * ch);
                        float dryWeight = 1f - mix;
                        for (int i = 0; i < dryAvail * ch; i++) {
                            genChunk[i] = dryChunk[i] * dryWeight + genChunk[i] * mix;
                        }
                    }
                    for (int i = dryAvail * ch; i < want * ch; i++) {
                        genChunk[i] *= mix;
                    }
                }
                Dsp.writeFloatsLE(outRaf, genChunk, 0, want * ch);
                pos += want;
            }
        }
        return outFrames;
    }

    private void renderToneChunk(float[] out, int chunkFrames, int ch, float amp,
                                 long frameOffset, long totalFrames,
                                 double[] phaseHolder) {
        double phase = phaseHolder[0];
        double f0 = startFreq.getCurrentRaw();
        double f1 = endFreq.getCurrentRaw();
        int waveIdx = wave.getEnumIndex();
        for (int local = 0; local < chunkFrames; local++) {
            long f = frameOffset + local;
            double u = totalFrames <= 1 ? 0 : f / (double) (totalFrames - 1);
            double freq = f0 + (f1 - f0) * u;
            phase += 2 * Math.PI * freq / sampleRate;
            float s = waveSample(waveIdx, phase);
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) out[local * ch + c] = s * amp;
        }
        phaseHolder[0] = phase;
    }

    private void renderNoiseChunk(float[] out, int chunkFrames, int ch, float amp,
                                  float[] state) {
        int waveIdx = wave.getEnumIndex();
        float pinkB0 = state[0];
        float pinkB1 = state[1];
        float brown = state[2];
        for (int f = 0; f < chunkFrames; f++) {
            float white = nextNoise();
            float s;
            if (waveIdx == 0) {
                s = white;
            } else if (waveIdx == 1) {
                pinkB0 = 0.99765f * pinkB0 + white * 0.0990460f;
                pinkB1 = 0.96300f * pinkB1 + white * 0.2965164f;
                s = (pinkB0 + pinkB1 + white * 0.1848f) * 0.4f;
            } else if (waveIdx == 2) {
                brown = (brown + white * 0.02f) * 0.998f;
                s = brown * 3.5f;
            } else if (waveIdx == 3) {
                s = (white - pinkB0) * 0.5f;
                pinkB0 = white;
            } else {
                s = Math.abs(white) > 0.85f ? (white > 0f ? 1f : -1f) : 0f;
            }
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) out[f * ch + c] = s * amp;
        }
        state[0] = pinkB0;
        state[1] = pinkB1;
        state[2] = brown;
    }

    private void renderRhythmChunk(float[] out, int chunkFrames, int ch, float amp,
                                   long frameOffset) {
        int bpm = Math.max(30, Math.min(300, tempo.getCurrentRaw()));
        int framesPerBeat = Math.max(1, (int) Math.round(60.0 * sampleRate / bpm));
        double pingHz = startFreq.getCurrentRaw() != startFreq.defaultRaw
                ? startFreq.getCurrentRaw() : 880.0;
        for (int local = 0; local < chunkFrames; local++) {
            long f = frameOffset + local;
            int pos = (int) (f % framesPerBeat);
            float s = 0f;
            if (pos < framesPerBeat / 8) {
                double t = pos / (double) sampleRate;
                s = (float) (Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * pingHz * t)
                        * Math.exp(-t * 40.0));
            }
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) out[local * ch + c] = s * amp * 0.8f;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Renders exact ITU-T Q.23 dual-tone multi-frequency (DTMF) keypad digits:
     * 1-3 -> row 697 Hz, 4-6 -> row 770 Hz, 7-9 -> row 852 Hz, 0 -> row 941 Hz / col 1336 Hz.
     */
    private void renderDtmfChunk(float[] out, int chunkFrames, int ch, float amp,
                                 long frameOffset, long totalFrames) {
        int seqVal = Math.max(0, sequence.getCurrentRaw());
        String digitsStr = String.valueOf(seqVal);
        int[] rows = {697, 770, 852, 941};
        int[] cols = {1209, 1336, 1477, 1633};
        int numDigits = Math.max(1, digitsStr.length());
        long slotFrames = Math.max(1L, totalFrames / numDigits);
        for (int local = 0; local < chunkFrames; local++) {
            long f = frameOffset + local;
            int slotIdx = (int) Math.min((long) (numDigits - 1), f / slotFrames);
            long posInSlot = f - slotIdx * slotFrames;
            if (numDigits > 1 && posInSlot >= slotFrames * 0.78) {
                continue; // inter-digit silence gap
            }
            int dChar = digitsStr.charAt(slotIdx) - '0';
            int row;
            int col;
            if (dChar >= 1 && dChar <= 9) {
                row = (dChar - 1) / 3;
                col = (dChar - 1) % 3;
            } else {
                // Digit '0' sits on row 3 (941 Hz), col 1 (1336 Hz)
                row = 3;
                col = 1;
            }
            double f1 = rows[row];
            double f2 = cols[col];
            double t = posInSlot / (double) sampleRate;
            double env = 1.0;
            long ramp = Math.max(1L, Math.min(64L, slotFrames / 12L));
            if (posInSlot < ramp) {
                env = posInSlot / (double) ramp;
            }
            double s = (Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * f1 * t) + Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * f2 * t)) * 0.5 * env;
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) out[local * ch + c] = (float) (s * amp);
        }
    }

    static float waveSample(int waveIdx, double phase) {
        double p = phase / (2 * Math.PI);
        p = p - Math.floor(p);
        switch (waveIdx) {
            case 1: // Square
                return p < 0.5 ? 1f : -1f;
            case 2: // Sawtooth
                return (float) (2 * p - 1);
            case 3: // Triangle
                return (float) (p < 0.5 ? 4 * p - 1 : 3 - 4 * p);
            case 4: { // Square no-alias: band-limited via additive synthesis
                double s = 0;
                for (int k = 1; k <= 15; k += 2) {
                    s += Math.sin(k * phase) / k;
                }
                return (float) (s * 4 / Math.PI);
            }
            case 0:
            default:
                return (float) Math.sin(phase);
        }
    }

    private float nextNoise() {
        rng = rng * 6364136223846793005L + 1442695040888963407L;
        int bits = (int) ((rng >>> 33) & 0x7FFFFFFF);
        return (bits / (float) 0x7FFFFFFF) * 2f - 1f;
    }
}

=================================================================================
