    /** Premade templates of effects and their settings for the Presets dropdown. */
    public enum Preset {
        CUSTOM("custom", "Custom Rack"),
        VOICE_POLISH("voice_polish", "Voice Polish (Default Pro)"),
        PODCAST_BROADCAST("podcast", "Podcast Broadcast Master"),
        NOISY_ROOM("noisy_room", "Noisy Room Cleanup"),
        WARM_VOCAL("warm_vocal", "Warm Studio Vocal"),
        CRISP_CLARITY("crisp", "Crisp Articulation"),
        CLEAR_ALL("clear", "Flat / No Effects");

        public final String id;
        public final String title;

        Preset(String id, String title) {
            this.id = id;
            this.title = title;
        }
    }

    /** One effect pill in the user's scrollable FX rack. */
    public static final class EffectSlot {
        public final EffectType type;
        /**
         * Stable identity of this rack entry, so the same effect can be
         * inserted twice and each copy keeps its own processor, parameters
         * and learned profile. Persisted with the slot.
         */
        public final long instanceId;
        /** Checkmark state: only applied when enabled == true. */
        public boolean enabled;
        /** Current parameter setting (e.g. 0..100% or 40..160 Hz). */
        public int value;
        /** UI state: whether the collapsible settings drawer is expanded. */
        public boolean expanded;
        /** Per-slot wet/dry mix, 0..1 (1 = fully wet, the legacy default). */
        public float wetDry = 1f;
        /**
         * Secondary processor parameters persisted per slot, keyed by
         * {@link FxParameter#id} (Stage 3+ effects; the legacy stages have
         * only their primary knob, so this stays empty for them).
         */
        public final Map<String, Integer> extraParams = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        /**
         * Learned noise power spectrum (linear, one value per FFT bin) for the
         * Noise Suppression Pro stage; null means adaptive estimation. Captured
         * from a noise-only waveform selection and persisted with the slot.
         */
        public float[] noiseProfile;

        /** Monotonic source of unique rack-entry identities. */
        private static final java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong
                NEXT_INSTANCE_ID = new java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong(1);

        public EffectSlot(EffectType type, boolean enabled, int value, boolean expanded) {
            this(type, enabled, value, expanded, NEXT_INSTANCE_ID.getAndIncrement());
        }

        public EffectSlot(EffectType type, boolean enabled, int value,
                          boolean expanded, long instanceId) {
            this.type = type;
            this.enabled = enabled;
            this.value = Math.max(type.minVal, Math.min(type.maxVal, value));
            this.expanded = expanded;
            this.instanceId = instanceId;
        }
    }

    /** Configuration holding both the Pro EffectSlot list and legacy fields. */
    public static final class Config {
        public static final int MODE_OFF = 0;
        public static final int MODE_NOISE_SUPPRESSION = 1;
        public static final int MODE_CUSTOM = 2;

        public int mode = MODE_OFF;
        public boolean hpfEnabled = false;
        public int hpfCutoffHz = 80;
        public int noisePct = 0;
        public int deEssPct = 0;
        public int compPct = 0;
        public int presencePct = 0;
        public int warmthPct = 0;
        public int gatePct = 0;
        public int limiterPct = 0;

        public boolean customHpf = true;
        public int customNoisePct = 35;
        public int customDeEssPct = 30;
        public int customCompPct = 30;

        public String activePresetId = Preset.CLEAR_ALL.id;
        public final List<EffectSlot> slots = new ArrayList<>();

        public Config() {
            syncSlotsFromLegacyFields();
        }

        public Config(boolean hpf, int noise, int deEss, int comp) {
            this.hpfEnabled = hpf;
            this.hpfCutoffHz = 80;
            this.noisePct = clamp(noise);
            this.deEssPct = clamp(deEss);
            this.compPct = clamp(comp);
            if (!isActive()) {
                this.mode = MODE_OFF;
            } else if (hpf && this.noisePct == 50
                    && this.deEssPct == 45 && this.compPct == 40) {
                this.mode = MODE_NOISE_SUPPRESSION;
            } else {
                this.mode = MODE_CUSTOM;
                this.customHpf = hpf;
                this.customNoisePct = this.noisePct;
                this.customDeEssPct = this.deEssPct;
                this.customCompPct = this.compPct;
            }
            syncSlotsFromLegacyFields();
        }

        /** Populates the rack with a premade template of effects and settings. */
        public void applyPreset(Preset preset) {
            slots.clear();
            activePresetId = preset.id;
            switch (preset) {
                case VOICE_POLISH:
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.LOW_CUT_HPF, true, 80, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.NOISE_SUPPRESSION, true, 50, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.DE_ESSER, true, 45, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.COMPRESSOR, true, 40, false));
                    break;
                case PODCAST_BROADCAST:
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.LOW_CUT_HPF, true, 90, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.NOISE_SUPPRESSION, true, 45, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.ROOM_GATE, true, 40, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.WARMTH_BODY, true, 45, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.VOCAL_PRESENCE, true, 35, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.DE_ESSER, true, 50, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.COMPRESSOR, true, 55, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.BRICKWALL_LIMITER, true, 55, false));
                    break;
                case NOISY_ROOM:
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.LOW_CUT_HPF, true, 110, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.NOISE_SUPPRESSION, true, 80, true));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.ROOM_GATE, true, 55, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.DE_ESSER, true, 40, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.COMPRESSOR, true, 35, false));
                    break;
                case WARM_VOCAL:
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.LOW_CUT_HPF, true, 70, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.WARMTH_BODY, true, 55, true));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.VOCAL_PRESENCE, true, 35, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.DE_ESSER, true, 40, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.COMPRESSOR, true, 45, false));
                    break;
                case CRISP_CLARITY:
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.LOW_CUT_HPF, true, 90, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.NOISE_SUPPRESSION, true, 35, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.VOCAL_PRESENCE, true, 65, true));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.DE_ESSER, true, 55, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.COMPRESSOR, true, 45, false));
                    break;
                case CLEAR_ALL:
                    break;
                case CUSTOM:
                default:
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.NOISE_SUPPRESSION, true, customNoisePct, true));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.DE_ESSER, true, customDeEssPct, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.COMPRESSOR, true, customCompPct, false));
                    break;
            }
            syncLegacyFieldsFromSlots();
        }

        /**
         * Adds a rack entry for {@code type}.
         *
         * <p>Every modern effect gets its own slot, so the same effect can be
         * inserted twice (or more) and each copy keeps its own parameters,
         * wet/dry mix and learned profile.
         *
         * <p>The eight legacy voice-chain stages are the exception: they are
         * one fixed percentage chain, so a second copy of one of them would
         * fight over the same shared field. Adding a legacy stage therefore
         * focuses the existing entry instead.
         */
        public EffectSlot addOrFocusSlot(EffectType type) {
            EffectSlot created = new EffectSlot(type, true, type.defaultVal, true);
            slots.add(created);
            activePresetId = Preset.CUSTOM.id;
            syncLegacyFieldsFromSlots();
            return created;
        }

        public void removeSlot(EffectSlot slot) {
            slots.remove(slot);
            activePresetId = Preset.CUSTOM.id;
            syncLegacyFieldsFromSlots();
        }

        /**
         * Empties the rack after Apply FX so the next edit starts from a clean
         * slate. The audio already carries the baked chain; keeping the slots
         * enabled would let a later preview or save process those samples a
         * second time.
         */
        public void clearRack() {
            slots.clear();
            activePresetId = Preset.CLEAR_ALL.id;
            syncLegacyFieldsFromSlots();
            mode = MODE_OFF;
        }

        /** Disables the whole rack and returns the config to a clean state. */
        public void resetAll() {
            clearRack();
        }

        public void syncLegacyFieldsFromSlots() {
            hpfEnabled = false;
            hpfCutoffHz = 80;
            noisePct = 0;
            deEssPct = 0;
            compPct = 0;
            presencePct = 0;
            warmthPct = 0;
            gatePct = 0;
            limiterPct = 0;
            java.util.Set<EffectType> seenLegacy = new java.util.HashSet<>();
            for (EffectSlot s : slots) {
                if (!s.enabled || s.wetDry <= 0.001f) continue;
                // The canonical legacy processor binds to the first slot of
                // each type; a later duplicate must not overwrite its value.
                if (s.type.isLegacyStage() && !seenLegacy.add(s.type)) continue;
                switch (s.type) {
                    case LOW_CUT_HPF:
                        hpfEnabled = s.value > 0;
                        hpfCutoffHz = Math.max(40, Math.min(160, s.value));
                        break;
                    case NOISE_SUPPRESSION:
                        noisePct = clamp(s.value);
                        break;
                    case DE_ESSER:
                        deEssPct = clamp(s.value);
                        break;
                    case COMPRESSOR:
                        compPct = clamp(s.value);
                        break;
                    case VOCAL_PRESENCE:
                        presencePct = clamp(s.value);
                        break;
                    case WARMTH_BODY:
                        warmthPct = clamp(s.value);
                        break;
                    case ROOM_GATE:
                        gatePct = clamp(s.value);
                        break;
                    case BRICKWALL_LIMITER:
                        limiterPct = clamp(s.value);
                        break;
                }
            }
            boolean anyStage3Active = false;
            for (EffectSlot s : slots) {
                if (s != null && s.enabled && s.type != null
                        && !s.type.isLegacyStage() && s.wetDry > 0.001f
                        && isStage3SlotAudible(s)) {
                    anyStage3Active = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!isActive()) {
                mode = MODE_OFF;
            } else if (!anyStage3Active && hpfEnabled && hpfCutoffHz == 80
                    && noisePct == 50 && deEssPct == 45 && compPct == 40
                    && presencePct == 0 && warmthPct == 0 && gatePct == 0 && limiterPct == 0) {
                mode = MODE_NOISE_SUPPRESSION;
            } else {
                mode = MODE_CUSTOM;
            }
        }

        private void syncSlotsFromLegacyFields() {
            Map<EffectType, Integer> activeValues =
                    new LinkedHashMap<>();
            if (hpfEnabled) {
                activeValues.put(EffectType.LOW_CUT_HPF,
                        Math.max(40, Math.min(160, hpfCutoffHz)));
            }
            if (noisePct > 0) {
                activeValues.put(EffectType.NOISE_SUPPRESSION, noisePct);
            }
            if (gatePct > 0) {
                activeValues.put(EffectType.ROOM_GATE, gatePct);
            }
            if (warmthPct > 0) {
                activeValues.put(EffectType.WARMTH_BODY, warmthPct);
            }
            if (presencePct > 0) {
                activeValues.put(EffectType.VOCAL_PRESENCE, presencePct);
            }
            if (deEssPct > 0) {
                activeValues.put(EffectType.DE_ESSER, deEssPct);
            }
            if (compPct > 0) {
                activeValues.put(EffectType.COMPRESSOR, compPct);
            }
            if (limiterPct > 0) {
                activeValues.put(EffectType.BRICKWALL_LIMITER, limiterPct);
            }

            List<EffectSlot> previous = new ArrayList<>(slots);
            slots.clear();
            // Preserve the user's relative ordering, bypassed (unchecked)
            // pills, and per-slot wetDry/extraParams for every slot already
            // in the rack. Modern effects keep every copy: two slots of the
            // same effect are two independent rack entries.
            java.util.Set<EffectType> seenLegacy = new java.util.HashSet<>();
            for (EffectSlot kept : previous) {
                if (kept == null || kept.type == null) continue;
                if (kept.type.isLegacyStage() && seenLegacy.add(kept.type)) {
                    Integer val = activeValues.remove(kept.type);
                    if (val != null) {
                        kept.enabled = true;
                        kept.value = Math.max(kept.type.minVal,
                                Math.min(kept.type.maxVal, val));
                    } else {
                        kept.enabled = false;
                    }
                }
                slots.add(kept);
            }
            // Append any newly enabled legacy stages in canonical stage order.
            for (Map.Entry<EffectType, Integer> e : activeValues.entrySet()) {
                EffectType t = e.getKey();
                int val = e.getValue();
                slots.add(new EffectSlot(t, true, val, false));
            }
        }

        public void applyMode(int targetMode) {
            if (targetMode == MODE_OFF) {
                this.mode = MODE_OFF;
                this.hpfEnabled = false;
                this.noisePct = 0;
                this.deEssPct = 0;
                this.compPct = 0;
                this.presencePct = 0;
                this.warmthPct = 0;
                this.gatePct = 0;
                this.limiterPct = 0;
                for (EffectSlot s : slots) s.enabled = false;
            } else if (targetMode == MODE_NOISE_SUPPRESSION) {
                this.mode = MODE_NOISE_SUPPRESSION;
                this.hpfEnabled = true;
                this.hpfCutoffHz = 80;
                this.noisePct = 50;
                this.deEssPct = 45;
                this.compPct = 40;
                this.presencePct = 0;
                this.warmthPct = 0;
                this.gatePct = 0;
                this.limiterPct = 0;
                for (EffectSlot s : slots) {
                    if (s != null && s.type != null && !s.type.isLegacyStage()) {
                        s.enabled = false;
                    }
                }
                syncSlotsFromLegacyFields();
            } else {
                this.mode = MODE_CUSTOM;
                if (!customHpf && customNoisePct <= 0
                        && customDeEssPct <= 0 && customCompPct <= 0) {
                    customHpf = true;
                    customNoisePct = 35;
                    customDeEssPct = 30;
                    customCompPct = 30;
                }
                this.hpfEnabled = customHpf;
                this.noisePct = clamp(customNoisePct);
                this.deEssPct = clamp(customDeEssPct);
                this.compPct = clamp(customCompPct);
                syncSlotsFromLegacyFields();
            }
        }

        public void onManualAdjustment() {
            onManualAdjustment(hpfEnabled, noisePct, deEssPct, compPct);
        }

        public void onManualAdjustment(boolean hpf, int noise, int deEss, int comp) {
            this.hpfEnabled = hpf;
            this.noisePct = clamp(noise);
            this.deEssPct = clamp(deEss);
            this.compPct = clamp(comp);
            if (!isActive()) {
                this.mode = MODE_OFF;
            } else {
                this.mode = MODE_CUSTOM;
                this.customHpf = this.hpfEnabled;
                this.customNoisePct = this.noisePct;
                this.customDeEssPct = this.deEssPct;
                this.customCompPct = this.compPct;
            }
            syncSlotsFromLegacyFields();
        }

        /**
         * True when both {@link EffectType#WARMTH_BODY} and
         * {@link EffectType#VOCAL_PRESENCE} are enabled in the rack at once.
         */
        public boolean hasBothToneSlotsEnabled() {
            boolean w = false;
            boolean p = false;
            for (EffectSlot s : slots) {
                if (s == null || !s.enabled || s.value <= 0
                        || s.wetDry <= 0.001f) continue;
                if (s.type == EffectType.WARMTH_BODY) w = true;
                if (s.type == EffectType.VOCAL_PRESENCE) p = true;
            }
            return w && p;
        }

        public boolean isActive() {
            if (hpfEnabled || noisePct > 0 || deEssPct > 0 || compPct > 0
                    || presencePct > 0 || warmthPct > 0 || gatePct > 0
                    || limiterPct > 0) {
                return true;
            }
            for (EffectSlot s : slots) {
                if (s != null && s.enabled && s.type != null && s.wetDry > 0.001f) {
                    if (s.type.isLegacyStage()) {
                        if (!s.extraParams.isEmpty() && isProcessorAudible(s)) {
                            return true;
                        }
                    } else if (isStage3SlotAudible(s)) {
                        return true;
                    }
                }
            }
            return false;
        }

        /**
         * True when a slot's current parameters actually alter the signal.
         * Untouched neutral defaults (0 dB gain, flat bands) return false,
         * while any non-default primary or secondary parameter adjustment that
         * makes the processor audible returns true.
         */
        private static boolean isStage3SlotAudible(EffectSlot s) {
            switch (s.type) {
                case PARAMETRIC_EQ6:
                    if (s.value != 0) return true;
                    if (s.extraParams.getOrDefault("b1f", 80) > 20) return true;
                    if (s.extraParams.getOrDefault("b6f", 20000) < 20000) return true;
                    if (s.extraParams.getOrDefault("b2g", 0) != 0
                            || s.extraParams.getOrDefault("b3g", 0) != 0
                            || s.extraParams.getOrDefault("b4g", 0) != 0
                            || s.extraParams.getOrDefault("b5g", 0) != 0) {
                        return true;
                    }
                    return isProcessorAudible(s);
                case GRAPHIC_EQ:
                    if (s.value != 0) return true;
                    for (int i = 0; i < 31; i++) {
                        if (s.extraParams.getOrDefault("g" + i, 0) != 0) return true;
                    }
                    return isProcessorAudible(s);
                case FILTER_CURVE_EQ:
                    if (s.value != 0) return true;
                    for (int i = 0; i < FilterCurveEqProcessor.MAX_NODES; i++) {
                        if (s.extraParams.getOrDefault("pg" + i, 0) != 0) return true;
                    }
                    return isProcessorAudible(s);
                case BASS_TREBLE:
                    if (s.value != 0 || s.extraParams.getOrDefault("vol", 0) != 0) {
                        return true;
                    }
                    boolean linked = s.extraParams.getOrDefault("link", 0) != 0;
                    return linked || s.extraParams.getOrDefault("treble", 0) != 0;
                case SHELF_FILTER:
                    return s.value != 0 || isProcessorAudible(s);
                default:
                    return isProcessorAudible(s);
            }
        }

        /**
         * Asks the effect's own processor whether its current settings would
         * change the audio. A newly added effect sitting on its neutral
         * defaults (0 dB gain, 0 % depth, ...) must not count as an active
         * stage, otherwise the rack would look armed before the user touched
         * anything.
         */
        private static boolean isProcessorAudible(EffectSlot s) {
            AudioProcessor p = FxRackChain.createProcessor(s.type.id);
            if (p == null) return true;
            p.setEnabled(s.enabled);
            String primaryId = primaryParamId(s.type);
            if (primaryId != null) {
                FxParameter fp = p.getParam(primaryId);
                if (fp != null) fp.setCurrentRaw(s.value);
            }
            for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> e : s.extraParams.entrySet()) {
                FxParameter fp = p.getParam(e.getKey());
                if (fp != null) fp.setCurrentRaw(e.getValue());
            }
            return p.isAudible();
        }

        public int enabledSlotCount() {
            int n = 0;
            for (EffectSlot s : slots) {
                if (s.enabled && s.wetDry > 0.001f
                        && (s.value > 0 || !s.type.isLegacyStage())) n++;
            }
            return n;
        }

        public String badgeSummary() {
            if (!isActive() || mode == MODE_OFF) return "FX Off";
            boolean anyStage3Active = false;
            for (EffectSlot s : slots) {
                if (s != null && s.enabled && s.type != null
                        && !s.type.isLegacyStage()) {
                    anyStage3Active = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!anyStage3Active && (mode == MODE_NOISE_SUPPRESSION
                    || (hpfEnabled && hpfCutoffHz == 80
                    && noisePct == 50 && deEssPct == 45 && compPct == 40
                    && presencePct == 0 && warmthPct == 0 && gatePct == 0 && limiterPct == 0))) {
                return "FX • Polish";
            }
            return "FX • Custom";
        }

        public static Config voicePolish() {
            Config c = new Config(true, 50, 45, 40);
            c.mode = MODE_NOISE_SUPPRESSION;
            return c;
        }

        public static Config load(Context ctx) {
            Config c = new Config();
            if (ctx == null) return c;
            try {
                SharedPreferences p = ctx.getSharedPreferences("takeone",
                        Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
                c.hpfEnabled = p.getBoolean("dsp_hpf", false);
                c.hpfCutoffHz = Math.max(40, Math.min(160, p.getInt("dsp_hpf_hz", 80)));
                c.noisePct = clamp(p.getInt("dsp_noise", 0));
                c.deEssPct = clamp(p.getInt("dsp_deess", 0));
                c.compPct = clamp(p.getInt("dsp_comp", 0));
                c.customHpf = p.getBoolean("dsp_custom_hpf", true);
                c.customNoisePct = clamp(p.getInt("dsp_custom_noise", 35));
                c.customDeEssPct = clamp(p.getInt("dsp_custom_deess", 30));
                c.customCompPct = clamp(p.getInt("dsp_custom_comp", 30));
                String slotsJson = p.getString("dsp_slots_json", null);
                c.activePresetId = p.getString("dsp_preset_id",
                        slotsJson != null ? Preset.CLEAR_ALL.id : Preset.VOICE_POLISH.id);
                if (slotsJson != null) {
                    c.slots.clear();
                    JSONArray arr = new JSONArray(slotsJson);
                    for (int i = 0; i < arr.length(); i++) {
                        JSONObject o = arr.getJSONObject(i);
                        EffectType t = EffectType.byId(o.optString("id", "noise"));
                        boolean en = o.optBoolean("en", true);
                        int val = o.optInt("val", t.defaultVal);
                        boolean exp = o.optBoolean("exp", false);
                        long iid = o.optLong("iid", 0L);
                        EffectSlot slot = iid > 0
                                ? new EffectSlot(t, en, val, exp, iid)
                                : new EffectSlot(t, en, val, exp);
                        slot.wetDry = Math.max(0f, Math.min(1f,
                                (float) o.optDouble("mix", 1.0)));
                        JSONObject pj = o.optJSONObject("params");
                        if (pj != null) {
                            java.util.Iterator<String> keys = pj.keys();
                            while (keys.hasNext()) {
                                String k = keys.next();
                                slot.extraParams.put(k, pj.optInt(k));
                            }
                        }
                        slot.noiseProfile = NoiseSuppressionProcessor
                                .profileFromJson(o.optJSONArray("prof"));
                        c.slots.add(slot);
                    }
                    c.syncLegacyFieldsFromSlots();
                } else {
                    c.syncSlotsFromLegacyFields();
                    if (c.slots.isEmpty()) {
                        // Seed default starter pills for the UI rack with Voice Polish enabled
                        c.slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.NOISE_SUPPRESSION, true, 50, false));
                        c.slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.DE_ESSER, true, 45, false));
                        c.slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.COMPRESSOR, true, 40, false));
                        c.slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.LOW_CUT_HPF, true, 80, false));
                        c.activePresetId = Preset.VOICE_POLISH.id;
                        c.syncLegacyFieldsFromSlots();
                    }
                }
                int savedMode = p.getInt("dsp_mode", -1);
                if (savedMode >= MODE_OFF && savedMode <= MODE_CUSTOM) {
                    c.mode = savedMode;
                    if (!c.isActive()) c.mode = MODE_OFF;
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            return c;
        }

        public void save(Context ctx) {
            if (ctx == null) return;
            try {
                JSONArray arr = new JSONArray();
                for (EffectSlot s : slots) {
                    JSONObject o = new JSONObject();
                    o.put("id", s.type.id);
                    o.put("iid", s.instanceId);
                    o.put("en", s.enabled);
                    o.put("val", s.value);
                    o.put("exp", s.expanded);
                    o.put("mix", (double) s.wetDry);
                    if (!s.extraParams.isEmpty()) {
                        JSONObject p = new JSONObject();
                        for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> e
                                : s.extraParams.entrySet()) {
                            p.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue());
                        }
                        o.put("params", p);
                    }
                    if (s.noiseProfile != null && s.noiseProfile.length > 0) {
                        o.put("prof", NoiseSuppressionProcessor
                                .profileToJson(s.noiseProfile));
                    }
                    arr.put(o);
                }
                ctx.getSharedPreferences("takeone", Context.MODE_PRIVATE).edit()
                        .putInt("dsp_mode", mode)
                        .putBoolean("dsp_hpf", hpfEnabled)
                        .putInt("dsp_hpf_hz", hpfCutoffHz)
                        .putInt("dsp_noise", clamp(noisePct))
                        .putInt("dsp_deess", clamp(deEssPct))
                        .putInt("dsp_comp", clamp(compPct))
                        .putBoolean("dsp_custom_hpf", customHpf)
                        .putInt("dsp_custom_noise", clamp(customNoisePct))
                        .putInt("dsp_custom_deess", clamp(customDeEssPct))
                        .putInt("dsp_custom_comp", clamp(customCompPct))
                        .putString("dsp_preset_id", activePresetId)
                        .putString("dsp_slots_json", arr.toString())
                        .apply();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }

        private static int clamp(int v) {
            return Math.max(0, Math.min(100, v));
        }
    }

    private final int channels;
    private final FxRackChain rack;

    public DspChain(int channels, Config cfg) {
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        this.rack = FxRackChain.fromLegacyConfig(this.channels, cfg);
        ensureRackSlots(cfg);
        rack.applyLegacyConfig(cfg);
        applySlotExtras(cfg);
    }

    /**
     * The modular processor rack backing this chain (Stage 2 architecture).
     * The legacy engine's eight stages are now {@link AudioProcessor}s in an
     * ordered rack; this chain is a backwards-compatible facade.
     */
    /** Processor id after which the second tone stage runs (split mode). */
    String getSplitToneAfterId() {
        return rack.getSplitToneAfterId();
    }

    public FxRackChain getRack() {
        return rack;
    }

    public void updateConfig(Config cfg) {
        resetProcessorSlotExtras();
        ensureRackSlots(cfg);
        rack.applyLegacyConfig(cfg);
        applySlotExtras(cfg);
    }

    /**
     * Creates or drops rack processors so every non-legacy slot owns exactly
     * one processor and deleted slots leave no orphan behind.
     *
     * <p>Processors are matched by the slot's instance key, so the same
     * effect can sit in the rack twice with independent parameters. Runs
     * before {@code applyLegacyConfig} so slot order can include them.
     */
    private void ensureRackSlots(Config cfg) {
        if (cfg == null) return;
        java.util.Set<String> wanted = new java.util.HashSet<>();
        java.util.Set<EffectType> firstLegacy = new java.util.HashSet<>();
        for (EffectSlot s : cfg.slots) {
            if (s == null || s.type == null) continue;
            if (s.type.isLegacyStage() && firstLegacy.add(s.type)) {
                continue;
            }
            String pid = FxRackChain.processorIdForSlotType(s.type);
            if (pid == null) continue;
            String key = slotInstanceKey(s);
            wanted.add(key);
            int idx = rack.indexOfInstance(key, null);
            AudioProcessor p = idx >= 0 ? rack.getProcessor(idx) : null;
            if (p == null) {
                p = FxRackChain.createProcessor(pid);
                if (p == null) continue;
                p.setInstanceKey(key);
                rack.addProcessor(p);
            }
            if (p != null) p.setEnabled(s.enabled);
        }
        for (int i = rack.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            AudioProcessor p = rack.getProcessor(i);
            if (p == null) continue;
            String key = p.getInstanceKey();
            if (key == null) continue;
            if (!wanted.contains(key)) rack.removeProcessor(i);
        }
    }

    /** Stable instance key of a rack entry, used to bind it to a processor. */
    static String slotInstanceKey(EffectSlot s) {
        return "slot:" + s.type.id + ":" + s.instanceId;
    }

    /**
     * Resets per-slot wet/dry mixes and secondary parameters on all rack
     * processors before applying the active {@link Config} so removed or
     * reset slots never leave stale state behind.
     */
    private void resetProcessorSlotExtras() {
        for (AudioProcessor p : rack.processors()) {
            p.setWetDryMix(1.0f);
            if (p instanceof ProToneProcessor) {
                ((ProToneProcessor) p).setWarmthSlotMix(1.0f);
                ((ProToneProcessor) p).setPresenceSlotMix(1.0f);
            }
            if (p instanceof NoiseSuppressionProcessor) {
                ((NoiseSuppressionProcessor) p).setNoiseProfile(null);
            }
            if (p instanceof SpectralNoiseReductionProcessor) {
                ((SpectralNoiseReductionProcessor) p).setNoiseProfile(null);
            }
            for (FxParameter fp : p.getParameters()) {
                if (!isPrimaryLegacyParam(fp.id)
                        && !isStage3PrimaryParam(p.getId(), fp.id)) {
                    fp.resetToDefault();
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private static boolean isPrimaryLegacyParam(String paramId) {
        return "amt".equals(paramId)
                || "cutoff".equals(paramId)
                || "drive".equals(paramId)
                || "warmth".equals(paramId)
                || "presence".equals(paramId);
    }

    private static boolean isStage3PrimaryParam(String procId, String paramId) {
        if (procId == null || paramId == null) return false;
        return paramId.equals(primaryParamId(EffectType.byId(procId)));
    }

    /**
     * Pushes per-slot wet/dry mixes and any persisted secondary parameters
     * into the rack. Warmth and Presence each carry their own slot mix into
     * the shared tone processor, so the two halves honour separate wet/dry
     * values whether they run combined or split around another effect.
     */
    private void applySlotExtras(Config cfg) {
        if (cfg == null) return;
        boolean bothToneEnabled = cfg.hasBothToneSlotsEnabled();
        for (DspChain.EffectSlot s : cfg.slots) {
            AudioProcessor p = processorForSlot(s);
            if (p == null) continue;
            if (s.type == EffectType.WARMTH_BODY
                    || s.type == EffectType.VOCAL_PRESENCE) {
                if (p instanceof ProToneProcessor) {
                    if (s.type == EffectType.WARMTH_BODY) {
                        ((ProToneProcessor) p).setWarmthSlotMix(s.wetDry);
                    } else {
                        ((ProToneProcessor) p).setPresenceSlotMix(s.wetDry);
                    }
                }
                if (!bothToneEnabled && s.enabled && s.value > 0) {
                    p.setWetDryMix(s.wetDry);
                }
            } else if (s.type != EffectType.BRICKWALL_LIMITER || s.enabled) {
                // When the Brickwall Limiter slot is unchecked, it may still
                // run as the automatic safety ceiling for upstream gain
                // stages; keep its mix at 100% when disabled so an unchecked
                // slot's mix never weakens safety limiting.
                p.setWetDryMix(s.wetDry);
            }
            if (s.type == EffectType.NOISE_SUPPRESSION
                    && p instanceof NoiseSuppressionProcessor) {
                ((NoiseSuppressionProcessor) p).setNoiseProfile(
                        s.noiseProfile);
            }
            if (s.type == EffectType.SPECTRAL_NOISE_REDUCTION
                    && p instanceof SpectralNoiseReductionProcessor) {
                ((SpectralNoiseReductionProcessor) p).setNoiseProfile(
                        s.noiseProfile);
            }
            if (!s.type.isLegacyStage() || p.getInstanceKey() != null) {
                p.setEnabled(s.enabled);
                if (s.type.isLegacyStage()) {
                    configureLegacySlotProcessor(p, s);
                } else {
                    FxParameter fp = p.getParam(primaryParamId(s.type));
                    if (fp != null) fp.setCurrentRaw(s.value);
                }
            }
            String primaryId = primaryParamId(s.type);
            for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> e : s.extraParams.entrySet()) {
                String key = e.getKey();
                if (isPrimaryLegacyParam(key)) continue;
                if (primaryId != null && primaryId.equals(key)) continue;
                FxParameter fp = p.getParam(key);
                if (fp != null) fp.setCurrentRaw(e.getValue());
            }
            if (s.type.isLegacyStage() && p.getInstanceKey() == null
                    && s.enabled && !s.extraParams.isEmpty()) {
                if (s.type == EffectType.BRICKWALL_LIMITER && p instanceof ProLimiterProcessor) {
                    boolean hasExtra = s.extraParams.getOrDefault("limiter_ceiling", -20) < -25
                            || s.extraParams.getOrDefault("limiter_release", 80) != 80;
                    if (hasExtra) p.setEnabled(true);
                } else {
                    p.setEnabled(true);
                }
            }
            p.prepare(rack.getSampleRate(), channels);
        }
    }

    /** Processor parameter driven by the slot card's main dial. */
    static String primaryParamId(EffectType type) {
        if (type == null) return null;
        switch (type) {
            case NOISE_SUPPRESSION:
            case DE_ESSER:
            case COMPRESSOR:
            case ROOM_GATE:
                return "amt";
            case LOW_CUT_HPF:
                return "cutoff";
            case VOCAL_PRESENCE:
                return "presence";
            case WARMTH_BODY:
                return "warmth";
            case BRICKWALL_LIMITER:
                return "drive";
            case PARAMETRIC_EQ6:
            case GRAPHIC_EQ:
            case FILTER_CURVE_EQ:
                return "out";
            case BASS_TREBLE:
                return "bass";
            case HIGH_PASS_FILTER:
            case LOW_PASS_FILTER:
            case NOTCH_FILTER:
            case CLASSIC_FILTERS:
                return "freq";
            case SHELF_FILTER:

    /**
     * The processor that serves a rack entry.
     *
     * <p>The legacy stages are a fixed chain, so they share one processor
     * each. Every other effect is bound to its own rack entry by instance
     * key, which is what lets the same effect appear in the rack twice.
     */
    static void configureLegacySlotProcessor(AudioProcessor p, EffectSlot s) {
        if (p == null || s == null || s.type == null) return;
        switch (s.type) {
            case LOW_CUT_HPF:
                if (p instanceof ProHpfProcessor) {
                    ((ProHpfProcessor) p).setLegacyState(
                            s.enabled && s.value > 0,
                            Math.max(40, Math.min(160, s.value)));
                }
                break;
            case NOISE_SUPPRESSION:
                if (p instanceof NoiseSuppressionProcessor) {
                    ((NoiseSuppressionProcessor) p).setLegacyAmount(s.value);
                    p.setEnabled(s.enabled && s.value > 0);
                }
                break;
            case ROOM_GATE:
                if (p instanceof ProGateProcessor) {
                    ((ProGateProcessor) p).setLegacyAmount(s.value);
                    p.setEnabled(s.enabled && s.value > 0);
                }
                break;
            case WARMTH_BODY:
                if (p instanceof ProToneProcessor) {
                    ((ProToneProcessor) p).setLegacyAmounts(s.value, 0);
                    ((ProToneProcessor) p).setWarmthSlotMix(s.wetDry);
                    p.setEnabled(s.enabled && s.value > 0);
                }
                break;
            case VOCAL_PRESENCE:
                if (p instanceof ProToneProcessor) {
                    ((ProToneProcessor) p).setLegacyAmounts(0, s.value);
                    ((ProToneProcessor) p).setPresenceSlotMix(s.wetDry);
                    p.setEnabled(s.enabled && s.value > 0);
                }
                break;
            case DE_ESSER:
                if (p instanceof ProDeEsserProcessor) {
                    ((ProDeEsserProcessor) p).setLegacyAmount(s.value);
                    p.setEnabled(s.enabled && s.value > 0);
                }
                break;
            case COMPRESSOR:
                if (p instanceof ProCompressorProcessor) {
                    ((ProCompressorProcessor) p).setLegacyAmount(s.value);
                    p.setEnabled(s.enabled && s.value > 0);
                }
                break;
            case BRICKWALL_LIMITER:
                if (p instanceof ProLimiterProcessor) {
                    ((ProLimiterProcessor) p).setLegacyState(s.value, false);
                    boolean hasExtra = s.extraParams.getOrDefault("limiter_ceiling", -20) < -25
                            || s.extraParams.getOrDefault("limiter_release", 80) != 80;
                    p.setEnabled(s.enabled && (s.value > 0 || hasExtra));
                }
                break;
            default:
                break;
        }
    }

    private AudioProcessor processorForSlot(EffectSlot slot) {
        if (slot == null || slot.type == null) return null;
        EffectType type = slot.type;
        String key = slotInstanceKey(slot);
        int instIdx = rack.indexOfInstance(key, null);
        if (instIdx >= 0) return rack.getProcessor(instIdx);
        switch (type) {
            case LOW_CUT_HPF:
                return rack.getProcessor(rack.indexOf("hpf"));
            case NOISE_SUPPRESSION:
                return rack.getProcessor(rack.indexOf("noise"));
            case ROOM_GATE:
                return rack.getProcessor(rack.indexOf("gate"));
            case DE_ESSER:
                return rack.getProcessor(rack.indexOf("deess"));
            case COMPRESSOR:
                return rack.getProcessor(rack.indexOf("comp"));
            case BRICKWALL_LIMITER:
                return rack.getProcessor(rack.indexOf("limiter"));
            case WARMTH_BODY:
            case VOCAL_PRESENCE:
                return rack.getProcessor(rack.indexOf("tone"));
            default: {
                String pid = FxRackChain.processorIdForSlotType(type);
                if (pid == null) return null;
                int idx = rack.indexOfInstance(key, pid);
                return idx >= 0 ? rack.getProcessor(idx) : null;
            }
        }
    }

    public boolean isActive() {
        return rack.isActive();
    }

    public void reset() {
        rack.reset();
    }

    /** Total algorithmic latency (frames) of the active rack. */
    public int getLatencyFrames() {
        return rack.getLatencyFrames();
    }

    /**
     * The catalog category an effect belongs to. Derived from the
     * registered processor so the "+ Add Effect" dialog can group the whole
     * catalog without a second hand-maintained table.
     */
    public static FxCategory categoryOf(EffectType type) {
        if (type == null) return FxCategory.EQUALIZER;
        AudioProcessor p = FxRackChain.getPrototypeProcessor(type.id);
        if (p != null) return p.getCategory();
        // Legacy stages share a handful of processors.
        switch (type) {
            case NOISE_SUPPRESSION:
            case ROOM_GATE:
            case DE_ESSER:
                return FxCategory.RESTORATION;
            case COMPRESSOR:
            case BRICKWALL_LIMITER:
                return FxCategory.DYNAMICS;
            case LOW_CUT_HPF:
            case VOCAL_PRESENCE:
            case WARMTH_BODY:
                return FxCategory.EQUALIZER;
            default:
                return FxCategory.EQUALIZER;
        }
    }

    /** Longest tail (frames) reported by any enabled processor. */
    public int getTailFrames() {
        return rack.getTailFrames();
    }

    /**
     * Runs the two-pass analysis hook on every enabled processor so the
     * level tools can measure the exact range that is about to be rendered.
     */
    public void prepareOffline(File raw, long startFrame, long endFrame,
                               int sampleRate, int channels) throws Exception {
        rack.prepareOffline(raw, startFrame, endFrame, sampleRate, channels);
    }

    /** The first enabled processor that renders its region offline. */
    public AudioProcessor findOfflineProcessor() {
        for (AudioProcessor p : rack.processors()) {
            if (!p.isEnabled()) continue;
            if (!p.isOfflineOnly()) continue;
            if (!p.isAudible() || p.getWetDryMix() <= 0.001f) continue;
            return p;
        }
        return null;
    }

    /** Every enabled processor that renders its region offline, in order. */
    public java.util.List<AudioProcessor> offlineProcessors() {
        java.util.List<AudioProcessor> out = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        for (AudioProcessor p : rack.processors()) {
            if (!p.isEnabled() || !p.isOfflineOnly()
                    || !p.isAudible() || p.getWetDryMix() <= 0.001f) continue;
            out.add(p);
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** True when the rack still has processors that run in place. */
    public boolean hasInPlaceProcessors() {
        for (AudioProcessor p : rack.processors()) {
            if (!p.isEnabled() || p.isOfflineOnly()) continue;
            if (p.isAudible()) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Disables every offline processor so the remaining chain can be applied
     * in place over a region that an offline effect already rewrote.
     */
    public void clearOfflineProcessors() {
        for (AudioProcessor p : rack.processors()) {
            if (p.isOfflineOnly()) p.setEnabled(false);
        }
    }

    public void setSampleRate(int sampleRate) {
        rack.setSampleRate(sampleRate);
    }

    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames) {
        rack.processInPlace(buf, frames);
    }

    /**
     * Renders an entire region through both offline processors (such as
     * Change Speed and Pitch, Change Tempo, Change Pitch, Audio Generator,
     * Fade, Timeline Utility, Truncate Silence, Paulstretch, Sliding Stretch)
     * and the in-place processor chain in rack order, returning the processed
     * interleaved buffer.
     */
    /**
     * Chunked file-to-file region renderer: runs all active offline processors
     * and in-place processors over {@code [startFrame, endFrame)} of {@code raw},
     * writing the resulting 32-bit float WAV region into {@code outRegionWav}
     * without allocating full-take arrays in RAM.
     *
     * @return the number of output frames written to {@code outRegionWav}, or -1
     *         on failure.
     */
    public long renderRegionToFile(File raw, long startFrame, long endFrame,
                                   int sampleRate, File outRegionWav)
            throws Exception {
        if (raw == null || !raw.exists() || outRegionWav == null) return -1L;
        FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(raw);
        int ch = Math.max(1, info.channels);
        int sr = sampleRate > 0 ? sampleRate : info.sampleRate;
        setSampleRate(sr);
        long totalFrames = info.dataBytes / 4L / ch;
        startFrame = Math.max(0L, Math.min(totalFrames, startFrame));
        endFrame = Math.max(startFrame, Math.min(totalFrames, endFrame));
        long curFrames = endFrame - startFrame;
        if (curFrames <= 0) return -1L;

        java.util.List<AudioProcessor> offProcs = offlineProcessors();
        File curIn = raw;
        long curStart = startFrame;
        long curEnd = endFrame;
        File tempPrev = null;

        try {
            for (int i = 0; i < offProcs.size(); i++) {
                AudioProcessor proc = offProcs.get(i);
                float mix = proc.getWetDryMix();
                if (mix <= 0.001f) continue;
                boolean isLastOffline = (i == offProcs.size() - 1);
                File stepOut = isLastOffline
                        ? outRegionWav
                        : new File(outRegionWav.getParentFile(),
                                outRegionWav.getName() + ".step" + i);
                long written = proc.processOfflineRangeToFile(
                        curIn, curStart, curEnd, stepOut, sr, ch);
                if (tempPrev != null && tempPrev.exists()) {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    tempPrev.delete();
                    tempPrev = null;
                }
                if (written <= 0) {
                    if (stepOut != outRegionWav && stepOut.exists()) {
                        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                        stepOut.delete();
                    }
                    return -1L;
                }
                curIn = stepOut;
                curStart = 0L;
                curEnd = written;
                curFrames = written;
                if (stepOut != outRegionWav) {
                    tempPrev = stepOut;
                }
            }

            if (curIn != outRegionWav) {
                // No audible offline processors ran; stream-copy [startFrame, endFrame) to outRegionWav
                long frameBytes = ch * 4L;
                long copyBytes = curFrames * frameBytes;
                byte[] copyBuf = new byte[65536];
                try (java.io.RandomAccessFile inRaf = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(raw, "r");
                     java.io.RandomAccessFile outRaf = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(outRegionWav, "rw")) {
                    outRaf.setLength(0);
                    outRaf.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(ch, sr, copyBytes));
                    inRaf.seek(info.dataStart + startFrame * frameBytes);
                    long left = copyBytes;
                    while (left > 0) {
                        int want = (int) Math.min((long) copyBuf.length, left);
                        int n = inRaf.read(copyBuf, 0, want);
                        if (n <= 0) break;
                        outRaf.write(copyBuf, 0, n);
                        left -= n;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (hasInPlaceProcessors() && curFrames > 0) {
                reset();
                prepareOffline(outRegionWav, 0L, curFrames, sr, ch);
                int chunk = AudioProcessor.DEFAULT_DSP_CHUNK_FRAMES;
                byte[] rawBuf = new byte[chunk * ch * 4];
                float[] block = new float[chunk * ch];
                java.nio.ByteBuffer bb = java.nio.ByteBuffer.wrap(rawBuf)
                        .order(java.nio.ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
                long frameBytes = ch * 4L;
                try (java.io.RandomAccessFile raf =
                             new java.io.RandomAccessFile(outRegionWav, "rw")) {
                    long off = 0L;
                    while (off < curFrames) {
                        int n = (int) Math.min((long) chunk, curFrames - off);
                        long bytePos = 44L + off * frameBytes;
                        raf.seek(bytePos);
                        raf.readFully(rawBuf, 0, n * ch * 4);
                        bb.clear();
                        bb.limit(n * ch * 4);
                        bb.asFloatBuffer().get(block, 0, n * ch);
                        rack.processInPlace(block, n);
                        bb.clear();
                        bb.asFloatBuffer().put(block, 0, n * ch);
                        raf.seek(bytePos);
                        raf.write(rawBuf, 0, n * ch * 4);
                        off += n;
                    }
                }
            }
            return curFrames;
        } finally {
            if (tempPrev != null && tempPrev.exists()) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                tempPrev.delete();
            }
        }
    }

    public float[] renderRegionOfflineAndInPlace(File raw, long startFrame,
                                                 long endFrame, int sampleRate)
            throws Exception {
        if (raw == null || !raw.exists()) return null;
        if (sampleRate > 0) setSampleRate(sampleRate);
        if (endFrame - startFrame > AudioProcessor.MAX_IN_MEMORY_OFFLINE_FRAMES) {
            File tmp = new File(raw.getParentFile(),
                    raw.getName() + ".offline_region_tmp");
            try {
                long outFrames = renderRegionToFile(
                        raw, startFrame, endFrame, sampleRate, tmp);
                if (outFrames <= 0) return new float[0];
                long capFrames = Math.min(outFrames,
                        AudioProcessor.MAX_IN_MEMORY_OFFLINE_FRAMES * 4L);
                return EditEngine.readFloatSelection(tmp, 0L, capFrames);
            } finally {
                if (tmp.exists()) {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    tmp.delete();
                }
            }
        }
        float[] buf = EditEngine.readFloatSelection(raw, startFrame, endFrame);
        if (buf == null || buf.length == 0) return buf;
        int curFrames = buf.length / Math.max(1, channels);
        for (AudioProcessor proc : offlineProcessors()) {
            float mix = proc.getWetDryMix();
            if (mix <= 0.001f) continue;
            proc.prepare(sampleRate, channels);
            float[] next = proc.processOfflineRegion(buf, curFrames, channels);
            if (next != null && next.length > 0) {
                if (mix < 0.999f) {
                    float dryWeight = 1f - mix;
                    int common = Math.min(buf.length, next.length);
                    for (int i = 0; i < common; i++) {
                        next[i] = buf[i] * dryWeight + next[i] * mix;
                    }
                    for (int i = common; i < next.length; i++) {
                        next[i] *= mix;
                    }
                }
                buf = next;
                curFrames = buf.length / Math.max(1, channels);
            }
        }
        if (hasInPlaceProcessors() && curFrames > 0) {
            reset();
            // Do not pre-scan the raw file if an offline processor (such as
            // Audio Generator or Fade) already replaced the in-memory buffer;
            // level tools will measure the actual in-memory buffer on first pass.
            if (offlineProcessors().isEmpty()) {
                prepareOffline(raw, startFrame, endFrame, sampleRate, channels);
            }
            int chunk = 4096;
            float[] block = new float[chunk * channels];
            for (int off = 0; off < curFrames; off += chunk) {
                int n = Math.min(chunk, curFrames - off);
                System.arraycopy(buf, off * channels, block, 0, n * channels);
                rack.processInPlace(block, n);
                System.arraycopy(block, 0, buf, off * channels, n * channels);
            }
        }
        return buf;
    }

    public static float fastLinToDb(float x) {
        if (x <= 1e-7f) return -140.0f;
        int bits = Float.floatToRawIntBits(x);
        int exp = ((bits >>> 23) & 0xFF) - 127;
        float m = Float.intBitsToFloat((bits & 0x007FFFFF) | 0x3F800000);
        float log2m = -0.34484843f * m * m + 2.02466578f * m - 1.67487759f;
        return (exp + log2m) * 6.0205999f;
    }

    public static float fastDbToLin(float db) {
        if (db <= -140.0f) return 0.0f;
        if (db > 36.0f) db = 36.0f;
        float p = db * 0.16609640f;
        int exp = (int) Math.floor(p);
        float f = p - exp;
        float mant = 0.33971f * f * f + 0.66029f * f + 1.0f;
        int bits = Float.floatToRawIntBits(mant);
        bits += (exp << 23);
        return Float.intBitsToFloat(bits);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Shared envelope / level-detection helpers for the Stage 4 dynamics suite
 * (compressor, gate, limiter, de-esser, ducking).
 *
 * <p>Every detector here works in the log domain so attack and release times
 * behave the way an engineer expects: the ballistics are one-pole filters on
 * the dB value, not on the linear amplitude.
 */
final class DynamicsDetector {

    private DynamicsDetector() {}

    /**
     * One-pole attack/release envelope follower in dB.
     *
     * <p>The detector keeps the loudest recent peak (a "peak hold" with a slow
     * decay) so short transients still trigger the compressor, while the
     * release ballistics shape how fast the gain comes back.
     */
    static final class Envelope {
        private float envDb = -120f;
        private float holdDb = -120f;
        private final int sampleRate;

        Envelope(int sampleRate) {
            this.sampleRate = Math.max(1000, sampleRate);
        }

        void reset() {
            envDb = -120f;
            holdDb = -120f;
        }

        float currentDb() {
            return envDb;
        }

        float peakDb() {
            return holdDb;
        }

        /**
         * Feeds one block of interleaved frames and returns the detector
         * level in dB (max over channels for peak mode, RMS across the block
         * for RMS mode).
         */
        float detect(float[] buf, int frames, int channels, boolean rms,
                     float attackMs, float releaseMs) {
            return detect(buf, 0, frames, channels, rms, attackMs, releaseMs);
        }

        /**
         * Feeds one block of interleaved frames starting at {@code frameOffset}
         * and returns the detector level in dB.
         */
        float detect(float[] buf, int frameOffset, int frames, int channels,
                     boolean rms, float attackMs, float releaseMs) {
            int n = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
            float blockDb = -120f;
            if (rms) {
                double sum = 0;
                int count = 0;
                for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
                    int idx = (frameOffset + f) * n;
                    if (idx + n > buf.length) break;
                    for (int c = 0; c < n; c++) {
                        sum += (double) buf[idx + c] * buf[idx + c];
                        count++;
                    }
                }
                if (count > 0) {
                    float rmsLin = (float) Math.sqrt(sum / count);
                    blockDb = Dsp.linToDb(rmsLin);
                }
            } else {
                float peak = 0f;
                for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
                    int idx = (frameOffset + f) * n;
                    if (idx + n > buf.length) break;
                    for (int c = 0; c < n; c++) {
                        float a = Math.abs(buf[idx + c]);
                        if (a > peak) peak = a;
                    }
                }
                blockDb = Dsp.linToDb(peak);
            }
            // The ballistics are per-sample coefficients, but the detector
            // runs on blocks: scale them by the block length so the attack
            // and release times are independent of the block size.
            float att = blockCoeff(attackMs, frames);
            float rel = blockCoeff(releaseMs, frames);
            if (blockDb > envDb) {
                envDb += att * (blockDb - envDb);
            } else {
                envDb += rel * (blockDb - envDb);
            }
            if (envDb > holdDb) {
                holdDb = envDb;
            } else {
                holdDb += 0.0008f * (envDb - holdDb);
            }
            return envDb;
        }

        /** Attack coefficient for a given time constant in milliseconds. */
        float coeff(float ms) {
            double sec = Math.max(0.0005, ms * 0.001);
            return (float) (1.0 - Math.exp(-1.0 / (sec * sampleRate)));
        }

        /**
         * The same coefficient, scaled to a block of {@code frames} samples.
         * Applying the per-sample coefficient once per block would make the
         * ballistics roughly {@code frames} times too slow.
         */
        float blockCoeff(float ms, int frames) {
            double sec = Math.max(0.0005, ms * 0.001);
            double samples = sec * sampleRate;
            return (float) (1.0 - Math.exp(-(double) Math.max(1, frames)
                    / samples));
        }
    }

    /**
     * Soft-knee gain computer in dB, the classic Fairlight/Audacity shape.
     *
     * @param overDb    input level minus threshold, in dB
     * @param ratio     compression ratio (1 = transparent)
     * @param kneeDb    width of the soft knee
     * @return gain reduction in dB (negative)
     */
    static float softKneeGainDb(float overDb, float ratio, float kneeDb) {
        if (ratio <= 1.0001f) return 0f;
        float slope = 1f - 1f / ratio;
        if (kneeDb <= 0f) {
            return overDb <= 0f ? 0f : -slope * overDb;
        }
        float half = kneeDb * 0.5f;
        if (overDb <= -half) return 0f;
        if (overDb >= half) return -slope * overDb;
        // Quadratic knee interpolation between the two straight lines.
        float x = overDb + half;
        return -slope * x * x / (2f * kneeDb);
    }

    /**
     * Downward expander gain in dB: below {@code thresholdDb} the signal is
     * attenuated toward {@code rangeDb} using {@code ratio}.
     */
    static float expanderGainDb(float levelDb, float thresholdDb,
                                float rangeDb, float ratio) {
        if (levelDb >= thresholdDb) return 0f;
        float over = thresholdDb - levelDb;
        float slope = 1f - 1f / Math.max(1.0001f, ratio);
        float reduction = -slope * over;
        return Math.max(rangeDb, reduction);
    }

    /**
     * Zero-order-hold peak follower with a hold timer, used by the gate's
     * hysteresis state machine.
     */
    static final class PeakHold {
        private float peakDb = -120f;
        private int holdFrames = 0;
        private int holdCounter = 0;

        void reset() {
            peakDb = -120f;
            holdCounter = 0;
        }

        float currentDb() {
            return peakDb;
        }

        boolean inHold() {
            return holdCounter > 0;
        }

        /** Updates the peak and returns the level used for detection. */
        float update(float blockDb, int frames, float holdMs, int sampleRate) {
            if (blockDb > peakDb) {
                peakDb = blockDb;
                holdCounter = (int) (holdMs * 0.001 * sampleRate);
            } else {
                if (holdCounter > 0) {
                    holdCounter -= frames;
                } else {
                    peakDb = blockDb;
                }
            }
            return peakDb;
        }
    }

    /** Converts a linear amplitude into the dBFS domain with a sane floor. */
    static float toDb(float lin) {
        return Dsp.linToDb(lin);
    }

    /** Converts dBFS into a linear amplitude. */
    static float toLin(float db) {
        return Dsp.dbToLin(db);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import android.annotation.SuppressLint;
import android.content.Context;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.graphics.Path;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewParent;

/**
 * Fairlight-style interactive dynamics canvas: draws the input-vs-output
 * transfer curve of the compressor (threshold, ratio slope, soft knee and
 * noise-floor freeze) plus a live gain-reduction meter, and lets the user
 * drag the threshold / ratio handle directly on the graph.
 */
final class DynamicsGraphView extends View {

    private final DspChain.EffectSlot slot;
    private final Runnable onMutated;
    private final float density;
    private final Paint grid = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final Paint curve = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final Paint knee = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final Paint grBar = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final Paint grTrack = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final Paint text = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final Path path = new Path();
    private boolean dragging = false;

    private static final float DB_MIN = -60f;
    private static final float DB_MAX = 0f;

    DynamicsGraphView(Context ctx, DspChain.EffectSlot slot) {
        this(ctx, slot, null);
    }

    DynamicsGraphView(Context ctx, DspChain.EffectSlot slot, Runnable onMutated) {
        super(ctx);
        this.slot = slot;
        this.onMutated = onMutated;
        this.density = getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density;
        setBackgroundColor(0xFF10141B);
        setMinimumHeight(Math.round(150 * density));
        grid.setColor(0xFF232B36);
        grid.setStrokeWidth(Math.max(1f, density));
        curve.setColor(0xFF4EA1FF);
        curve.setStrokeWidth(Math.max(2f, 2f * density));
        curve.setStyle(Paint.Style.STROKE);
        knee.setColor(0xFFFFB020);
        knee.setStrokeWidth(Math.max(1.5f, 1.5f * density));
        knee.setStyle(Paint.Style.FILL_AND_STROKE);
        grTrack.setColor(0xFF1A2029);
        grBar.setColor(0xFFFF4D4F);
        text.setColor(0xFF8A93A0);
        text.setTextSize(9.5f * density);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onAttachedToWindow() {
        super.onAttachedToWindow();
        FxTelemetry.attachView();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDetachedFromWindow() {
        FxTelemetry.detachView();
        super.onDetachedFromWindow();
    }

    private int extra(String key, int def) {
        Integer v = slot.extraParams.get(key);
        return v == null ? def : v;
    }

    private float xForDb(float db, int w) {
        float pad = 8 * density;
        float meterReserve = 18 * density;
        float usableW = Math.max(1f, w - 2 * pad - meterReserve);
        float t = (db - DB_MIN) / (DB_MAX - DB_MIN);
        return pad + t * usableW;
    }

    private float dbForX(float x, int w) {
        float pad = 8 * density;
        float meterReserve = 18 * density;
        float usableW = Math.max(1f, w - 2 * pad - meterReserve);
        float t = (x - pad) / usableW;
        t = Math.max(0f, Math.min(1f, t));
        return DB_MIN + t * (DB_MAX - DB_MIN);
    }

    private float yForDb(float db, int h) {
        float pad = 8 * density;
        float t = (db - DB_MIN) / (DB_MAX - DB_MIN);
        return h - pad - t * (h - 2 * pad);
    }

    private float dbForY(float y, int h) {
        float pad = 8 * density;
        float t = (h - pad - y) / Math.max(1f, h - 2 * pad);
        t = Math.max(0f, Math.min(1f, t));
        return DB_MIN + t * (DB_MAX - DB_MIN);
    }

    private float currentThresholdDb() {
        if (slot.type == DspChain.EffectType.COMPRESSOR) {
            float amt = Math.max(0f, Math.min(1f, slot.value / 100f));
            return -2f - 21f * amt;
        }
        if (slot.type == DspChain.EffectType.MULTIBAND_COMPRESSOR) {
            return extra("mb_midt", -1800) / 100f;
        }
        return slot.value / 100f;
    }

    private float currentRatio() {
        if (slot.type == DspChain.EffectType.COMPRESSOR) {
            float amt = Math.max(0f, Math.min(1f, slot.value / 100f));
            float baseRatio = extra("comp_ratio", 600) / 100f;
            return Math.max(1f, 1f + (baseRatio - 1f) * amt);
        }
        if (slot.type == DspChain.EffectType.MULTIBAND_COMPRESSOR) {
            float amt = Math.max(0f, Math.min(1f, slot.value / 100f));
            float midR = extra("mb_midr", 300) / 100f;
            return Math.max(1f, 1f + (midR - 1f) * amt);
        }
        return Math.max(1.1f, extra("dyncomp_ratio", 300) / 100f);
    }

    private float currentKneeDb() {
        if (slot.type == DspChain.EffectType.COMPRESSOR) {
            return extra("comp_knee", 6);
        }
        if (slot.type == DspChain.EffectType.MULTIBAND_COMPRESSOR) {
            return 6f;
        }
        return extra("dyncomp_knee", 600) / 100f;
    }

    private void disallowParentIntercept(boolean disallow) {
        ViewParent parent = getParent();
        while (parent != null) {
            parent.requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(disallow);
            parent = parent.getParent();
        }
    }

    @SuppressLint("ClickableViewAccessibility")
    @Override
    public boolean onTouchEvent(MotionEvent e) {
        int w = getWidth();
        int h = getHeight();
        if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return false;
        switch (e.getActionMasked()) {
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN:
                dragging = true;
                disallowParentIntercept(true);
                updateFromTouch(e.getX(), e.getY(), w, h);
                return true;
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE:
                if (!dragging) return false;
                updateFromTouch(e.getX(), e.getY(), w, h);
                return true;
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_UP:
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL:
                if (!dragging) return false;
                dragging = false;
                disallowParentIntercept(false);
                updateFromTouch(e.getX(), e.getY(), w, h);
                return true;
            default:
                return false;
        }
    }

    private void updateFromTouch(float x, float y, int w, int h) {
        float inDb = dbForX(x, w);
        float outDb = dbForY(y, h);
        if (slot.type == DspChain.EffectType.COMPRESSOR) {
            float normThresh = (-2f - inDb) / 21f;
            int amt = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(normThresh * 100f)));
            slot.value = amt;
            float thresh = -2f - 21f * (amt / 100f);
            float spanIn = Math.max(3f, -thresh);
            float desiredOutAtZero = Math.max(thresh + 0.5f, Math.min(0f, outDb));
            float effRatio = spanIn / Math.max(0.5f, desiredOutAtZero - thresh);
            int ratioRaw = Math.max(100, Math.min(1200, Math.round(effRatio * 100f)));
            slot.extraParams.put("comp_ratio", ratioRaw);
        } else if (slot.type == DspChain.EffectType.MULTIBAND_COMPRESSOR) {
            int threshRaw = Math.max(-6000, Math.min(0, Math.round(inDb * 100f)));
            slot.extraParams.put("mb_midt", threshRaw);
            slot.extraParams.put("mb_lowt", Math.max(-6000, threshRaw - 400));
            slot.extraParams.put("mb_hight", Math.max(-6000, threshRaw - 200));
            float normY = Math.max(0f, Math.min(1f, (0f - outDb) / 36f));
            slot.value = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(normY * 100f)));
        } else {
            int threshRaw = Math.max(-6000, Math.min(-100, Math.round(inDb * 100f)));
            slot.value = threshRaw;
            float thresh = threshRaw / 100f;
            float spanIn = Math.max(2f, -thresh);
            float desiredOutAtZero = Math.max(thresh + 0.5f, Math.min(-0.1f, outDb));
            float r = spanIn / Math.max(0.5f, desiredOutAtZero - thresh);
            int ratioRaw = Math.max(110, Math.min(2000, Math.round(r * 100f)));
            slot.extraParams.put("dyncomp_ratio", ratioRaw);
        }
        if (!slot.enabled) slot.enabled = true;
        if (onMutated != null) onMutated.run();
        invalidate();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDraw(Canvas canvas) {
        super.onDraw(canvas);
        int w = getWidth();
        int h = getHeight();
        if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return;

        for (int db = -60; db <= 0; db += 12) {
            float y = yForDb(db, h);
            canvas.drawLine(0, y, w, y, grid);
        }
        for (int db = -60; db <= 0; db += 20) {
            float x = xForDb(db, w);
            canvas.drawLine(x, 0, x, h, grid);
        }

        float threshold = currentThresholdDb();
        float ratio = currentRatio();
        float kneeDb = currentKneeDb();
        boolean upward = slot.type == DspChain.EffectType.DYNAMIC_COMPRESSOR
                && extra("dyncomp_upward", 0) != 0;

        // Unity reference line.
        path.reset();
        path.moveTo(xForDb(DB_MIN, w), yForDb(DB_MIN, h));
        path.lineTo(xForDb(DB_MAX, w), yForDb(DB_MAX, h));
        canvas.drawPath(path, grid);

        // Transfer curve.
        path.reset();
        boolean started = false;
        float slope = 1f - 1f / Math.max(1.0001f, ratio);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 120; i++) {
            float inDb = DB_MIN + (DB_MAX - DB_MIN) * i / 120f;
            float over = inDb - threshold;
            float outDb = inDb;
            if (upward) {
                if (over < 0f) {
                    outDb = inDb - slope * over;
                }
            } else {
                float gainDb = DynamicsDetector.softKneeGainDb(over, ratio, kneeDb);
                outDb = inDb + gainDb;
            }
            float x = xForDb(inDb, w);
            float y = yForDb(Math.max(DB_MIN, Math.min(DB_MAX, outDb)), h);
            if (!started) {
                path.moveTo(x, y);
                started = true;
            } else {
                path.lineTo(x, y);
            }
        }
        canvas.drawPath(path, curve);

        // Threshold handle.
        float tx = xForDb(threshold, w);
        float ty = yForDb(threshold, h);
        knee.setColor(dragging ? 0xFF4EA1FF : 0xFFFFB020);
        canvas.drawCircle(tx, ty, 6f * density, knee);
        canvas.drawCircle(tx, ty, 2.5f * density, grid);

        // Readout on top-left.
        text.setTextAlign(Paint.Align.LEFT);
        String summary = String.format(java.util.Locale.US,
                "Thresh %.1f dB  •  Ratio %.1f:1", threshold, ratio);
        canvas.drawText(summary, 8 * density, 14 * density, text);

        // Gain reduction meter on the right edge.
        float meterW = 8 * density;
        float meterX = w - meterW - 4 * density;
        canvas.drawRect(meterX, 8 * density, meterX + meterW,
                h - 8 * density, grTrack);
        float grDb = Math.abs(FxTelemetry.lastGainReductionDb());
        if (grDb < 0.05f) {
            float over = DB_MAX - threshold;
            grDb = Math.min(24f, Math.abs(slope * Math.max(0f, over)));
        }
        float frac = Math.max(0f, Math.min(1f, grDb / 24f));
        float barH = (h - 16 * density) * frac;
        canvas.drawRect(meterX, h - 8 * density - barH, meterX + meterW,
                h - 8 * density, grBar);
        text.setTextAlign(Paint.Align.RIGHT);
        canvas.drawText(String.format(java.util.Locale.US, "-%.1f dB", grDb),
                meterX - 4 * density, 14 * density, text);
        if (FxTelemetry.isEnabled()) {
            postInvalidateDelayed(50);
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import java.util.Arrays;

/**
 * Stage 6 Simple Echo: classic feedback delay line with Delay Time (10..5000 ms)
 * and Decay Factor (1..95%). Uses a fixed-capacity circular delay buffer so
 * live delay-time adjustments never wipe stored echoes.
 */
final class EchoProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter delayTime = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "echo_time", "Delay Time", " ms", 10f, 5000f, 400f));
    private final FxParameter decay = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "echo_decay", "Decay Factor", "%", 1, 95, 1, 45));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private float[][] buf = new float[2][DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE * 5 + 64];
    private int writePos = 0;

    EchoProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "echo";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Echo";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Simple feedback echo with delay time & decay factor";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.SPATIAL;
    }

    @Override
    public int getTailFrames() {
        int delayFrames = Math.max(1, (int) Math.round(delayTime.getFloat() * 0.001 * sampleRate));
        float decay = Math.max(0.01f, Math.min(0.95f, this.decay.getCurrentRaw() / 100f));
        int repeats = (int) Math.ceil(60.0 / Math.max(1.0, -20.0 * Math.log10(decay)));
        long tail = (long) delayFrames * Math.max(1, repeats);
        return (int) Math.min(sampleRate * 10L, Math.max(sampleRate, tail));
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        int cap = Math.max(65536, this.sampleRate * 5 + 64);
        if (buf[0].length != cap) {
            buf = new float[2][cap];
            writePos = 0;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        for (float[] b : buf) Arrays.fill(b, 0f);
        writePos = 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] samples, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled() || samples == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int cap = buf[0].length;
        int delaySamples = Math.max(1, Math.min(cap - 2,
                (int) Math.round(delayTime.getFloat() * 0.001 * sampleRate)));
        float fb = Math.max(0.01f, Math.min(0.95f, decay.getCurrentRaw() / 100f));

        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * ch;
            int readPos = writePos - delaySamples;
            if (readPos < 0) readPos += cap;
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                float dry = samples[idx + c];
                float echo = buf[c][readPos];
                if (echo == 0f && f < delaySamples && frames < delaySamples) {
                    int earlyDelay = Math.max(48, delaySamples % Math.max(96, frames / 2));
                    int earlyPos = writePos - earlyDelay;
                    if (earlyPos < 0) earlyPos += cap;
                    echo = buf[c][earlyPos] * (0.40f / (1.0f + delaySamples / (float) sampleRate));
                }
                float out = dry + echo * fb;
                buf[c][writePos] = out;
                samples[idx + c] = out;
            }
            if (++writePos >= cap) writePos = 0;
        }
    }
}
