package com.example.hello;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.ByteOrder;

/**
 * Stage 7 fades: fade in, fade out, studio fade out (equal-power S-curve
 * plus a closing low-pass) and a fully customisable fade.
 *
 * <p>Supports bounded-chunk file-to-file streaming via
 * {@link #processOfflineRangeToFile} so applying fades to multi-minute takes
 * never allocates full-region arrays in RAM.
 */
final class FadeProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] TYPE_LABELS = {"Fade In", "Fade Out",
            "Studio Fade Out", "Adjustable Fade"};
    private static final String[] CURVE_LABELS = {"Linear", "Logarithmic",
            "Exponential", "Cosine", "S-Curve"};

    private final FxParameter type = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "fade_type", "Type", TYPE_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter curve = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "fade_curve", "Curve Shape", CURVE_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter midBoost = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "fade_mid", "Mid-Fade Boost", "%", -100, 100, 1, 0));
    private final FxParameter startGain = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "fade_start", "Start Gain", "%", 0, 100, 1, 0));
    private final FxParameter endGain = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "fade_end", "End Gain", "%", 0, 100, 1, 100));
    private final FxParameter length = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "fade_len", "Length", "%", 1, 100, 1, 20));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int channels = 2;
    private final BiquadFilter closingLp = new BiquadFilter();

    FadeProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "fade";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Fade";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Fade in, fade out, studio fade or custom curve";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.TOOLS;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        closingLp.setSections(new float[][]{Dsp.rbjLowPass(this.sampleRate, 800f, 0.7071)},
                this.channels);
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        closingLp.reset();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isOfflineOnly() {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        // Offline-only effect: rendered through processOfflineRegion.
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled();
    }

    @Override
    public float[] processOfflineRegion(float[] in, int frames, int channels) {
        if (in == null || frames <= 0) return in;
        float[] out = in.clone();
        int typeIdx = type.getEnumIndex();
        int fadeFrames = Math.max(1,
                (int) Math.round(frames * length.getCurrentRaw() / 100.0));
        fadeFrames = Math.min(fadeFrames, frames);

        switch (typeIdx) {
            case 0: { // Fade In
                applyRamp(out, frames, channels, fadeFrames, true, 0L, frames);
                break;
            }
            case 1: { // Fade Out
                applyRamp(out, frames, channels, fadeFrames, false, 0L, frames);
                break;
            }
            case 2: { // Studio Fade Out
                closingLp.reset();
                applyStudioFade(out, frames, channels, fadeFrames, 0L, frames);
                break;
            }
            default: { // Adjustable Fade
                applyAdjustable(out, frames, channels, fadeFrames, 0L);
                break;
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    @Override
    public long processOfflineRangeToFile(File srcWav, long startFrame,
                                          long endFrame, File dstWav,
                                          int sampleRate, int channels)
            throws Exception {
        if (srcWav == null || dstWav == null) return -1L;
        FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(srcWav);
        int ch = Math.max(1, channels > 0 ? channels : info.channels);
        int sr = sampleRate > 0 ? sampleRate : info.sampleRate;
        long totalFrames = info.dataBytes / 4L / ch;
        startFrame = Math.max(0L, Math.min(totalFrames, startFrame));
        endFrame = Math.max(startFrame, Math.min(totalFrames, endFrame));
        long regionFrames = endFrame - startFrame;
        if (regionFrames <= 0) return -1L;

        prepare(sr, ch);
        closingLp.reset();
        int typeIdx = type.getEnumIndex();
        long fadeFrames = Math.max(1L,
                Math.round(regionFrames * length.getCurrentRaw() / 100.0));
        fadeFrames = Math.min(fadeFrames, regionFrames);
        float mix = getWetDryMix();

        int chunkFrames = DEFAULT_DSP_CHUNK_FRAMES;
        byte[] rawBuf = new byte[chunkFrames * ch * 4];
        float[] fBuf = new float[chunkFrames * ch];
        float[] dryBuf = mix < 0.999f ? new float[chunkFrames * ch] : null;
        ByteBuffer bb = ByteBuffer.wrap(rawBuf).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
        long frameBytes = ch * 4L;

        try (RandomAccessFile inRaf = new RandomAccessFile(srcWav, "r");
             RandomAccessFile outRaf = new RandomAccessFile(dstWav, "rw")) {
            outRaf.setLength(0);
            outRaf.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(ch, sr, regionFrames * frameBytes));
            long offset = 0L;
            while (offset < regionFrames) {
                int want = (int) Math.min((long) chunkFrames, regionFrames - offset);
                inRaf.seek(info.dataStart + (startFrame + offset) * frameBytes);
                inRaf.readFully(rawBuf, 0, want * ch * 4);
                bb.clear();
                bb.limit(want * ch * 4);
                bb.asFloatBuffer().get(fBuf, 0, want * ch);
                if (dryBuf != null) {
                    System.arraycopy(fBuf, 0, dryBuf, 0, want * ch);
                }

                switch (typeIdx) {
                    case 0:
                        applyRamp(fBuf, want, ch, fadeFrames, true, offset, regionFrames);
                        break;
                    case 1:
                        applyRamp(fBuf, want, ch, fadeFrames, false, offset, regionFrames);
                        break;
                    case 2:
                        applyStudioFade(fBuf, want, ch, fadeFrames, offset, regionFrames);
                        break;
                    default:
                        applyAdjustable(fBuf, want, ch, fadeFrames, offset);
                        break;
                }

                if (dryBuf != null) {
                    HardwareApiManager.get().processGainClipMixChunked(
                            fBuf, dryBuf, want * ch, 1.0f, 0f, mix);
                }
                Dsp.writeFloatsLE(outRaf, fBuf, 0, want * ch);
                offset += want;
            }
        }
        return regionFrames;
    }

    private float shapeCurve(float u) {
        u = Math.max(0f, Math.min(1f, u));
        int curveIdx = curve.getEnumIndex();
        float s;
        switch (curveIdx) {
            case 1: // Logarithmic
                s = (float) Math.pow(u, 0.5);
                break;
            case 2: // Exponential
                s = (float) Math.pow(u, 2.0);
                break;
            case 3: // Cosine
                s = (float) (0.5 - 0.5 * Math.cos(Math.PI * u));
                break;
            case 4: // S-Curve
                s = u * u * (3f - 2f * u);
                break;
            case 0:
            default: // Linear
                s = u;
                break;
        }
        float mid = midBoost.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        if (mid != 0f) {
            s *= Math.max(0f, 1f + mid * 2.5f * u * (1f - u));
        }
        return Math.max(0f, Math.min(1.5f, s));
    }

    /** Shaped ramp in or out over the first/last {@code fadeFrames}. */
    private void applyRamp(float[] buf, int chunkFrames, int ch, long fadeFrames,
                           boolean fadeIn, long globalFrameOffset, long totalFrames) {
        float gStart = startGain.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        float gEnd = endGain.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        if (Math.abs(gStart - 1.0f) < 1e-4f && Math.abs(gEnd - 1.0f) < 1e-4f) {
            gStart = 0.85f;
        }
        if (!fadeIn && gStart < 0.01f && gEnd > 0.99f) {
            gStart = 1.0f;
            gEnd = 0.0f;
        }
        long startOut = totalFrames - fadeFrames;
        for (int local = 0; local < chunkFrames; local++) {
            long f = globalFrameOffset + local;
            float g;
            if (fadeIn) {
                if (f < fadeFrames) {
                    float u = fadeFrames <= 1 ? 1f : f / (float) (fadeFrames - 1);
                    float shaped = shapeCurve(u);
                    g = gStart + (gEnd - gStart) * shaped;
                } else {
                    g = gEnd;
                }
            } else {
                if (f >= startOut) {
                    long i = f - startOut;
                    float u = fadeFrames <= 1 ? 1f : i / (float) (fadeFrames - 1);
                    float shaped = shapeCurve(u);
                    g = gStart + (gEnd - gStart) * shaped;
                } else {
                    g = gStart;
                }
            }
            int idx = local * ch;
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) buf[idx + c] *= g;
        }
    }

    /** Equal-power S-curve with a low-pass that closes during the fade. */
    private void applyStudioFade(float[] buf, int chunkFrames, int ch,
                                 long fadeFrames, long globalFrameOffset,
                                 long totalFrames) {
        float gStart = startGain.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        float gEnd = endGain.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        if (Math.abs(gStart - 1.0f) < 1e-4f && Math.abs(gEnd - 1.0f) < 1e-4f) {
            gStart = 0.85f;
        }
        if (gStart < 0.01f && gEnd > 0.99f) {
            gStart = 1.0f;
            gEnd = 0.0f;
        }
        long startOut = totalFrames - fadeFrames;
        for (int local = 0; local < chunkFrames; local++) {
            long f = globalFrameOffset + local;
            float u = 0f;
            if (f >= startOut) {
                long i = f - startOut;
                u = fadeFrames <= 1 ? 1f : i / (float) (fadeFrames - 1);
            }
            float cutoff = 20000f * (float) Math.pow(800f / 20000f, u);
            closingLp.setSections(new float[][]{
                    Dsp.rbjLowPass(sampleRate, cutoff, 0.7071)}, ch);
            closingLp.process(buf, 1, ch, local);
            float baseCos = (float) (0.5 * (1.0 + Math.cos(Math.PI * u)));
            float shaped = 0.5f * baseCos + 0.5f * shapeCurve(1f - u);
            float g = gEnd + (gStart - gEnd) * shaped;
            int idx = local * ch;
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                buf[idx + c] *= g;
            }
        }
    }

    /** Custom curve between an arbitrary start and end gain. */
    private void applyAdjustable(float[] buf, int chunkFrames, int ch,
                                 long fadeFrames, long globalFrameOffset) {
        float g0 = startGain.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        float g1 = endGain.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        if (Math.abs(g0 - 1.0f) < 1e-4f && Math.abs(g1 - 1.0f) < 1e-4f) {
            g0 = 0.85f;
        }
        for (int local = 0; local < chunkFrames; local++) {
            long f = globalFrameOffset + local;
            float u = fadeFrames <= 1 ? 1f
                    : Math.min(1f, f / (float) (fadeFrames - 1));
            float shape = shapeCurve(u);
            float g = g0 + (g1 - g0) * shape;
            int idx = local * ch;
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) buf[idx + c] *= g;
        }
    }
}

FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/FilterCurveEqProcessor.java

package com.example.hello;

import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * Stage 3 · A3: Filter Curve EQ. Up to 32 draggable frequency/gain nodes
 * design a linear-phase FIR whose magnitude matches the drawn curve; audio
 * runs through a uniform overlap-add FFT convolution (block 256). Node
 * geometry persists per slot through {@code extraParams} (npts, pf#, pg#),
 * so it survives rack save/load without bespoke serialization.
 *
 * <p>Fixes BUG-01 &amp; BUG-02:
 * <ul>
 *   <li>Reports its exact linear-phase group delay ({@code taps / 2} frames) via
 *       {@link #getLatencyFrames()} so offline bakes align and drain the FIR
 *       without leading silence or tail truncation.</li>
 *   <li>Blends {@link #getWetDryMix()} phase-coherently inside the linear-phase
 *       target magnitude ({@code (1 - mix) + mix * wetMag}) and overrides
 *       {@link #handlesOwnWetDryMix()} so partial wet/dry mixes never comb-filter
 *       against an undelayed dry copy.</li>
 *   <li>Spaced default frequencies across all 32 nodes so nodes 8..31 never
 *       collide at 16 kHz.</li>
 * </ul>
 */
final class FilterCurveEqProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    static final int MAX_NODES = 32;
    private static final int BLOCK = 256;
    private static final String[] TAP_LABELS = {"1024", "2048", "4096"};

    private final FxParameter out = addParameter(
            FxParameter.dbParam("out", "Output", -18f, 18f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter npts = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("npts", "Points", "", 2, MAX_NODES, 1, 8));
    private final FxParameter tapsSel = addParameter(
            FxParameter.enumParam("taps", "Precision", TAP_LABELS, 1));
    private final FxParameter[] nodeFreq = new FxParameter[MAX_NODES];
    private final FxParameter[] nodeGain = new FxParameter[MAX_NODES];

    private final BiquadFilter outputGain = new BiquadFilter();

    private float[] ir = new float[0];
    private float[] hRe = new float[0];
    private float[] hIm = new float[0];
    private float[][] carry = new float[2][0];
    private float[] inRe = new float[0];
    private float[] inIm = new float[0];
    private int fftSize = 0;
    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int channels = 1;
    private long designKey = Long.MIN_VALUE;

    FilterCurveEqProcessor() {
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_NODES; i++) {
            double f = defaultFreq(i);
            nodeFreq[i] = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
                    "pf" + i, "F" + (i + 1), " Hz", 20, 20000, 1, (int) f));
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_NODES; i++) {
            nodeGain[i] = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
                    "pg" + i, "G" + (i + 1), -24f, 24f, 0f));
        }
    }

    /**
     * Default node layout: the first eight nodes (the default point count)
     * span 40 Hz to 16 kHz logarithmically; additional nodes (8..31) are
     * strictly increasing from 16,167 Hz up to 20,000 Hz so every node has a
     * unique default frequency and drag bounds never invert.
     */
    static double defaultFreq(int index) {
        if (index <= 7) {
            return Math.round(40.0 * Math.pow(400.0, Math.max(0, index) / 7.0));
        }
        int clamped = Math.min(index, MAX_NODES - 1);
        return Math.round(16000.0 + (4000.0 * (clamped - 7)) / (MAX_NODES - 8));
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "fcurve";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Filter Curve EQ";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Draw an arbitrary response curve; linear-phase FIR (1024-4096 taps)";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.EQUALIZER;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean handlesOwnWetDryMix() {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public int getLatencyFrames() {
        return isAudible() ? tapsForIndex(tapsSel.getEnumIndex()) / 2 : 0;
    }

    /**
     * The linear-phase FIR has group delay, not a decaying tail; the delay
     * is already reported by {@link #getLatencyFrames()}.
     */
    @Override
    public int getTailFrames() {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        if (!isEnabled() || getWetDryMix() <= 0.001f) return false;
        if (out.getCurrentRaw() != 0) return true;
        int n = Math.max(2, Math.min(MAX_NODES, npts.getCurrentRaw()));
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (nodeGain[i].getCurrentRaw() != 0) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sr, int ch) {
        sampleRate = Math.max(8000, sr);
        channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, ch));
        designKey = Long.MIN_VALUE;
        rebuild();
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        for (float[] c : carry) {
            if (c != null) java.util.Arrays.fill(c, 0f);
        }
        outputGain.reset();
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int ch) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        float mix = getWetDryMix();
        if (mix <= 0.001f || !isAudible()) return;
        rebuild();
        int c = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, ch));
        offset256(buf, frames, c);
    }

    private void rebuild() {
        long key = designKeyNow();
        if (key == designKey) return;
        designKey = key;
        int taps = tapsForIndex(tapsSel.getEnumIndex());
        int n = Math.max(2, Math.min(MAX_NODES, npts.getCurrentRaw()));
        double[][] nodes = new double[n][2];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            nodes[i][0] = nodeFreq[i].getFloat();
            nodes[i][1] = nodeGain[i].getFloat();
        }
        sortNodes(nodes);
        designFir(nodes, taps, getWetDryMix(), out.getFloat());
        installCarry();
    }

    private long designKeyNow() {
        long h = 1469598103934665603L;
        h = h * 31 + sampleRate;
        h = h * 31 + channels;
        h = h * 31 + npts.getCurrentRaw();
        h = h * 31 + tapsSel.getCurrentRaw();
        h = h * 31 + out.getCurrentRaw();
        h = h * 31 + Math.round(getWetDryMix() * 1000f);
        int n = Math.max(2, Math.min(MAX_NODES, npts.getCurrentRaw()));
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            h = h * 31 + nodeFreq[i].getCurrentRaw();
            h = h * 31 + nodeGain[i].getCurrentRaw();
        }
        return h;
    }

    private static void sortNodes(double[][] nodes) {
        for (int i = 1; i < nodes.length; i++) {
            double[] v = nodes[i];
            int j = i - 1;
            while (j >= 0 && nodes[j][0] > v[0]) {
                nodes[j + 1] = nodes[j];
                j--;
            }
            nodes[j + 1] = v;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Builds the windowed impulse response via inverse FFT of the curve,
     * blending wet/dry phase-coherently at the identical linear-phase center
     * ({@code taps / 2}) so partial mixes never comb-filter.
     */
    private void designFir(double[][] nodes, int taps, float mix, float outDb) {
        int size = 2;
        while (size < BLOCK + taps - 1) size <<= 1;
        fftSize = size;
        float[] re = new float[size];
        float[] im = new float[size];
        int half = size / 2;
        float w = Math.max(0f, Math.min(1f, mix));
        float d = 1f - w;
        for (int k = 0; k <= half; k++) {
            double f = k * (double) sampleRate / size;
            double db = curveDbAt(nodes, f) + outDb;
            float wetMag = Dsp.dbToLin(db);
            float mag = d + w * wetMag;
            re[k] = mag;
            if (k > 0 && k < half) re[size - k] = mag;
        }
        Dsp.fft(re, im, true);
        float[] win = Dsp.blackmanWindow(taps);
        ir = new float[taps];
        for (int t = 0; t < taps; t++) {
            int src = ((t - taps / 2) % size + size) % size;
            ir[t] = re[src] * win[t];
        }
        if (hRe.length != size) {
            hRe = new float[size];
            hIm = new float[size];
            inRe = new float[size];
            inIm = new float[size];
        }
        java.util.Arrays.fill(hRe, 0f);
        java.util.Arrays.fill(hIm, 0f);
        System.arraycopy(ir, 0, hRe, 0, taps);
        Dsp.fft(hRe, hIm, false);
    }

    /** Piecewise-linear dB interpolation over the sorted nodes (log-f axis). */
    private static double curveDbAt(double[][] nodes, double f) {
        if (f <= nodes[0][0]) return nodes[0][1];
        int last = nodes.length - 1;
        if (f >= nodes[last][0]) return nodes[last][1];
        for (int i = 0; i < last; i++) {
            double f0 = nodes[i][0], f1 = nodes[i + 1][0];
            if (f >= f0 && f <= f1) {
                double denom = Math.log(f1) - Math.log(f0);
                if (Math.abs(denom) < 1e-9) return nodes[i + 1][1];
                double t = (Math.log(f) - Math.log(f0)) / denom;
                return nodes[i][1] + t * (nodes[i + 1][1] - nodes[i][1]);
            }
        }
        return nodes[last][1];
    }

    private void installCarry() {
        if (carry[0].length != fftSize - BLOCK) {
            carry = new float[][]{new float[fftSize - BLOCK],
                    new float[fftSize - BLOCK]};
        }
    }

    /** Uniform overlap-add blocks of 256 frames through the FIR. */
    private void offset256(float[] buf, int frames, int c) {
        if (ir.length == 0 || fftSize == 0) return;
        int off = 0;
        while (off < frames) {
            int blk = Math.min(BLOCK, frames - off);
            for (int chn = 0; chn < c; chn++) {
                java.util.Arrays.fill(inRe, 0f);
                java.util.Arrays.fill(inIm, 0f);
                for (int f = 0; f < blk; f++) {
                    inRe[f] = buf[(off + f) * c + chn];
                }
                Dsp.fft(inRe, inIm, false);
                HardwareApiManager.get().complexMultiplyInPlace(
                        inRe, inIm, hRe, hIm, fftSize);
                Dsp.fft(inRe, inIm, true);
                float[] cr = carry[chn];
                for (int f = 0; f < blk; f++) {
                    buf[(off + f) * c + chn] = inRe[f] + cr[f];
                }
                int keep = fftSize - BLOCK;
                for (int j = 0; j < keep; j++) {
                    int m = j + blk;
                    float prev = m < keep ? cr[m] : 0f;
                    cr[j] = prev + inRe[m];
                }
            }
            off += blk;
        }
    }

    static int tapsForIndex(int idx) {
        switch (idx) {
            case 0: return 1024;
            case 2: return 4096;
            default: return 2048;
        }
    }

    String curveSummary() {
        int n = Math.max(2, Math.min(MAX_NODES, npts.getCurrentRaw()));
        return String.format(Locale.US, "%d pts · %s", n, TAP_LABELS[
                Math.max(0, Math.min(2, tapsSel.getEnumIndex()))]);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import android.annotation.SuppressLint;
import android.content.Context;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.view.MotionEvent;

/**
 * Interactive canvas for the filter-curve EQ: draggable nodes on a log-f axis
 * with piecewise-linear dB interpolation (the same curve the FIR designer
 * uses). Drag moves a node; long-press on empty space inserts one, long-press
 * on a node removes it.
 */
final class FilterCurveEqView extends EqCurveView {

    private final Handler handler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
    private final Runnable longPress = this::onLongPress;
    private int active = -1;
    private float downX;
    private float downY;
    private boolean longPressFired;

    FilterCurveEqView(Context ctx, DspChain.EffectSlot slot, Runnable onMutated) {
        super(ctx, slot, 24f, onMutated);
    }

    private int nodeCount() {
        return Math.max(2, Math.min(FilterCurveEqProcessor.MAX_NODES,
                extra("npts", 8)));
    }

    private double[][] readNodes() {
        int n = nodeCount();
        double[][] nodes = new double[n][2];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            nodes[i][0] = extra("pf" + i, (int) FilterCurveEqProcessor.defaultFreq(i));
            nodes[i][1] = extra("pg" + i, 0) / 100.0;
        }
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            double[] v = nodes[i];
            int j = i - 1;
            while (j >= 0 && nodes[j][0] > v[0]) {
                nodes[j + 1] = nodes[j];
                j--;
            }
            nodes[j + 1] = v;
        }
        return nodes;
    }

    private void writeNodes(double[][] nodes) {
        putExtra("npts", nodes.length);
        for (int i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
            putExtra("pf" + i, (int) Math.round(nodes[i][0]));
            putExtra("pg" + i, (int) Math.round(nodes[i][1] * 100.0));
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected float responseDb(float f) {
        double[][] nodes = readNodes();
        double out = slot.value / 100.0;
        return (float) (out + curveDbAt(nodes, f));
    }

    private static double curveDbAt(double[][] nodes, double f) {
        if (f <= nodes[0][0]) return nodes[0][1];
        int last = nodes.length - 1;
        if (f >= nodes[last][0]) return nodes[last][1];
        for (int i = 0; i < last; i++) {
            double f0 = nodes[i][0], f1 = nodes[i + 1][0];
            if (f >= f0 && f <= f1) {
                double t = (Math.log(f) - Math.log(f0))
                        / Math.max(1e-9, Math.log(f1) - Math.log(f0));
                return nodes[i][1] + t * (nodes[i + 1][1] - nodes[i][1]);
            }
        }
        return nodes[last][1];
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDrawHandles(Canvas canvas, int w, int h) {
        double[][] nodes = readNodes();
        for (int i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
            float x = xForFreq((float) nodes[i][0], w);
            float y = yForDb((float) nodes[i][1], h);
            handle.setColor(i == active ? 0xFF4EA1FF : 0xFFF2F4F7);
            canvas.drawCircle(x, y, 6 * density, handle);
            canvas.drawCircle(x, y, 2.5f * density, grid);
        }
        if (active >= 0 && active < nodes.length) {
            String txt = Math.round(nodes[active][0]) + " Hz  "
                    + String.format(java.util.Locale.US, "%+.1f dB",
                    nodes[active][1]);
            canvas.drawText(txt, 8 * density, 12 * density, label);
        } else {
            canvas.drawText(nodes.length + " points  (hold: add/remove)",
                    8 * density, 12 * density, label);
        }
    }

    @SuppressLint("ClickableViewAccessibility")
    @Override
    public boolean onTouchEvent(MotionEvent e) {
        int w = getWidth();
        int h = getHeight();
        switch (e.getActionMasked()) {
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN: {
                downX = e.getX();
                downY = e.getY();
                longPressFired = false;
                active = nearestNode(downX, downY, w, h);
                disallowParentIntercept(true);
                handler.postDelayed(longPress, 480);
                return true;
            }
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE: {
                if (longPressFired) return true;
                if (Math.hypot(e.getX() - downX, e.getY() - downY) > 12 * density) {
                    handler.removeCallbacks(longPress);
                }
                if (active < 0) return true;
                double[][] nodes = readNodes();
                double lo = active > 0 ? nodes[active - 1][0] + 1 : F_MIN;
                double hi = active < nodes.length - 1
                        ? nodes[active + 1][0] - 1 : F_MAX;
                if (hi < lo) hi = lo;
                double f = Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, freqForX(e.getX(), w)));
                double g = dbForY(e.getY(), h);
                nodes[active][0] = f;
                nodes[active][1] = g;
                writeNodes(nodes);
                if (!slot.enabled) slot.enabled = true;
                onMutated.run();
                invalidate();
                return true;
            }
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_UP:
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL: {
                disallowParentIntercept(false);
                handler.removeCallbacks(longPress);
                if (active >= 0 && !longPressFired) {
                    if (!slot.enabled) slot.enabled = true;
                    onMutated.run();
                }
                active = -1;
                invalidate();
                return true;
            }
            default:
                return false;
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDetachedFromWindow() {
        handler.removeCallbacks(longPress);
        active = -1;
        longPressFired = false;
        super.onDetachedFromWindow();
    }

    private void onLongPress() {
        int w = getWidth();
        int h = getHeight();
        double[][] nodes = readNodes();
        int hit = nearestNode(downX, downY, w, h);
        if (hit >= 0) {
            if (nodes.length <= 2) return;
            longPressFired = true;
            double[][] out = new double[nodes.length - 1][2];
            for (int i = 0, j = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
                if (i != hit) out[j++] = nodes[i];
            }
            writeNodes(out);
            active = -1;
        } else {
            if (nodes.length >= FilterCurveEqProcessor.MAX_NODES) return;
            longPressFired = true;
            double f = freqForX(downX, w);
            double g = dbForY(downY, h);
            int insert = nodes.length;
            for (int i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
                if (nodes[i][0] > f) {
                    insert = i;
                    break;
                }
            }
            double[][] out = new double[nodes.length + 1][2];
            for (int i = 0, j = 0; i < out.length; i++) {
                if (i == insert) {
                    out[i][0] = f;
                    out[i][1] = g;
                } else {
                    out[i] = nodes[j++];
                }
            }
            writeNodes(out);
            active = insert;
        }
        if (!slot.enabled) slot.enabled = true;
        onMutated.run();
        invalidate();
    }

    private int nearestNode(float x, float y, int w, int h) {
        double[][] nodes = readNodes();
        int best = -1;
        float bestD = 34 * density;
        for (int i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
            float nx = xForFreq((float) nodes[i][0], w);
            float ny = yForDb((float) nodes[i][1], h);
            float d = (float) Math.hypot(nx - x, ny - y);
            if (d < bestD) {
                bestD = d;
                best = i;
            }
        }
        return best;
    }
}

=================================================================================
FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/FormatConverter.java
