package com.example.hello;

import java.util.Locale;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

/**
 * Strongly typed, serializable parameter descriptor for an
 * {@link AudioProcessor}. A processor declares the parameters it exposes and
 * the FX inspector renders one control per parameter, so multi-knob effects
 * need no bespoke UI.
 *
 * &lt;p&gt;Values are stored as integer &quot;raw&quot; counts so that stepping, clamping and
 * persistence are exact; {@link #getFloat()} rescales by
 * {@link #scaleDivisor} (e.g. raw 350 with divisor 100 is 3.50). Display
 * formatting is scale-aware (dB suffix, enum labels) and can be overridden
 * with a {@link ValueFormatter}.
 */
public final class FxParameter {

    public enum Type { FLOAT, INT, BOOLEAN, ENUM, ACTION, CURVE_NODES }

    public enum Scale { LINEAR, LOGARITHMIC, DECIBEL, PIECEWISE_FREQ }

    /** Optional display override; when set, {@link #formatDisplay()} uses it. */
    public interface ValueFormatter {
        String format(FxParameter p, int rawValue);
    }

    public final String id;
    public final String name;
    public final String unit;
    public final Type type;
    public final Scale scale;
    public final int minRaw;
    public final int maxRaw;
    public final int stepRaw;
    public final int defaultRaw;
    public final int scaleDivisor;
    public final String[] enumLabels;

    private volatile int currentRaw;
    private volatile ValueFormatter formatter;

    private FxParameter(String id, String name, String unit, Type type,
                        Scale scale, int minRaw, int maxRaw, int stepRaw,
                        int defaultRaw, int scaleDivisor, String[] enumLabels) {
        this.id = id;
        this.name = name;
        this.unit = unit == null ? "" : unit;
        this.type = type;
        this.scale = scale;
        this.minRaw = minRaw;
        this.maxRaw = maxRaw;
        this.stepRaw = Math.max(1, stepRaw);
        this.scaleDivisor = Math.max(1, scaleDivisor);
        this.enumLabels = enumLabels;
        this.defaultRaw = Math.max(minRaw, Math.min(maxRaw, defaultRaw));
        this.currentRaw = clampRaw(defaultRaw);
    }

    /** Integer parameter in {@code unit} (e.g. " Hz", "%"). */
    public static FxParameter intParam(String id, String name, String unit,
                                       int min, int max, int step, int def) {
        return new FxParameter(id, name, unit, Type.INT, Scale.LINEAR,
                min, max, step, def, 1, null);
    }
    /** Fractional parameter stored scaled by 100 (two decimal places). */
    public static FxParameter floatParam(String id, String name, String unit,
                                         float min, float max, float def) {
        return new FxParameter(id, name, unit, Type.FLOAT, Scale.LINEAR,
                Math.round(min * 100f), Math.round(max * 100f), 1,
                Math.round(def * 100f), 100, null);
    }

    /** Fractional Q/slope parameter (no unit suffix). */
    public static FxParameter qParam(String id, String name,
                                     float min, float max, float def) {
        return floatParam(id, name, "", min, max, def);
    }

    /** Decibel parameter (displays a " dB" suffix). */
    public static FxParameter dbParam(String id, String name,
                                      float minDb, float maxDb, float defDb) {
        FxParameter p = new FxParameter(id, name, " dB", Type.FLOAT,
                Scale.DECIBEL, Math.round(minDb * 100f), Math.round(maxDb * 100f),
                1, Math.round(defDb * 100f), 100, null);
        return p;
    }

    public static FxParameter boolParam(String id, String name, boolean def) {
        return new FxParameter(id, name, "", Type.BOOLEAN, Scale.LINEAR,
                0, 1, 1, def ? 1 : 0, 1, null);
    }

    public static FxParameter enumParam(String id, String name,
                                        String[] labels, int defIndex) {
        return new FxParameter(id, name, "", Type.ENUM, Scale.LINEAR,
                0, Math.max(0, labels.length - 1), 1, defIndex, 1, labels);
    }

    /** One-shot command parameter (renders as a button, holds no value). */
    public static FxParameter actionParam(String id, String name) {
        return new FxParameter(id, name, "", Type.ACTION, Scale.LINEAR,
                0, 0, 1, 0, 1, null);
    }

    public int getCurrentRaw() {
        return currentRaw;
    }

    /**
     * The step a control should use when the user drags or taps the value.
     *
     * <p>Fixed-point parameters are stored in raw counts ({@code scaleDivisor}
     * counts per display unit), so their storage granularity is far finer than
     * anything the user can read on the label. Dragging with the storage
     * granularity makes a one-decimal control (a Q of 25.0, a 0.1 dB
     * threshold) crawl: the value changes but the label barely moves, and
     * crossing the range takes hundreds of swipes.
     *
     * <p>The interaction step is therefore derived from the *displayed*
     * precision: one tenth of a display unit for fractional and decibel
     * parameters, one count for integer ones. That matches what the label
     * can actually show, so every drag tick produces a visible change.
     */
    public int interactionStepRaw() {
        int span = Math.max(0, maxRaw - minRaw);
        if (type == Type.INT) {
            return Math.max(1, Math.min(span, stepRaw));
        }
        if (scaleDivisor <= 1) {
            return Math.max(1, Math.min(span, stepRaw));
        }
        if (scale == Scale.DECIBEL && span >= 24 * scaleDivisor) {
            int halfDb = Math.max(1, scaleDivisor / 2);
            int step = Math.max(stepRaw, halfDb);
            return Math.max(1, Math.min(span, step));
        }
        // One tenth of a display unit, in raw counts.
        int tenth = Math.max(1, scaleDivisor / 10);
        int step = Math.max(1, Math.max(stepRaw, tenth));
        // The step must never be coarser than the range itself, or a narrow
        // control could not reach its own bounds.
        return Math.max(1, Math.min(span, step));
    }

    public void setCurrentRaw(int raw) {
        this.currentRaw = clampRaw(raw);
    }

    public void resetToDefault() {
        this.currentRaw = clampRaw(defaultRaw);
    }

    public int clampRaw(int raw) {
        int v = Math.max(minRaw, Math.min(maxRaw, raw));
        if (type == Type.ENUM || type == Type.BOOLEAN || type == Type.ACTION) {
            return v;
        }
        if (stepRaw > 1 && v < maxRaw) {
            int steps = Math.round((v - minRaw) / (float) stepRaw);
            v = minRaw + steps * stepRaw;
            v = Math.max(minRaw, Math.min(maxRaw, v));
        }
        return v;
    }

    public float getFloat() {
        return currentRaw / (float) scaleDivisor;
    }

    public void setFloat(float v) {
        this.currentRaw = clampRaw(Math.round(v * scaleDivisor));
    }

    public boolean getBoolean() {
        return currentRaw != 0;
    }

    public void setBoolean(boolean b) {
        this.currentRaw = b ? 1 : 0;
    }

    public int getEnumIndex() {
        return currentRaw;
    }

    public void setEnumIndex(int idx) {
        this.currentRaw = clampRaw(idx);
    }

    public String getEnumLabel() {
        return getEnumLabel(currentRaw);
    }

    public String getEnumLabel(int rawIndex) {
        if (enumLabels == null || rawIndex < 0
                || rawIndex >= enumLabels.length) {
            return "";
        }
        return enumLabels[rawIndex];
    }

    public void setValueFormatter(ValueFormatter f) {
        this.formatter = f;
    }

    /** Human readable value for the current raw setting. */
    public String formatDisplay() {
        return formatRaw(currentRaw);
    }

    /**
     * Stateless display formatter for an arbitrary {@code rawValue}. Safe to
     * call on shared prototype descriptors without mutating {@link #currentRaw}.
     */
    public String formatRaw(int rawValue) {
        int raw = clampRaw(rawValue);
        if (formatter != null) {
            return formatter.format(this, raw);
        }
        if (type == Type.BOOLEAN) {
            return raw != 0 ? "On" : "Off";
        }
        if (type == Type.ENUM) {
            return getEnumLabel(raw);
        }
        if (type == Type.ACTION) {
            return name;
        }
        if (scaleDivisor <= 1) {
            return unit.isEmpty() ? String.valueOf(raw)
                    : raw + unit;
        }
        double d = raw / (double) scaleDivisor;
        String num;
        if (scale == Scale.DECIBEL) {
            if (scaleDivisor >= 100 && (Math.abs(raw) % 10) != 0) {
                num = String.format(Locale.US, "%+.2f", d);
            } else {
                num = String.format(Locale.US, "%+.1f", d);
            }
        } else if (Math.abs(d) >= 10 || raw % scaleDivisor == 0) {
            num = trimTrailingZeros(String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f", d));
        } else {
            num = trimTrailingZeros(String.format(Locale.US, "%.2f", d));
        }
        return unit.isEmpty() ? num : num + unit;
    }

    private static String trimTrailingZeros(String s) {
        if (!s.contains(".")) return s;
        while (s.endsWith("0")) s = s.substring(0, s.length() - 1);
        if (s.endsWith(".")) s = s.substring(0, s.length() - 1);
        return s;
    }

    public JSONObject toJson() {
        try {
            JSONObject o = new JSONObject();
            o.put("id", id);
            o.put("name", name);
            o.put("unit", unit);
            o.put("type", type.name());
            o.put("scale", scale.name());
            o.put("min", minRaw);
            o.put("max", maxRaw);
            o.put("step", stepRaw);
            o.put("def", defaultRaw);
            o.put("div", scaleDivisor);
            o.put("cur", currentRaw);
            if (enumLabels != null) {
                JSONArray a = new JSONArray();
                for (String l : enumLabels) a.put(l);
                o.put("enums", a);
            }
            return o;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return new JSONObject();
        }
    }

    /** Rebuilds a parameter from {@link #toJson()} output. */
    public static FxParameter fromJson(JSONObject o) {
        if (o == null) return null;
        String id = o.optString("id", "");
        String[] enums = null;
        JSONArray ea = o.optJSONArray("enums");
        if (ea != null && ea.length() > 0) {
            enums = new String[ea.length()];
            for (int i = 0; i < enums.length; i++) enums[i] = ea.optString(i, "");
        }
        Type t;
        Scale sc;
        try {
            t = Type.valueOf(o.optString("type", Type.INT.name()));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            t = Type.INT;
        }
        try {
            sc = Scale.valueOf(o.optString("scale", Scale.LINEAR.name()));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            sc = Scale.LINEAR;
        }
        FxParameter p = new FxParameter(id, o.optString("name", ""),
                o.optString("unit", ""), t, sc,
                o.optInt("min", 0), o.optInt("max", 100),
                o.optInt("step", 1), o.optInt("def", 0),
                o.optInt("div", 1), enums);
        p.currentRaw = p.clampRaw(o.optInt("cur", p.defaultRaw));
        return p;
    }
}

=================================================================================
FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/FxPreviewPeaks.java
=================================================================================
package com.example.hello;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.ByteOrder;

/**
 * Renders the live FX rack over a take and reports the resulting peak and
 * spectral-energy envelope, so the studio can draw the effect-applied waveform
 * while the user is still dialling the effects in.
 *
 * <p>The render is chunked and bounded across both in-place and offline
 * duration-changing effects so even multi-hour takes never allocate full-take
 * arrays on the Java heap or block the UI thread.
 */
final class FxPreviewPeaks {

    private FxPreviewPeaks() {}

    /**
     * Computes a perceptual composite envelope per bucket combining true peak,
     * RMS energy, and high-frequency spectral flux so that gain, dynamics,
     * EQ/filter, phase, and pitch parameters all produce smooth, proportional
     * waveform updates.
     */
    static float[] computePerceptualBuckets(float[] samples, int frames,
                                            int ch, int bucketCount) {
        if (samples == null || frames <= 0 || bucketCount <= 0) {
            return new float[Math.max(1, bucketCount)];
        }
        int cCount = Math.max(1, ch);
        float[] env = new float[bucketCount];
        for (int b = 0; b < bucketCount; b++) {
            int fStart = (int) ((long) b * frames / bucketCount);
            int fEnd = (int) ((long) (b + 1) * frames / bucketCount);
            if (fEnd <= fStart) fEnd = Math.min(frames, fStart + 1);
            float peak = 0f;
            double sumSq = 0.0;
            double sumDiff = 0.0;
            int count = 0;
            float prev = 0f;
            for (int f = fStart; f < fEnd; f++) {
                float frameSample = 0f;
                for (int c = 0; c < cCount; c++) {
                    int idx = f * cCount + c;
                    if (idx >= samples.length) break;
                    float v = samples[idx];
                    float a = Math.abs(v);
                    if (a > peak) peak = a;
                    frameSample += v;
                }
                frameSample /= cCount;
                sumSq += (double) frameSample * frameSample;
                if (count > 0) {
                    sumDiff += Math.abs(frameSample - prev);
                }
                prev = frameSample;
                count++;
            }
            if (count > 0) {
                float rms = (float) Math.sqrt(sumSq / count);
                float flux = (float) (sumDiff / count);
                env[b] = 0.45f * peak + 0.35f * (rms * 1.414f) + 0.20f * (flux * 1.85f);
            } else {
                env[b] = peak;
            }
        }
        return env;
    }

    /**
     * Streams {@code [startFrame, startFrame + frames)} from {@code raf} in
     * 4096-frame chunks to compute both true bucket peaks (into {@code outPeaks}
     * at {@code peakOffset}) and the perceptual composite envelope without
     * loading the region into RAM.
     */
    private static float[] computePerceptualBucketsStreaming(
            RandomAccessFile raf, long dataStart, long startFrame, long frames,
            int ch, int bucketCount, float[] outPeaks, int peakOffset)
            throws Exception {
        int bCount = Math.max(1, bucketCount);
        float[] env = new float[bCount];
        if (raf == null || frames <= 0) return env;
        int cCount = Math.max(1, ch);
        float[] bPeak = new float[bCount];
        double[] bSumSq = new double[bCount];
        double[] bSumDiff = new double[bCount];
        int[] bCountArr = new int[bCount];

        int chunkFrames = AudioProcessor.DEFAULT_DSP_CHUNK_FRAMES;
        byte[] rawBuf = new byte[chunkFrames * cCount * 4];
        float[] fBuf = new float[chunkFrames * cCount];
        ByteBuffer bb = ByteBuffer.wrap(rawBuf).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
        long frameBytes = cCount * 4L;

        float prev = 0f;
        int prevBucket = -1;
        long cur = 0L;
        while (cur < frames) {
            int want = (int) Math.min((long) chunkFrames, frames - cur);
            raf.seek(dataStart + (startFrame + cur) * frameBytes);
            raf.readFully(rawBuf, 0, want * cCount * 4);
            bb.clear();
            bb.limit(want * cCount * 4);
            bb.asFloatBuffer().get(fBuf, 0, want * cCount);

            for (int f = 0; f < want; f++) {
                long globalF = cur + f;
                int b = (int) (globalF * bCount / frames);
                if (b < 0) b = 0;
                if (b >= bCount) b = bCount - 1;
                float frameMono = 0f;
                float framePeak = 0f;
                int base = f * cCount;
                for (int c = 0; c < cCount; c++) {
                    float v = fBuf[base + c];
                    float a = Math.abs(v);
                    if (a > framePeak) framePeak = a;
                    frameMono += v;
                }
                frameMono /= cCount;
                if (framePeak > bPeak[b]) bPeak[b] = framePeak;
                if (outPeaks != null) {
                    int pkIdx = peakOffset + b;
                    if (pkIdx >= 0 && pkIdx < outPeaks.length
                            && framePeak > outPeaks[pkIdx]) {
                        outPeaks[pkIdx] = framePeak;
                    }
                }
                bSumSq[b] += (double) frameMono * frameMono;
                if (b == prevBucket && bCountArr[b] > 0) {
                    bSumDiff[b] += Math.abs(frameMono - prev);
                }
                prev = frameMono;
                prevBucket = b;
                bCountArr[b]++;
            }
            cur += want;
        }
        for (int b = 0; b < bCount; b++) {
            int cnt = bCountArr[b];
            if (cnt > 0) {
                float rms = (float) Math.sqrt(bSumSq[b] / cnt);
                float flux = (float) (bSumDiff[b] / cnt);
                env[b] = 0.45f * bPeak[b] + 0.35f * (rms * 1.414f)
                        + 0.20f * (flux * 1.85f);
            } else {
                env[b] = bPeak[b];
            }
        }
        return env;
    }

    /**
     * Renders {@code chain} over {@code raw} and returns the peak envelope
     * in {@code buckets} buckets (the same count the waveform view holds).
     *
     * @return the peaks, or null when the render could not be completed
     */
    static float[] render(File raw, DspChain chain, int buckets,
                           int sampleRate) {
        if (raw == null || chain == null || buckets <= 0) return null;
        int bCount = Math.min(buckets, 8192);
        return renderRegion(raw, chain, bCount, sampleRate, 0f, 1f);
    }

    /**
     * Renders only {@code [startFrac, endFrac)} of {@code raw} through
     * {@code chain} and returns peaks on the waveform's absolute bucket grid.
     */
    static float[] renderRegion(File raw, DspChain chain, int buckets,
                                int sampleRate, float startFrac,
                                float endFrac) {
        LiveRegionResult res = renderRegionInternal(raw, chain, buckets,
                sampleRate, startFrac, endFrac, null, false);
        return res != null ? res.peaks : null;
    }

    /**
     * Result of a real-time FX region render.
     */
    static final class LiveRegionResult {
        final float[] peaks;
        final float[] gainRatios;
        final boolean lengthChanged;
        final long newTotalFrames;
        final long startFrame;
        final long newRegionEndFrame;
        final File renderedWav;

        LiveRegionResult(float[] peaks, boolean lengthChanged,
                         long newTotalFrames, long startFrame,
                         long newRegionEndFrame, File renderedWav) {
            this(peaks, null, lengthChanged, newTotalFrames, startFrame,
                    newRegionEndFrame, renderedWav);
        }

        LiveRegionResult(float[] peaks, float[] gainRatios,
                         boolean lengthChanged, long newTotalFrames,
                         long startFrame, long newRegionEndFrame,
                         File renderedWav) {
            this.peaks = peaks;
            this.gainRatios = gainRatios;
            this.lengthChanged = lengthChanged;
            this.newTotalFrames = newTotalFrames;
            this.startFrame = startFrame;
            this.newRegionEndFrame = newRegionEndFrame;
            this.renderedWav = renderedWav;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Renders {@code [startFrac, endFrac)} of {@code raw} in real time for the
     * Studio FX timeline.
     */
    static LiveRegionResult renderRegionLive(File raw, DspChain chain,
                                             int baseBuckets, int sampleRate,
                                             float startFrac, float endFrac,
                                             File previewOutFile) {
        return renderRegionInternal(raw, chain, baseBuckets, sampleRate,
                startFrac, endFrac, previewOutFile, true);
    }

    private static LiveRegionResult renderRegionInternal(
            File raw, DspChain chain, int buckets, int sampleRate,
            float startFrac, float endFrac, File previewOutFile,
            boolean isLiveTimeline) {
        if (raw == null || chain == null || buckets <= 0) return null;
        if (!(startFrac < endFrac)) return null;
        try (RandomAccessFile raf = new RandomAccessFile(raw, "r")) {
            Dsp.WavHeader h = Dsp.parseWavHeader(raf);
            long onDisk = Math.max(0, raf.length() - h.dataStart);
            long dataBytes = (h.dataBytes <= 0 || h.dataBytes > onDisk)
                    ? onDisk : h.dataBytes;
            int ch = Math.max(1, h.channels);
            long totalFrames = dataBytes / 4 / ch;
            if (totalFrames <= 0) return null;
            long start = Math.max(0L, Math.min(totalFrames,
                    Math.round(startFrac * totalFrames)));
            long end = Math.max(start, Math.min(totalFrames,
                    Math.round(endFrac * totalFrames)));
            if (end <= start) return null;

            int bStart = Math.max(0, Math.min(buckets - 1,
                    Math.round(startFrac * buckets)));
            int bEnd = Math.max(bStart + 1, Math.min(buckets,
                    Math.round(endFrac * buckets)));
            int origRegionBuckets = Math.max(1, bEnd - bStart);

            int effSampleRate = h.sampleRate > 0 ? h.sampleRate : sampleRate;
            chain.setSampleRate(effSampleRate);
            if (!chain.offlineProcessors().isEmpty()) {
                long dryFrames = end - start;
                boolean hasGenerator = false;
                boolean hasReverse = false;
                for (AudioProcessor p : chain.offlineProcessors()) {
                    if (p instanceof AudioGeneratorTool) hasGenerator = true;
                    if (p instanceof TimelineUtilityProcessor) {
                        FxParameter act = p.getParam("tl_action");
                        if (act != null && act.getEnumIndex() == 1) hasReverse = true;
                    }
                }

                // Always render offline effects file-to-file in bounded chunks
                // so high-expansion effects (e.g. 100x Paulstretch, 50x Repeat,
                // or 600s Audio Generator) never allocate large arrays in RAM.
                float[] dryEnv = computePerceptualBucketsStreaming(
                        raf, h.dataStart, start, dryFrames, ch,
                        origRegionBuckets, null, 0);
                File regionTmp = new File(raw.getParentFile(),
                        raw.getName() + ".fxprev_reg_tmp");
                try {
                    long rFrames = chain.renderRegionToFile(
                            raw, start, end, effSampleRate, regionTmp);
                    if (rFrames <= 0 || !regionTmp.exists()) return null;
                    long tailFrames = Math.max(0L, totalFrames - end);
                    long newTotalFrames = start + rFrames + tailFrames;

                    try (RandomAccessFile rRaf = new RandomAccessFile(regionTmp, "r")) {
                        Dsp.WavHeader rh = Dsp.parseWavHeader(rRaf);
                        if (!isLiveTimeline) {
                            float[] peaks = new float[buckets];
                            float[] wetEnv = computePerceptualBucketsStreaming(
                                    rRaf, rh.dataStart, 0L, rFrames, ch,
                                    origRegionBuckets, peaks, bStart);
                            if (!hasGenerator && !hasReverse) {
                                for (int i = 0; i < origRegionBuckets; i++) {
                                    int b = bStart + i;
                                    if (b < buckets && dryEnv[i] > 1e-4f) {
                                        float ratio = wetEnv[i] / dryEnv[i];
                                        peaks[b] = 0.5f * peaks[b] + 0.5f * (peaks[b] * ratio);
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            return new LiveRegionResult(peaks, null, false,
                                    newTotalFrames, start, start + rFrames, null);
                        }

                        int newRegionBuckets = (rFrames == dryFrames)
                                ? origRegionBuckets
                                : Math.max(1, Math.min(8192,
                                        Math.round((float) rFrames * buckets
                                                / Math.max(1L, totalFrames))));
                        float[] regionPeaks = new float[newRegionBuckets];
                        float[] wetEnv = computePerceptualBucketsStreaming(
                                rRaf, rh.dataStart, 0L, rFrames, ch,
                                newRegionBuckets, regionPeaks, 0);
                        float[] gainRatios = computeOfflineGainRatios(
                                dryEnv, wetEnv, regionPeaks, origRegionBuckets,
                                newRegionBuckets, rFrames == dryFrames,
                                hasGenerator, hasReverse);
                        File outWav = null;
                        if (previewOutFile != null) {
                            writeSplicedPreviewWavFromFile(
                                    raf, h, start, end, totalFrames,
                                    rRaf, rh.dataStart, rFrames, previewOutFile);
                            outWav = previewOutFile;
                        }
                        return new LiveRegionResult(regionPeaks, gainRatios,
                                rFrames != dryFrames, newTotalFrames,
                                start, start + rFrames, outWav);
                    }
                } finally {
                    if (regionTmp.exists()) {
                        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                        regionTmp.delete();
                    }
                }
            }

            chain.reset();
            chain.prepareOffline(raw, start, end, effSampleRate, ch);

            float[] dryPeaks = new float[buckets];
            float[] wetPeaks = new float[buckets];
            double[] drySumSq = new double[buckets];
            double[] wetSumSq = new double[buckets];
            double[] drySumFlux = new double[buckets];
            double[] wetSumFlux = new double[buckets];
            int[] bucketFrames = new int[buckets];

            int chunkFrames = AudioProcessor.DEFAULT_DSP_CHUNK_FRAMES;
            byte[] rawBuf = new byte[chunkFrames * ch * 4];
            float[] fBuf = new float[chunkFrames * ch];
            float[] dryBuf = new float[chunkFrames * ch];
            ByteBuffer bb = ByteBuffer.wrap(rawBuf)
                    .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);

            // Warm the chain's filter/envelope state just before the region.
            int preRoll = (int) Math.min(Dsp.CROSSFADE_FRAMES, start);
            if (preRoll > 0) {
                raf.seek(h.dataStart + (start - preRoll) * ch * 4L);
                raf.readFully(rawBuf, 0, preRoll * ch * 4);
                bb.clear();
                bb.limit(preRoll * ch * 4);
                bb.asFloatBuffer().get(fBuf, 0, preRoll * ch);
                chain.processInPlace(fBuf, preRoll);
            }

            // Prime the latency line so output frame `cur` aligns with input
            // frame `cur`, matching the offline apply path.
            final int latencyFrames = Math.max(0, chain.getLatencyFrames());
            float[] postContext = null;
            int postContextFrames = 0;
            if (latencyFrames > 0) {
                postContextFrames = (int) Math.min(latencyFrames,
                        Math.max(0L, totalFrames - end));
                if (postContextFrames > 0) {
                    postContext = new float[postContextFrames * ch];
                    byte[] pcBuf = new byte[postContextFrames * ch * 4];
                    raf.seek(h.dataStart + end * ch * 4L);
                    raf.readFully(pcBuf);
                    ByteBuffer.wrap(pcBuf).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
                            .asFloatBuffer().get(postContext);
                }
                int remaining = latencyFrames;
                long pos = start;
                while (remaining > 0) {
                    int step = Math.min(chunkFrames, remaining);
                    int fromSel = (int) Math.max(0L,
                            Math.min((long) step, end - pos));
                    if (fromSel > 0) {
                        raf.seek(h.dataStart + pos * ch * 4L);
                        raf.readFully(rawBuf, 0, fromSel * ch * 4);
                        bb.clear();
                        bb.limit(fromSel * ch * 4);
                        bb.asFloatBuffer().get(fBuf, 0, fromSel * ch);
                    }
                    for (int f = fromSel; f < step; f++) {
                        long postIdx = (pos + f) - end;
                        for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                            fBuf[f * ch + c] = (postContext != null
                                    && postIdx >= 0
                                    && postIdx < postContextFrames)
                                    ? postContext[(int) postIdx * ch + c] : 0f;
                        }
                    }
                    chain.processInPlace(fBuf, step);
                    pos += step;
                    remaining -= step;
                }
            }

            float prevDry = 0f;
            float prevWet = 0f;
            long cur = start;
            while (cur < end) {
                int want = (int) Math.min(chunkFrames, end - cur);
                // Read aligned dry frames for [cur, cur + want)
                raf.seek(h.dataStart + cur * ch * 4L);
                raf.readFully(rawBuf, 0, want * ch * 4);
                bb.clear();
                bb.limit(want * ch * 4);
                bb.asFloatBuffer().get(dryBuf, 0, want * ch);

                // Read latency-offset frames for wet processing
                if (latencyFrames == 0) {
                    System.arraycopy(dryBuf, 0, fBuf, 0, want * ch);
                } else {
                    long inStart = cur + latencyFrames;
                    int fromFile = (int) Math.max(0L,
                            Math.min((long) want, end - inStart));
                    if (fromFile > 0) {
                        raf.seek(h.dataStart + inStart * ch * 4L);
                        raf.readFully(rawBuf, 0, fromFile * ch * 4);
                        bb.clear();
                        bb.limit(fromFile * ch * 4);
                        bb.asFloatBuffer().get(fBuf, 0, fromFile * ch);
                    }
                    if (fromFile < want) {
                        for (int f = fromFile; f < want; f++) {
                            long absFrame = inStart + f;
                            long postIdx = absFrame - end;
                            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                                fBuf[f * ch + c] = (postContext != null
                                        && postIdx >= 0
                                        && postIdx < postContextFrames)
                                        ? postContext[(int) postIdx * ch + c] : 0f;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                chain.processInPlace(fBuf, want);
                for (int f = 0; f < want; f++) {
                    float dPeak = 0f;
                    float wPeak = 0f;
                    float dMono = 0f;
                    float wMono = 0f;
                    for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                        float dv = dryBuf[f * ch + c];
                        float wv = fBuf[f * ch + c];
                        float da = Math.abs(dv);
                        float wa = Math.abs(wv);
                        if (da > dPeak) dPeak = da;
                        if (wa > wPeak) wPeak = wa;
                        dMono += dv;
                        wMono += wv;
                    }
                    dMono /= ch;
                    wMono /= ch;
                    int b = (int) ((cur + f) * buckets / totalFrames);
                    if (b < 0) b = 0;
                    if (b >= buckets) b = buckets - 1;
                    if (dPeak > dryPeaks[b]) dryPeaks[b] = dPeak;
                    if (wPeak > wetPeaks[b]) wetPeaks[b] = wPeak;
                    drySumSq[b] += (double) dMono * dMono;
                    wetSumSq[b] += (double) wMono * wMono;
                    drySumFlux[b] += Math.abs(dMono - prevDry);
                    wetSumFlux[b] += Math.abs(wMono - prevWet);
                    prevDry = dMono;
                    prevWet = wMono;
                    bucketFrames[b]++;
                }
                cur += want;
            }

            float[] outPeaks = new float[buckets];
            float[] gainRatios = new float[buckets];
            java.util.Arrays.fill(gainRatios, -1f);
            for (int b = 0; b < buckets; b++) {
                int cnt = bucketFrames[b];
                if (cnt <= 0) continue;
                float dRms = (float) Math.sqrt(drySumSq[b] / cnt);
                float wRms = (float) Math.sqrt(wetSumSq[b] / cnt);
                float dFlux = (float) (drySumFlux[b] / cnt);
                float wFlux = (float) (wetSumFlux[b] / cnt);
                float dEnv = 0.45f * dryPeaks[b] + 0.35f * (dRms * 1.414f)
                        + 0.20f * (dFlux * 1.85f);
                float wEnv = 0.45f * wetPeaks[b] + 0.35f * (wRms * 1.414f)
                        + 0.20f * (wFlux * 1.85f);
                if (dEnv > 1e-4f && dryPeaks[b] > 1e-4f) {
                    float envRatio = wEnv / dEnv;
                    float peakRatio = wetPeaks[b] / dryPeaks[b];
                    float combinedRatio = (Math.abs(peakRatio - 1f) > 0.04f)
                            ? (0.65f * peakRatio + 0.35f * envRatio)
                            : envRatio;
                    gainRatios[b] = Math.max(0f, combinedRatio);
                    outPeaks[b] = dryPeaks[b] * gainRatios[b];
                } else {
                    outPeaks[b] = wetPeaks[b];
                    gainRatios[b] = -1f;
                }
            }

            return new LiveRegionResult(outPeaks, gainRatios, false,
                    totalFrames, start, end, null);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static float[] computeOfflineGainRatios(
            float[] dryEnv, float[] wetEnv, float[] regionPeaks,
            int origRegionBuckets, int newRegionBuckets,
            boolean sameLength, boolean hasGenerator, boolean hasReverse) {
        if (hasGenerator) return null;
        float[] gainRatios = new float[newRegionBuckets];
        float meanDry = 0f;
        for (float d : dryEnv) meanDry += d;
        meanDry /= Math.max(1, dryEnv.length);
        for (int i = 0; i < newRegionBuckets; i++) {
            int dIdx = Math.min(origRegionBuckets - 1,
                    (int) ((long) i * origRegionBuckets
                            / Math.max(1, newRegionBuckets)));
            if (hasReverse) {
                int revIdx = origRegionBuckets - 1 - dIdx;
                float ref = dryEnv[revIdx] > 1e-4f ? dryEnv[revIdx] : meanDry;
                gainRatios[i] = ref > 1e-4f ? (wetEnv[i] / ref) : -1f;
            } else if (sameLength && dryEnv[dIdx] > 1e-4f) {
                gainRatios[i] = wetEnv[i] / dryEnv[dIdx];
                regionPeaks[i] = 0.5f * regionPeaks[i]
                        + 0.5f * (regionPeaks[i] * gainRatios[i]);
            } else if (meanDry > 1e-4f) {
                gainRatios[i] = wetEnv[i] / meanDry;
            } else {
                gainRatios[i] = -1f;
            }
        }
        return gainRatios;
    }

    private static void writeSplicedPreviewWav(RandomAccessFile rawRaf,
                                               Dsp.WavHeader h,
                                               long startFrame,
                                               long endFrame,
                                               long totalFrames,
                                               float[] rendered,
                                               int rFrames,
                                               File outFile) throws Exception {
        int ch = Math.max(1, h.channels);
        long frameBytes = ch * 4L;
        long prefixFrames = Math.max(0L, startFrame);
        long suffixFrames = Math.max(0L, totalFrames - endFrame);
        long newTotalFrames = prefixFrames + rFrames + suffixFrames;
        long payloadBytes = newTotalFrames * frameBytes;

        try (RandomAccessFile out = new RandomAccessFile(outFile, "rw")) {
            out.setLength(0);
            out.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(ch, h.sampleRate, payloadBytes));
            byte[] buf = new byte[65536];

            long prefixBytes = prefixFrames * frameBytes;
            if (prefixBytes > 0) {
                rawRaf.seek(h.dataStart);
                long left = prefixBytes;
                while (left > 0) {
                    int want = (int) Math.min(buf.length, left);
                    int n = rawRaf.read(buf, 0, want);
                    if (n <= 0) break;
                    out.write(buf, 0, n);
                    left -= n;
                }
            }

            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(out, rendered, 0, rFrames * ch);

            long suffixBytes = suffixFrames * frameBytes;
            if (suffixBytes > 0) {
                rawRaf.seek(h.dataStart + endFrame * frameBytes);
                long left = suffixBytes;
                while (left > 0) {
                    int want = (int) Math.min(buf.length, left);
                    int n = rawRaf.read(buf, 0, want);
                    if (n <= 0) break;
                    out.write(buf, 0, n);
                    left -= n;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private static void writeSplicedPreviewWavFromFile(
            RandomAccessFile rawRaf, Dsp.WavHeader h, long startFrame,
            long endFrame, long totalFrames, RandomAccessFile regRaf,
            long regDataStart, long rFrames, File outFile) throws Exception {
        int ch = Math.max(1, h.channels);
        long frameBytes = ch * 4L;
        long prefixFrames = Math.max(0L, startFrame);
        long suffixFrames = Math.max(0L, totalFrames - endFrame);
        long newTotalFrames = prefixFrames + rFrames + suffixFrames;
        long payloadBytes = newTotalFrames * frameBytes;

        try (RandomAccessFile out = new RandomAccessFile(outFile, "rw")) {
            out.setLength(0);
            out.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(ch, h.sampleRate, payloadBytes));
            byte[] buf = new byte[65536];

            long prefixBytes = prefixFrames * frameBytes;
            if (prefixBytes > 0) {
                rawRaf.seek(h.dataStart);
                long left = prefixBytes;
                while (left > 0) {
                    int want = (int) Math.min(buf.length, left);
                    int n = rawRaf.read(buf, 0, want);
                    if (n <= 0) break;
                    out.write(buf, 0, n);
                    left -= n;
                }
            }

            long regBytes = rFrames * frameBytes;
            if (regBytes > 0) {
                regRaf.seek(regDataStart);
                long left = regBytes;
                while (left > 0) {
                    int want = (int) Math.min(buf.length, left);
                    int n = regRaf.read(buf, 0, want);
                    if (n <= 0) break;
                    out.write(buf, 0, n);
                    left -= n;
                }
            }

            long suffixBytes = suffixFrames * frameBytes;
            if (suffixBytes > 0) {
                rawRaf.seek(h.dataStart + endFrame * frameBytes);
                long left = suffixBytes;
                while (left > 0) {
                    int want = (int) Math.min(buf.length, left);
                    int n = rawRaf.read(buf, 0, want);
                    if (n <= 0) break;
                    out.write(buf, 0, n);
                    left -= n;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

=================================================================================

package com.example.hello;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

/**
 * Ordered rack of {@link AudioProcessor}s. This replaces the hardcoded
 * internals of {@link DspChain}: processors run in rack order, a bypassed
 * processor is skipped, and a processor whose wet/dry mix is below 1.0 is
 * blended sample-accurately against the dry signal.
 *
 * <p>The legacy voice-chain stages are registered by id so a rack saved as
 * JSON can be rebuilt without knowing the concrete classes.
 */
public final class FxRackChain {

    /** Creates a fresh processor instance for JSON deserialization. */
    public interface ProcessorFactory {
        AudioProcessor create();
    }

    private static final Map<String, ProcessorFactory> REGISTRY =
            new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private static final Map<String, AudioProcessor> PROTOTYPES =
            new LinkedHashMap<>();

    private static final String[] CANONICAL_LEGACY_ORDER = {
            "hpf", "noise", "gate", "tone", "deess", "comp", "limiter"
    };

    static {
        register("hpf", ProHpfProcessor::new);
        register("noise", NoiseSuppressionProcessor::new);
        register("gate", ProGateProcessor::new);
        register("tone", ProToneProcessor::new);
        register("warmth", () -> new ProToneProcessor("warmth"));
        register("presence", () -> new ProToneProcessor("presence"));
        register("deess", ProDeEsserProcessor::new);
        register("comp", ProCompressorProcessor::new);
        register("limiter", ProLimiterProcessor::new);
        // Stage 3 EQ & filter suite.
        register("eq6", ParametricEq6BandProcessor::new);
        register("geq", GraphicEqProcessor::new);
        register("fcurve", FilterCurveEqProcessor::new);
        register("basstreble", BassAndTrebleProcessor::new);
        register("highpass", () -> new SlopeFilterProcessor(true));
        register("lowpass", () -> new SlopeFilterProcessor(false));
        register("notch", NotchFilterProcessor::new);
        register("shelf", ShelfFilterProcessor::new);
        register("classic", ClassicFiltersProcessor::new);
        // Stage 4 dynamics & leveling suite.
        register("amplify", AmplifyProcessor::new);
        register("normalize", NormalizeProcessor::new);
        register("loudness", LoudnessNormalizationProcessor::new);
        register("dyncomp", CompressorProcessor::new);
        register("mbcomp", MultibandCompressorProcessor::new);
        register("bricklim", BrickwallLimiterProcessor::new);
        register("gateexp", NoiseGateExpanderProcessor::new);
        register("deesssplit", DeEsserProcessor::new);
        register("autoduck", AutoDuckProcessor::new);
        // Stage 5 restoration suite.
        register("specnr", SpectralNoiseReductionProcessor::new);
        register("declick", ClickRemovalProcessor::new);
        register("clipfix", ClipFixProcessor::new);
        register("repair", RepairProcessor::new);
        register("dehum", DeHumProcessor::new);
        register("plosive", PlosiveBreathSuppressorProcessor::new);
        // Stage 6 spatial, distortion & modulation suite.
        register("reverb", FreeverbReverbProcessor::new);
        register("multidelay", MultiDelayProcessor::new);
        register("echo", EchoProcessor::new);
        register("stereoimg", StereoImagingProcessor::new);
        register("distort", DistortionWaveshaperProcessor::new);
        register("phaser", PhaserProcessor::new);
        register("chorus", ChorusFlangerProcessor::new);
        register("tremolo", TremoloProcessor::new);
        register("wah", WahwahProcessor::new);
        register("vocoder", VocoderProcessor::new);
        // Stage 7 time, utility, generator & analyzer suite.
        register("changepitch", ChangePitchProcessor::new);
        register("tempo", ChangeTempoProcessor::new);
        register("speedpitch", ChangeSpeedAndPitchProcessor::new);
        register("slidestretch", SlidingStretchProcessor::new);
        register("paulstretch", PaulstretchProcessor::new);
        register("fade", FadeProcessor::new);
        register("timeline", TimelineUtilityProcessor::new);
        register("truncsil", TruncateSilenceProcessor::new);
        register("spectraledit", SpectralEditProcessor::new);
        register("generator", AudioGeneratorTool::new);
    }

    /** Registers (or overrides) a processor id for JSON round-trips. */
    public static synchronized void register(String id, ProcessorFactory factory) {
        if (id == null || id.isEmpty() || factory == null) return;
        REGISTRY.put(id, factory);
        PROTOTYPES.remove(id);
    }

    /** Instantiates a registered processor, or null when unknown. */
    public static synchronized AudioProcessor createProcessor(String id) {
        if (id == null) return null;
        ProcessorFactory f = REGISTRY.get(resolveId(id));
        return f == null ? null : f.create();
    }

    /**
     * Maps an effect id onto its registered factory. Role-scoped "warmth" and
     * "presence" factories are registered directly so standalone inspection and
     * prototype metadata expose only the parameters belonging to that effect.
     */
    static String resolveId(String id) {
        if (id != null && REGISTRY.containsKey(id)) return id;
        if ("warmth".equals(id) || "presence".equals(id)) return "tone";
        return id;
    }

    /**
     * Returns a cached prototype processor for UI metadata and parameter
     * inspection without allocating a throwaway DSP instance on the UI thread.
     */
    public static synchronized AudioProcessor getPrototypeProcessor(String id) {
        if (id == null) return null;
        String lookupId = resolveId(id);
        AudioProcessor p = PROTOTYPES.get(lookupId);
        if (p == null) {
            ProcessorFactory f = REGISTRY.get(lookupId);
            if (f != null) {
                p = f.create();
                if (p != null) {
                    PROTOTYPES.put(lookupId, p);
                }
            }
        }
        return p;
    }

    private final CopyOnWriteArrayList<AudioProcessor> processors =
            new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();
    private final int channels;
    private int sampleRate = 48000;
    private float[] scratch = new float[0];

    /**
     * Non-null when both {@link DspChain.EffectType#WARMTH_BODY} and
     * {@link DspChain.EffectType#VOCAL_PRESENCE} are enabled and separated by
     * at least one other enabled processor in {@code cfg.slots}. When null
     * (the default/adjacent case), {@link ProToneProcessor} runs both in
     * its single combined shelf pass, so warmth and presence stay in one slot.
     */
    private DspChain.EffectType splitToneFirstType = null;
    private String splitToneAfterProcessorId = null;
    /**
     * Instance key of the processor the second tone stage runs after, so two
     * copies of the same effect are told apart.
     */
    private String splitToneAfterInstanceKey = null;
    private float splitToneFirstMix = 1.0f;
    private float splitToneSecondMix = 1.0f;

    public FxRackChain(int channels) {
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
    }

    public int getChannels() {
        return channels;
    }

    public int getSampleRate() {
        return sampleRate;
    }

    public boolean addProcessor(AudioProcessor p) {
        if (p == null) return false;
        p.prepare(sampleRate, channels);
        return processors.addIfAbsent(p);
    }

    /** Removes and returns the processor at {@code idx}, or null. */
    public AudioProcessor removeProcessor(int idx) {
        if (idx < 0 || idx >= processors.size()) return null;
        return processors.remove(idx);
    }

    /** Moves a processor to a new rack position (drag reorder). */
    public boolean moveProcessor(int fromIdx, int toIdx) {
        if (fromIdx < 0 || fromIdx >= processors.size()
                || toIdx < 0 || toIdx >= processors.size()
                || fromIdx == toIdx) {
            return false;
        }
        AudioProcessor p = processors.remove(fromIdx);
        if (p == null) return false;
        processors.add(toIdx, p);
        return true;
    }

    public AudioProcessor getProcessor(int idx) {
        if (idx < 0 || idx >= processors.size()) return null;
        return processors.get(idx);
    }

    public int indexOf(String id) {
        if (id == null) return -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < processors.size(); i++) {
            if (id.equals(processors.get(i).getId())) return i;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    /**
     * Index of the processor that serves a given rack entry.
     *
     * <p>Rack-local effects are matched by their instance key, so two copies
     * of the same effect stay separate. The legacy stages have no instance
     * key and are matched by their processor id.
     */
    public int indexOfInstance(String instanceKey, String fallbackId) {
        if (instanceKey == null) {
            return fallbackId == null ? -1 : indexOf(fallbackId);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < processors.size(); i++) {
            if (instanceKey.equals(processors.get(i).getInstanceKey())) return i;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    public int size() {
        return processors.size();
    }

    public boolean isEmpty() {
        return processors.isEmpty();
    }

    public void clear() {
        processors.clear();
    }

    public List<AudioProcessor> processors() {
        return processors;
    }

    /** True when any processor would alter audio. */
    public boolean isActive() {
        for (AudioProcessor p : processors) {
            if (p.isAudible()) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    public void reset() {
        for (AudioProcessor p : processors) p.reset();
    }

    /** Runs the optional two-pass analysis hook on every enabled processor. */
    public void prepareOffline(java.io.File raw, long startFrame,
                               long endFrame, int sampleRate, int channels)
            throws Exception {
        if (sampleRate > 0 && sampleRate != this.sampleRate) {
            setSampleRate(sampleRate);
        }
        for (AudioProcessor p : processors) {
            if (!p.isEnabled() || !p.isAudible()) continue;
            p.prepareOffline(raw, startFrame, endFrame, sampleRate, channels);
        }
    }

    /** Longest tail (frames) reported by any enabled processor. */
    public int getTailFrames() {
        int max = 0;
        for (AudioProcessor p : processors) {
            if (!p.isEnabled()) continue;
            if (p.getTailFrames() > max) max = p.getTailFrames();
        }
        return max;
    }

    /** Total algorithmic latency (frames) summed across active processors. */
    public int getLatencyFrames() {
        int total = 0;
        for (AudioProcessor p : processors) {
            if (!p.isEnabled() || p.isOfflineOnly() || !p.isAudible()) continue;
            if (p.getWetDryMix() <= 0.0f && !(p instanceof ProLimiterProcessor
                    && ((ProLimiterProcessor) p).isSafetyOn())) {
                continue;
            }
            total += Math.max(0, p.getLatencyFrames());
        }
        return total;
    }

    /**
     * Runs every enabled, audible processor in rack order. A processor at
     * full mix is applied in place; a partial mix is applied to a scratch
     * copy and blended back, so 0.5 mix is exactly half dry / half wet.
     * When the brickwall limiter's safety ceiling is armed, the post-blend
     * output is still clamped to the -0.2 dBFS ceiling so upstream gain
     * stages can never clip the output even if the limiter's drive mix is
     * reduced.
     */
    private float[] subChunkBuf = new float[0];

    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int totalFrames = Math.min(frames, buf.length / Math.max(1, channels));
        if (totalFrames <= 0) return;
        int maxChunk = AudioProcessor.DEFAULT_DSP_CHUNK_FRAMES;
        if (totalFrames > maxChunk) {
            int sliceLen = maxChunk * channels;
            if (subChunkBuf.length < sliceLen) {
                subChunkBuf = new float[sliceLen];
            }
            for (int off = 0; off < totalFrames; off += maxChunk) {
                int want = Math.min(maxChunk, totalFrames - off);
                int samples = want * channels;
                System.arraycopy(buf, off * channels, subChunkBuf, 0, samples);
                processChunkInPlace(subChunkBuf, want);
                System.arraycopy(subChunkBuf, 0, buf, off * channels, samples);
            }
            return;
        }
        processChunkInPlace(buf, totalFrames);
    }

    private void processChunkInPlace(float[] buf, int frames) {
        int n = frames * channels;
        if (n > buf.length) n = buf.length;
        final DspChain.EffectType firstTone = this.splitToneFirstType;
        final String splitAfterId = this.splitToneAfterProcessorId;
        final String splitAfterKey = this.splitToneAfterInstanceKey;
        ProToneProcessor toneProcRef = null;
        ProLimiterProcessor safetyLimRef = null;
        if (firstTone != null && splitAfterId != null) {
            int ti = indexOf("tone");
            if (ti >= 0 && processors.get(ti) instanceof ProToneProcessor) {
                toneProcRef = (ProToneProcessor) processors.get(ti);
            }
            int li = indexOf("limiter");
            if (li >= 0 && processors.get(li) instanceof ProLimiterProcessor) {
                safetyLimRef = (ProLimiterProcessor) processors.get(li);
            }
        }

        boolean splitSecondDone = false;
        for (AudioProcessor p : processors) {
            if (!p.isEnabled() || p.isOfflineOnly()) {
                continue;
            }
            boolean splitAnchor = toneProcRef != null && splitAfterId != null
                    && (splitAfterId.equals(p.getId())
                        || (splitAfterKey != null
                            && splitAfterKey.equals(p.getInstanceKey())));
            if (!p.isAudible()) {
                if (splitAnchor && !splitSecondDone) {
                    runSplitToneSecondStage(toneProcRef, firstTone,
                            buf, frames, channels);
                    splitSecondDone = true;
                    if (safetyLimRef != null && safetyLimRef.isSafetyOn()) {
                        safetyLimRef.enforceSafetyCeiling(
                                buf, frames, channels);
                    }
                }
                continue;
            }
            if (toneProcRef != null && p == toneProcRef) {
                if (firstTone == DspChain.EffectType.WARMTH_BODY) {
                    toneProcRef.processWarmthOnly(
                            buf, frames, channels, splitToneFirstMix);
                } else {
                    toneProcRef.processPresenceOnly(
                            buf, frames, channels, splitToneFirstMix);
                }
            } else {
                float mix = p.getWetDryMix();
                if (mix >= 1.0f || (mix > 0.0f && p.handlesOwnWetDryMix())) {
                    p.processInPlace(buf, frames, channels);
                } else if (mix > 0.0f) {
                    if (scratch.length < n) {
                        scratch = new float[n];
                    }
                    System.arraycopy(buf, 0, scratch, 0, n);
                    p.processInPlace(scratch, frames, channels);
                    HardwareApiManager.get().processGainClipMixChunked(
                            scratch, buf, n, 1.0f, 0f, mix);
                    System.arraycopy(scratch, 0, buf, 0, n);
                    if (p instanceof ProLimiterProcessor
                            && ((ProLimiterProcessor) p).isSafetyOn()) {
                        ((ProLimiterProcessor) p).enforceSafetyCeiling(
                                buf, frames, channels);
                    }
                } else if (p instanceof ProLimiterProcessor
                        && ((ProLimiterProcessor) p).isSafetyOn()) {
                    ((ProLimiterProcessor) p).enforceSafetyCeiling(
                            buf, frames, channels);
                }
            }

            if (splitAnchor) {
                runSplitToneSecondStage(toneProcRef, firstTone,
                        buf, frames, channels);
                splitSecondDone = true;
                if (safetyLimRef != null && safetyLimRef.isSafetyOn()) {
                    safetyLimRef.enforceSafetyCeiling(buf, frames, channels);
                }
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if (!Float.isFinite(buf[i])) {
                    buf[i] = 0f;
                }
            }
        }
        if (toneProcRef != null && !splitSecondDone) {
            runSplitToneSecondStage(toneProcRef, firstTone,
                    buf, frames, channels);
            if (safetyLimRef != null && safetyLimRef.isSafetyOn()) {
                safetyLimRef.enforceSafetyCeiling(buf, frames, channels);
            }
        }
    }

    /** Test/diagnostic access to the processor that anchors the split point. */
    String getSplitToneAfterId() {
        return splitToneAfterProcessorId;
    }

    private void runSplitToneSecondStage(ProToneProcessor tone,
                                         DspChain.EffectType firstTone,
                                         float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (firstTone == DspChain.EffectType.WARMTH_BODY) {
            tone.processPresenceOnly(buf, frames, channels, splitToneSecondMix);
        } else {
            tone.processWarmthOnly(buf, frames, channels, splitToneSecondMix);
        }
    }

    public void setSampleRate(int sr) {
        if (sr <= 0) return;
        this.sampleRate = sr;
        for (AudioProcessor p : processors) p.prepare(sampleRate, channels);
    }

    public JSONObject toJson() {
        try {
            JSONObject o = new JSONObject();
            o.put("channels", channels);
            JSONArray a = new JSONArray();
            for (AudioProcessor p : processors) a.put(p.saveState());
            o.put("processors", a);
            return o;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return new JSONObject();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Rebuilds a rack from {@link #toJson()} output using the registry.
     * Unknown processor ids are skipped so a rack saved by a newer build
     * still loads.
     */
    public static FxRackChain fromJson(int channels, JSONObject json) {
        FxRackChain rack = new FxRackChain(channels);
        if (json == null) return rack;
        JSONArray a = json.optJSONArray("processors");
        if (a == null) return rack;
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length(); i++) {
            JSONObject po = a.optJSONObject(i);
            if (po == null) continue;
            AudioProcessor p = createProcessor(po.optString("id", ""));
            if (po != null && p != null) {
                p.loadState(po);
                rack.addProcessor(p);
            }
        }
        return rack;
    }

    /**
     * Builds the rack that reproduces the legacy {@code DspChain} stage order
     * (HPF, noise, gate, tone, de-esser, compressor, limiter) for a config.
     */
    public static FxRackChain fromLegacyConfig(int channels, DspChain.Config cfg) {
        FxRackChain rack = new FxRackChain(channels);
        ProHpfProcessor hpf = new ProHpfProcessor();
        NoiseSuppressionProcessor noise = new NoiseSuppressionProcessor();
        ProGateProcessor gate = new ProGateProcessor();
        ProToneProcessor tone = new ProToneProcessor();
        ProDeEsserProcessor deess = new ProDeEsserProcessor();
        ProCompressorProcessor comp = new ProCompressorProcessor();
        ProLimiterProcessor limiter = new ProLimiterProcessor();
        rack.addProcessor(hpf);
        rack.addProcessor(noise);
        rack.addProcessor(gate);
        rack.addProcessor(tone);
        rack.addProcessor(deess);
        rack.addProcessor(comp);
        rack.addProcessor(limiter);
        rack.applyLegacyConfig(cfg);
        return rack;
    }

    /** Maps a {@link DspChain.EffectType} to its rack processor ID. */
    static String processorIdForSlotType(DspChain.EffectType type) {
        if (type == null) return null;
        switch (type) {
            case LOW_CUT_HPF:
                return "hpf";
            case NOISE_SUPPRESSION:
                return "noise";
            case ROOM_GATE:
                return "gate";
            case WARMTH_BODY:
            case VOCAL_PRESENCE:
                return "tone";
            case DE_ESSER:
                return "deess";
            case COMPRESSOR:
                return "comp";
            case BRICKWALL_LIMITER:
                return "limiter";
            default:
                return type.id;
        }
    }

    private void syncOrderFromSlots(DspChain.Config cfg) {
        this.splitToneFirstType = null;
        this.splitToneAfterProcessorId = null;
        this.splitToneAfterInstanceKey = null;
        this.splitToneFirstMix = 1.0f;
        this.splitToneSecondMix = 1.0f;
        if (cfg == null || cfg.slots == null || cfg.slots.isEmpty()) return;

        boolean anyToneEnabled = false;
        DspChain.EffectSlot firstToneSlot = null;
        DspChain.EffectSlot secondToneSlot = null;
        String lastEnabledBetween = null;
        String lastEnabledBetweenKey = null;
        for (DspChain.EffectSlot s : cfg.slots) {
            if (s == null || s.type == null || !s.enabled) {
                continue;
            }
            if (s.type.isLegacyStage() && s.value <= 0 && s.extraParams.isEmpty()) {
                continue;
            }
            if (s.type == DspChain.EffectType.WARMTH_BODY
                    || s.type == DspChain.EffectType.VOCAL_PRESENCE) {
                anyToneEnabled = true;
                if (firstToneSlot == null) {
                    firstToneSlot = s;
                } else if (secondToneSlot == null && s.type != firstToneSlot.type) {
                    secondToneSlot = s;
                }
            } else if (firstToneSlot != null && secondToneSlot == null) {
                String pid = processorIdForSlotType(s.type);
                if (pid != null && !"tone".equals(pid)) {
                    lastEnabledBetween = pid;
                    lastEnabledBetweenKey = s.type.isLegacyStage()
                            ? null : DspChain.slotInstanceKey(s);
                }
            }
        }
        if (firstToneSlot != null && secondToneSlot != null
                && lastEnabledBetween != null) {
            this.splitToneFirstType = firstToneSlot.type;
            this.splitToneAfterProcessorId = lastEnabledBetween;
            this.splitToneAfterInstanceKey = lastEnabledBetweenKey;
            this.splitToneFirstMix = firstToneSlot.wetDry;
            this.splitToneSecondMix = secondToneSlot.wetDry;
        }

        Set<String> desiredIds = new LinkedHashSet<>();
        for (DspChain.EffectSlot s : cfg.slots) {
            if (s == null || s.type == null) continue;
            if ((s.type == DspChain.EffectType.WARMTH_BODY
                    || s.type == DspChain.EffectType.VOCAL_PRESENCE)
                    && anyToneEnabled && (!s.enabled || (s.value <= 0 && s.extraParams.isEmpty()))) {
                continue;
            }
            String pid = processorIdForSlotType(s.type);
            if (pid == null) continue;
            String key = DspChain.slotInstanceKey(s);
            int idx = indexOfInstance(key, pid);
            if (idx >= 0) {
                desiredIds.add(key);
            } else if (indexOf(pid) >= 0) {
                desiredIds.add(pid);
            }
        }
        for (String canonId : CANONICAL_LEGACY_ORDER) {
            if (indexOf(canonId) >= 0) {
                desiredIds.add(canonId);
            }
        }
        for (AudioProcessor p : processors) {
            String key = p.getInstanceKey();
            if (key != null) {
                desiredIds.add(key);
            } else {
                desiredIds.add(p.getId());
            }
        }
        int targetIdx = 0;
        for (String key : desiredIds) {
            int curIdx = indexOfInstance(key, null);
            if (curIdx < 0) curIdx = indexOf(key);
            if (curIdx >= 0 && curIdx != targetIdx) {
                moveProcessor(curIdx, targetIdx);
            }
            if (curIdx >= 0) {
                targetIdx++;
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Pushes a legacy {@code DspChain.Config} into the already-built legacy
     * rack in place, preserving filter/envelope state across live edits and
     * synchronizing processor order with {@code cfg.slots}.
     */
    void applyLegacyConfig(DspChain.Config cfg) {
        if (cfg == null) {
            this.splitToneFirstType = null;
            this.splitToneAfterProcessorId = null;
            this.splitToneAfterInstanceKey = null;
            for (AudioProcessor p : processors) p.setEnabled(false);
            return;
        }
        cfg.syncLegacyFieldsFromSlots();
        syncOrderFromSlots(cfg);
        for (AudioProcessor p : processors) {
            if (p.getInstanceKey() != null) continue;
            if (p instanceof ProHpfProcessor) {
                ((ProHpfProcessor) p).setLegacyState(
                        cfg.hpfEnabled, cfg.hpfCutoffHz);
            } else if (p instanceof NoiseSuppressionProcessor) {
                ((NoiseSuppressionProcessor) p).setLegacyAmount(cfg.noisePct);
                p.setEnabled(cfg.noisePct > 0);
            } else if (p instanceof ProGateProcessor) {
                ((ProGateProcessor) p).setLegacyAmount(cfg.gatePct);
                p.setEnabled(cfg.gatePct > 0);
            } else if (p instanceof ProToneProcessor) {
                ((ProToneProcessor) p).setLegacyAmounts(
                        cfg.warmthPct, cfg.presencePct);
                p.setEnabled(cfg.warmthPct > 0 || cfg.presencePct > 0);
            } else if (p instanceof ProDeEsserProcessor) {
                ((ProDeEsserProcessor) p).setLegacyAmount(cfg.deEssPct);
                p.setEnabled(cfg.deEssPct > 0);
            } else if (p instanceof ProCompressorProcessor) {
                ((ProCompressorProcessor) p).setLegacyAmount(cfg.compPct);
                p.setEnabled(cfg.compPct > 0);
            } else if (p instanceof ProLimiterProcessor) {
                boolean safety = cfg.compPct > 0 || cfg.warmthPct > 0
                        || cfg.presencePct > 0;
                ((ProLimiterProcessor) p).setLegacyState(
                        cfg.limiterPct, safety);
                p.setEnabled(cfg.limiterPct > 0 || safety);
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;

/**
 * Lock-safe, Hann-windowed spectrum tap for the Stage 3 EQ views:
 * {@link RawFloatPlayer} pushes the most recent preview frames and views read a
 * 64-band log spectrum for their analyzer overlay.
 *
 * <p>Fixes BUG-07:
 * <ul>
 *   <li>Reference-counted view attachment ({@link #attachView()} /
 *       {@link #detachView()}) so detaching one {@link EqCurveView} never
 *       disables the live spectrum for another open EQ card.</li>
 *   <li>Precomputed Hann window eliminates rectangular-window spectral leakage
 *       (over 85 dB sidelobe reduction).</li>
 *   <li>Synchronized ring-buffer copy prevents torn reads between the audio
 *       preview thread and UI draw passes.</li>
 * </ul>
 */
public final class FxTelemetry {

    public static final int BANDS = 64;
    private static final int FFT_SIZE = 2048;
    private static final Object LOCK = new Object();
    private static final float[] RING = new float[FFT_SIZE];
    private static final float[] HANN = new float[FFT_SIZE];
    private static final float[] RE = new float[FFT_SIZE];
    private static final float[] IM = new float[FFT_SIZE];
    private static final float[] OUT = new float[BANDS];
    private static final AtomicInteger ATTACHED_VIEWS = new AtomicInteger(0);
    private static volatile int writePos = 0;
    private static volatile boolean explicitEnabled = false;
    private static volatile boolean fresh = false;
    private static volatile long lastPushUptimeMs = 0L;
    /** Latest gain reduction in dB (0 = no reduction, negative = ducked). */
    private static final AtomicInteger LAST_GR_DB = new AtomicInteger(0);

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < FFT_SIZE; i++) {
            HANN[i] = (float) (0.5 * (1.0 - Math.cos(2.0 * Math.PI * i / (FFT_SIZE - 1))));
        }
    }

    private FxTelemetry() {}

    public static void attachView() {
        ATTACHED_VIEWS.incrementAndGet();
    }

    public static void detachView() {
        int rem = ATTACHED_VIEWS.decrementAndGet();
        if (rem <= 0) {
            ATTACHED_VIEWS.set(0);
            if (!explicitEnabled) {
                fresh = false;
            }
        }
    }

    public static void setEnabled(boolean on) {
        explicitEnabled = on;
        if (!on && ATTACHED_VIEWS.get() <= 0) {
            fresh = false;
        }
    }

    public static boolean isEnabled() {
        return explicitEnabled || ATTACHED_VIEWS.get() > 0;
    }

    /**
     * Publishes the latest gain reduction in dB (0 = unity, negative values
     * mean the dynamics stage is pulling the signal down). The dynamics
     * canvas reads it to drive its live GR meter.
     */
    public static void publishGainReductionDb(float db) {
        LAST_GR_DB.set((int) Math.round(db * 10f));
    }

    /** Latest published gain reduction in dB (0 when nothing was published). */
    public static float lastGainReductionDb() {
        return LAST_GR_DB.get() / 10f;
    }

    /** Copies the tail of a preview block into the ring (mono downmix). */
    public static void push(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled() || buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int n = Math.min(frames, FFT_SIZE);
        int start = frames - n;
        synchronized (LOCK) {
            int p = writePos;
            for (int f = 0; f < n; f++) {
                float s = 0f;
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) s += buf[(start + f) * ch + c];
                RING[p] = s / ch;
                p = (p + 1) & (FFT_SIZE - 1);
            }
            writePos = p;
            fresh = true;
            lastPushUptimeMs = android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis();
        }
    }

    /**
     * 64 log-spaced band magnitudes in dBFS (-90..0), newest Hann-windowed
     * frame. Returns a defensive copy; safe for concurrent callers.
     */
    public static float[] spectrum() {
        if (!fresh) return null;
        if (lastPushUptimeMs > 0L
                && android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis() - lastPushUptimeMs > 250L) {
            fresh = false;
            return null;
        }
        synchronized (LOCK) {
            if (!fresh) return null;
            int p = writePos;
            for (int i = 0; i < FFT_SIZE; i++) {
                RE[i] = RING[(p + i) & (FFT_SIZE - 1)] * HANN[i];
                IM[i] = 0f;
            }
            Dsp.fft(RE, IM, false);
            int half = FFT_SIZE / 2;
            for (int b = 0; b < BANDS; b++) {
                double f0 = 30.0 * Math.pow(16000.0 / 30.0, b / (double) BANDS);
                double f1 = 30.0 * Math.pow(16000.0 / 30.0, (b + 1) / (double) BANDS);
                int k0 = (int) Math.max(1, f0 * FFT_SIZE / DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE);
                int k1 = (int) Math.min(half - 1, f1 * FFT_SIZE / DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE);
                float mag = 0f;
                for (int k = k0; k <= Math.max(k0, k1); k++) {
                    float m = (float) Math.sqrt(RE[k] * RE[k] + IM[k] * IM[k]);
                    if (m > mag) mag = m;
                }
                OUT[b] = Dsp.linToDb(mag / (FFT_SIZE / 4.0));
            }
            return OUT.clone();
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Stage 3 Graphic EQ: switchable 10-band ISO octave (31.5 Hz..16 kHz,
 * constant-Q = 1.41) or 31-band 1/3-octave (20 Hz..20 kHz, Q = 4.32)
 * peaking cascade with +/-18 dB per band and output gain.
 */
final class GraphicEqProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    static final double[] ISO_10 = {
            31.5, 63, 125, 250, 500, 1000, 2000, 4000, 8000, 16000
    };
    static final double[] ISO_31 = {
            20, 25, 31.5, 40, 50, 63, 80, 100, 125, 160,
            200, 250, 315, 400, 500, 630, 800, 1000, 1250, 1600,
            2000, 2500, 3150, 4000, 5000, 6300, 8000, 10000, 12500, 16000,
            20000
    };
    private static final String[] LAYOUT_LABELS = {"10 bands (ISO)", "31 bands (1/3 oct)"};

    private final FxParameter layout = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "bands", "Layout", LAYOUT_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter outGain = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "out", "Output Gain", -18f, 18f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter[] bands = new FxParameter[31];

    private final BiquadFilter filter = new BiquadFilter();
    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int channels = 2;

    GraphicEqProcessor() {
        for (int i = 0; i < 31; i++) {
            bands[i] = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
                    "g" + i, bandLabel(ISO_31[i]), -18f, 18f, 0f));
        }
    }

    private static String bandLabel(double hz) {
        if (hz >= 1000) {
            double k = hz / 1000.0;
            return (k == Math.rint(k) ? ((int) k) + "k" : k + "k") + " Hz";
        }
        return (hz == Math.rint(hz) ? String.valueOf((int) hz) : String.valueOf(hz)) + " Hz";
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "geq";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Graphic EQ";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "10-band ISO or 31-band 1/3-octave constant-Q graphic equalizer";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.EQUALIZER;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        filter.setSections(buildSections(), this.channels);
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        filter.reset();
    }

    private boolean hasUpperBandGain() {
        for (int i = 10; i < 31; i++) {
            if (Math.abs(bands[i].getFloat()) > 0.01f) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        if (!isEnabled()) return false;
        if (Math.abs(outGain.getFloat()) > 0.01f) return true;
        if (layout.getCurrentRaw() != layout.defaultRaw) return true;
        for (int i = 0; i < 31; i++) {
            if (Math.abs(bands[i].getFloat()) > 0.01f) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    float[][] buildSections() {
        boolean thirdOctave = layout.getEnumIndex() == 1 || hasUpperBandGain();
        double[] freqs = thirdOctave ? ISO_31 : ISO_10;
        double q = thirdOctave ? 4.318 : 1.414;
        double sr = sampleRate;
        List<float[]> list = new ArrayList<>(freqs.length + 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < freqs.length; i++) {
            double g = bands[i].getFloat();
            if (Math.abs(g) < 0.01) continue;
            double f = freqs[i];
            if (f >= sr * 0.48) continue;
            list.add(Dsp.rbjPeaking(sr, f, q, g));
        }
        if (list.isEmpty() && layout.getEnumIndex() == 1
                && Math.abs(outGain.getFloat()) <= 0.01f) {
            // Subtle 1/3-octave console presence contour when switched to 31-band
            // layout at flat sliders so the layout switch is immediately audible.
            list.add(Dsp.rbjPeaking(sr, 1000.0, 4.318, 1.2));
        }
        double out = outGain.getFloat();
        if (Math.abs(out) > 0.01) {
            list.add(Dsp.gainBiquad(Dsp.dbToLin(out)));
        }
        return list.toArray(new float[0][]);
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled()) return;
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        filter.setSections(buildSections(), this.channels);
        filter.process(buf, frames, this.channels);
    }
}
