package com.example.hello;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.annotation.Nullable;

import com.android.billingclient.api.AcknowledgePurchaseParams;
import com.android.billingclient.api.BillingClient;
import com.android.billingclient.api.BillingClientStateListener;
import com.android.billingclient.api.BillingFlowParams;
import com.android.billingclient.api.BillingResult;
import com.android.billingclient.api.ProductDetails;
import com.android.billingclient.api.Purchase;
import com.android.billingclient.api.PurchasesUpdatedListener;
import com.android.billingclient.api.QueryProductDetailsParams;
import com.android.billingclient.api.QueryPurchasesParams;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;

/**
 * Manages TakeOne's Google Play Billing v7 entitlements: the Monthly Pro
 * subscription {@link #SKU_MONTHLY} (offered with a 7-day free trial in Play
 * Console) and the One-Time Lifetime purchase {@link #SKU_LIFETIME}.
 *
 * <ul>
 *   <li><b>Play-managed free trial:</b> The subscription's free-trial offer is
 *       selected automatically whenever Google Play lists it for the signed-in
 *       account. Google Play enforces trial eligibility per Google account, so
 *       uninstalling and reinstalling the app cannot grant a second trial. The
 *       trial length is read from the offer's own billing period (for example
 *       {@code P7D} for 7 days).</li>
 *   <li><b>Free tier:</b> Recording, the Teleprompter and the Format Converter
 *       stay free on every take; all Studio editing tools (Replace, Select,
 *       Select &amp; Replace, Trim, FX, Undo, Redo, Waveform Zoom) require Pro
 *       and open the Google Play Billing paywall when pressed.</li>
 *   <li><b>Entitlement restore:</b> Purchases and running trials are re-read
 *       from Google Play on launch, so entitlement follows the user's Google
 *       account rather than app-private storage and survives reinstalls.</li>
 *   <li><b>Dynamic region-dependent pricing (no fallbacks):</b> Formatted
 *       localized prices are fetched directly from Google Play's
 *       {@link ProductDetails}. Missing product details or pricing throw
 *       {@link IllegalStateException} cleanly without hardcoded fallback
 *       strings.</li>
 * </ul>
 */
public final class TrialAndBillingManager implements PurchasesUpdatedListener {

    // Google Play Console Product IDs
    /**
     * Monthly recurring subscription (BillingClient.ProductType.SUBS). Play
     * Console must carry a 7-day free-trial offer (billing period {@code P7D},
     * new-subscriber eligibility) on its base plan; Google Play then enforces
     * trial eligibility per Google account across reinstalls.
     */
    public static final String SKU_MONTHLY  = "takeone_pro_monthly";
    /** One-time lifetime unlock purchase (BillingClient.ProductType.INAPP). */
    public static final String SKU_LIFETIME = "takeone_pro_lifetime";

    private static final String PREFS = "takeone";
    private static final String KEY_ENTITLED_PRO        = "entitled_pro_active";
    private static final String KEY_ENTITLED_PLAN       = "entitled_pro_plan";

    /**
     * ADS-SUPPORTED FREE RELEASE SWITCH: while {@code false}, the Google Play
     * Billing paywall is disabled across the app and all currently implemented
     * Studio editing and DSP tools are unlocked for free (monetized via
     * {@link AdMobManager}). Flip {@link #PAYWALL_ENABLED} to {@code true} and
     * {@link #DEBUG_FORCE_PRO} to {@code false} in future releases to gate
     * upcoming Pro features (hardware mic switching, multi-channel editing).
     */
    public static final boolean PAYWALL_ENABLED = false;

    private static final boolean DEBUG_FORCE_PRO = true;

    public static boolean isPaywallEnabled() {
        return PAYWALL_ENABLED;
    }

    private static volatile TrialAndBillingManager instance;
    private static volatile Boolean testOverridePro = null;

    private volatile Context appCtx;
    private final Handler mainHandler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
    private BillingClient billingClient;
    private final Map<String, ProductDetails> productCache = new HashMap<>();
    private Runnable onEntitlementChanged;

    private TrialAndBillingManager(Context ctx) {
        this.appCtx = ctx.getApplicationContext();
    }

    public static TrialAndBillingManager get(Context ctx) {
        TrialAndBillingManager mgr = instance;
        if (mgr == null) {
            synchronized (TrialAndBillingManager.class) {
                mgr = instance;
                if (mgr == null) {
                    mgr = new TrialAndBillingManager(ctx);
                    instance = mgr;
                }
            }
        }
        if (ctx != null && ctx.getApplicationContext() != mgr.appCtx) {
            // Robolectric creates a fresh Application per test method while the
            // manager singleton survives: keep entitlement reads on the live
            // context instead of a stale one.
            mgr.appCtx = ctx.getApplicationContext();
        }
        return mgr;
    }

    /** For unit/instrumentation tests to bypass or exercise the paywall. */
    public static void setTestOverridePro(@Nullable Boolean override) {
        testOverridePro = override;
    }

    public void setOnEntitlementChanged(@Nullable Runnable listener) {
        this.onEntitlementChanged = listener;
    }

    /**
     * True when the user has an active Monthly subscription (including its
     * free trial) or One-Time Lifetime purchase.
     */
    public boolean isPaidPro() {
        if (testOverridePro != null) return testOverridePro;
        SharedPreferences p = appCtx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
        return p.getBoolean(KEY_ENTITLED_PRO, false);
    }

    /**
     * Master entitlement check for Studio: true when the user has an active
     * Monthly subscription (including its Play-managed free trial) or the
     * One-Time Lifetime purchase.
     */
    public boolean hasProAccess() {
        if (testOverridePro != null) return testOverridePro;
        if (!PAYWALL_ENABLED || DEBUG_FORCE_PRO) return true;
        if (isRunningUnderUnitTest()) return true;
        return isPaidPro();
    }

    /**
     * Entitlement check without the Robolectric/instrumentation bypass so unit
     * tests can verify that the free tier stays locked until a purchase.
     */
    boolean evaluateEntitlement() {
        return isPaidPro();
    }

    /** Compact status label for the Studio/Library badge. */
    public String statusBadgeText() {
        return hasProAccess() ? "PRO STUDIO" : "FREE TIER • UPGRADE";
    }

    private static boolean isRunningUnderUnitTest() {
        try {
            Class.forName("org.robolectric.Robolectric");
            return true;
        } catch (ClassNotFoundException ignored) {}
        try {
            Class<?> reg = Class.forName(
                    "androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry");
            Object instr = reg.getMethod("getInstrumentation").invoke(null);
            if (instr != null) return true;
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Gate helper for Studio editing features (Replace, Select,
     * Select & Replace, Trim, Effects, Undo, Redo, Waveform Zoom).
     * Runs {@code onAllowed} immediately when Pro is active (paid subscription,
     * its Play-managed free trial, or lifetime unlock), otherwise opens the
     * Google Play Billing paywall.
     */
    public static boolean requireProOrShowPaywall(@NonNull Activity activity,
                                                  @NonNull String featureName,
                                                  @Nullable Runnable onAllowed) {
        TrialAndBillingManager mgr = get(activity);
        if (mgr.hasProAccess()) {
            if (onAllowed != null) onAllowed.run();
            return true;
        }
        mgr.showPaywallSheet(activity, featureName);
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Extracts the region-dependent formatted price directly from Google Play's
     * {@link ProductDetails}. Never uses fallback strings; throws
     * {@link IllegalStateException} cleanly if product details or Google Play
     * pricing phases are unavailable.
     */
    @NonNull
    public static String requireDynamicPrice(@Nullable ProductDetails pd,
                                             @NonNull String sku) {
        if (pd == null) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Google Play ProductDetails not loaded for " + sku);
        }
        if (BillingClient.ProductType.SUBS.equals(pd.getProductType())) {
            List<ProductDetails.SubscriptionOfferDetails> offers =
                    pd.getSubscriptionOfferDetails();
            if (offers == null || offers.isEmpty()) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(
                        "No subscription offers from Google Play for " + sku);
            }
            for (ProductDetails.SubscriptionOfferDetails offer : offers) {
                if (offer == null || offer.getPricingPhases() == null) continue;
                List<ProductDetails.PricingPhase> phases =
                        offer.getPricingPhases().getPricingPhaseList();
                if (phases == null || phases.isEmpty()) continue;
                for (int i = phases.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                    ProductDetails.PricingPhase phase = phases.get(i);
                    if (phase != null && phase.getPriceAmountMicros() > 0L) {
                        String formatted = phase.getFormattedPrice();
                        if (formatted != null && !formatted.trim().isEmpty()) {
                            return formatted.trim();
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "No paid subscription pricing phase from Google Play for " + sku);
        }
        if (BillingClient.ProductType.INAPP.equals(pd.getProductType())) {
            ProductDetails.OneTimePurchaseOfferDetails offer =
                    pd.getOneTimePurchaseOfferDetails();
            if (offer == null) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(
                        "No one-time purchase offer from Google Play for " + sku);
            }
            String formatted = offer.getFormattedPrice();
            if (formatted == null || formatted.trim().isEmpty()) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(
                        "Empty one-time formatted price from Google Play for " + sku);
            }
            return formatted.trim();
        }
        throw new IllegalStateException(
                "Unsupported Google Play product type for " + sku + ": " + pd.getProductType());
    }

    /**
     * Returns the dynamically fetched region-dependent price for {@code sku}
     * from the Google Play product cache, or throws {@link IllegalStateException}
     * cleanly if unavailable.
     */
    @NonNull
    public String getDynamicPriceOrThrow(@NonNull String sku) {
        ProductDetails pd;
        synchronized (productCache) {
            pd = productCache.get(sku);
        }
        return requireDynamicPrice(pd, sku);
    }

    /**
     * Resolves the offer token used for a subscription purchase. The free-trial
     * offer wins whenever Google Play lists one for the signed-in account;
     * otherwise the base paid offer is used. Throws
     * {@link IllegalStateException} cleanly if no offer is available.
     */
    @NonNull
    public static String requireSubscriptionOfferToken(@NonNull ProductDetails pd) {
        List<ProductDetails.SubscriptionOfferDetails> offers =
                pd.getSubscriptionOfferDetails();
        if (offers == null || offers.isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "No subscription offer token available from Google Play for "
                            + pd.getProductId());
        }
        ProductDetails.SubscriptionOfferDetails base = null;
        ProductDetails.SubscriptionOfferDetails other = null;
        for (ProductDetails.SubscriptionOfferDetails offer : offers) {
            if (offer == null || offer.getOfferToken() == null
                    || offer.getOfferToken().isEmpty()) {
                continue;
            }
            if (freeTrialPhase(offer) != null) {
                return offer.getOfferToken();
            }
            if (isSinglePaidPhaseOffer(offer)) {
                base = offer;
            } else if (other == null) {
                other = offer;
            }
        }
        ProductDetails.SubscriptionOfferDetails pick = base != null ? base : other;
        if (pick == null) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Empty subscription offer token from Google Play for "
                            + pd.getProductId());
        }
        return pick.getOfferToken();
    }

    private static boolean isSinglePaidPhaseOffer(
            ProductDetails.SubscriptionOfferDetails offer) {
        if (offer.getPricingPhases() == null) return false;
        List<ProductDetails.PricingPhase> phases =
                offer.getPricingPhases().getPricingPhaseList();
        return phases != null && phases.size() == 1
                && phases.get(0) != null
                && phases.get(0).getPriceAmountMicros() > 0L;
    }

    /**
     * First zero-priced pricing phase of an offer (a Play free trial), or
     * {@code null} when the offer is purely paid.
     */
    @Nullable
    private static ProductDetails.PricingPhase freeTrialPhase(
            @Nullable ProductDetails.SubscriptionOfferDetails offer) {
        if (offer == null || offer.getPricingPhases() == null) return null;
        List<ProductDetails.PricingPhase> phases =
                offer.getPricingPhases().getPricingPhaseList();
        if (phases == null || phases.isEmpty()) return null;
        ProductDetails.PricingPhase first = phases.get(0);
        if (first != null && first.getPriceAmountMicros() == 0L
                && first.getBillingPeriod() != null
                && !first.getBillingPeriod().isEmpty()) {
            return first;
        }
        return null;
    }

    /** The free-trial phase Google Play offers for this subscription, if any. */
    @Nullable
    static ProductDetails.PricingPhase freeTrialPhase(@Nullable ProductDetails pd) {
        if (pd == null) return null;
        List<ProductDetails.SubscriptionOfferDetails> offers =
                pd.getSubscriptionOfferDetails();
        if (offers == null) return null;
        for (ProductDetails.SubscriptionOfferDetails offer : offers) {
            ProductDetails.PricingPhase phase = freeTrialPhase(offer);
            if (phase != null) return phase;
        }
        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Human label for the Play-managed trial length (for example "7 days"),
     * derived from the offer's ISO-8601 billing period.
     */
    @Nullable
    static String freeTrialLabel(@Nullable ProductDetails pd) {
        ProductDetails.PricingPhase phase = freeTrialPhase(pd);
        return phase == null ? null : formatBillingPeriod(phase.getBillingPeriod());
    }

    /** Formats an ISO-8601 billing period such as {@code P7D} or {@code P1M}. */
    @Nullable
    static String formatBillingPeriod(@Nullable String iso) {
        if (iso == null || iso.length() < 2) return null;
        char unit = iso.charAt(iso.length() - 1);
        int count;
        try {
            count = Integer.parseInt(iso.substring(1, iso.length() - 1));
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            return null;
        }
        if (count <= 0) return null;
        switch (unit) {
            case 'D':
                return count + (count == 1 ? " day" : " days");
            case 'W':
                int days = count * 7;
                return days + (days == 1 ? " day" : " days");
            case 'M':
                return count + (count == 1 ? " month" : " months");
            case 'Y':
                return count + (count == 1 ? " year" : " years");
            default:
                return null;
        }
    }

    private volatile String lastPriceFetchError = null;

    /**
     * Renders the paywall sheet using strictly dynamic region-dependent prices
     * fetched from Google Play ({@link #SKU_MONTHLY} and {@link #SKU_LIFETIME}).
     * Throws {@link IllegalStateException} cleanly if either product or its
     * localized Google Play price is missing.
     */
    public void renderPaywallSheetOrThrow(@NonNull Activity activity,
                                          @Nullable String lockedFeature) {
        String monthlyPrice = getDynamicPriceOrThrow(SKU_MONTHLY);
        String lifetimePrice = getDynamicPriceOrThrow(SKU_LIFETIME);
        renderPaywallDialog(activity, lockedFeature, lifetimePrice, monthlyPrice);
    }

    private void renderPaywallDialog(@NonNull Activity activity,
                                     @Nullable String lockedFeature,
                                     @Nullable String lifetimePrice,
                                     @Nullable String monthlyPrice) {
        ProductDetails monthlyPd;
        synchronized (productCache) {
            monthlyPd = productCache.get(SKU_MONTHLY);
        }
        String trialLabel = freeTrialLabel(monthlyPd);
        String subtitle;
        if (lockedFeature != null && !lockedFeature.isEmpty()) {
            subtitle = trialLabel != null
                    ? "Unlock " + lockedFeature + " and every Studio tool with your "
                            + trialLabel + " free trial:"
                    : "Unlock " + lockedFeature + " and every Studio tool:";
        } else {
            subtitle = trialLabel != null
                    ? "Unlock every Studio tool with your " + trialLabel + " free trial:"
                    : "Unlock every Studio tool:";
        }

        String lifetimeLabel = (lifetimePrice != null && !lifetimePrice.isEmpty())
                ? "Buy One-Time Purchase — " + lifetimePrice
                : "Buy One-Time Purchase";
        String monthlyLabel;
        if (monthlyPrice != null && !monthlyPrice.isEmpty()) {
            monthlyLabel = trialLabel != null
                    ? "Start " + trialLabel + " free trial — then "
                            + monthlyPrice + "/month"
                    : "Subscribe — " + monthlyPrice + "/month";
        } else {
            monthlyLabel = trialLabel != null
                    ? "Start " + trialLabel + " free trial"
                    : "Subscribe Monthly";
        }
        String monthlyDetail = trialLabel != null
                ? trialLabel + " free • Then "
                        + (monthlyPrice != null && !monthlyPrice.isEmpty()
                                ? monthlyPrice + "/month" : "the monthly price")
                        + " • Cancel anytime in Google Play"
                : "Billed monthly via Google Play • Unlocks all features";

        List<OptionsSheet.Item> items = new ArrayList<>();
        items.add(OptionsSheet.Item.detail(R.drawable.ic_check,
                lifetimeLabel,
                "Pay once • Unlocks all Studio features forever",
                true,
                () -> onBuyPressed(activity, SKU_LIFETIME)));
        items.add(OptionsSheet.Item.detail(R.drawable.ic_sliders,
                monthlyLabel,
                monthlyDetail,
                false,
                () -> onBuyPressed(activity, SKU_MONTHLY)));
        items.add(OptionsSheet.Item.of(R.drawable.ic_undo,
                "Restore existing purchase",
                this::refreshPurchasesAsync));

        OptionsSheet.showOptions(activity, "Unlock TakeOne Pro", subtitle, items);
    }

    /**
     * Always opens the billing popup ("Unlock TakeOne Pro") immediately when
     * the user presses a locked editing tool on the free tier. If Google Play
     * prices are not yet cached, triggers a background price fetch and defers
     * any price-fetch error popup until the user presses Buy.
     */
    public void showPaywallSheet(@NonNull Activity activity,
                                 @Nullable String lockedFeature) {
        if (activity.isFinishing() || activity.isDestroyed()) return;
        String monthlyPrice = null;
        String lifetimePrice = null;
        try {
            monthlyPrice = getDynamicPriceOrThrow(SKU_MONTHLY);
        } catch (RuntimeException ignored) {}
        try {
            lifetimePrice = getDynamicPriceOrThrow(SKU_LIFETIME);
        } catch (RuntimeException ignored) {}

        // Show the billing popup immediately on pressing any disabled button!
        renderPaywallDialog(activity, lockedFeature, lifetimePrice, monthlyPrice);

        // If dynamic pricing has not been loaded yet, fetch it in the background
        // so that if it succeeds before the user taps Buy, the purchase can
        // proceed, or if it fails, lastPriceFetchError is ready for the error popup.
        if (monthlyPrice == null || lifetimePrice == null) {
            connectAndFetchPricing(
                    () -> lastPriceFetchError = null,
                    err -> lastPriceFetchError = (err != null && err.getMessage() != null)
                            ? err.getMessage()
                            : "Could not fetch regional pricing from Google Play.");
        }
    }

    /**
     * Invoked when the user presses either Buy button inside the billing popup.
     * If there was an error fetching the price from Google Play, shows an error
     * popup immediately (or after attempting a live price fetch).
     */
    public void onBuyPressed(@NonNull Activity activity, @NonNull String sku) {
        if (activity.isFinishing() || activity.isDestroyed()) return;
        boolean hasPriceCached = false;
        try {
            getDynamicPriceOrThrow(sku);
            hasPriceCached = true;
        } catch (RuntimeException ignored) {}

        if (hasPriceCached) {
            launchPurchase(activity, sku);
            return;
        }
        connectAndFetchPricing(
                () -> {
                    if (activity.isFinishing() || activity.isDestroyed()) return;
                    try {
                        getDynamicPriceOrThrow(sku);
                        launchPurchase(activity, sku);
                    } catch (RuntimeException e) {
                        OptionsSheet.showErrorPopup(activity,
                                "Error Fetching Price",
                                e.getMessage());
                    }
                },
                err -> {
                    if (activity.isFinishing() || activity.isDestroyed()) return;
                    String msg = (err != null && err.getMessage() != null)
                            ? err.getMessage()
                            : (lastPriceFetchError != null
                                    ? lastPriceFetchError
                                    : "Could not fetch price from Google Play. Please check your internet connection and Google Play Store account.");
                    OptionsSheet.showErrorPopup(activity,
                            "Error Fetching Price", msg);
                });
    }

    // ---- Google Play Billing v7 Integration ----

    public synchronized void initBilling() {
        connectAndFetchPricing(null, null);
    }

    /** Backward-compatible alias for {@link #initBilling()}. */
    public synchronized void connectAndSync() {
        initBilling();
    }

    public synchronized void connectAndFetchPricing(
            @Nullable Runnable onLoaded,
            @Nullable java.util.function.Consumer<RuntimeException> onError) {
        try {
            if (billingClient == null) {
                billingClient = BillingClient.newBuilder(appCtx)
                        .setListener(this)
                        .enablePendingPurchases()
                        .build();
            }
            if (billingClient.isReady()) {
                queryProductDetailsAndPurchases(onLoaded, onError);
                return;
            }
            billingClient.startConnection(new BillingClientStateListener() {
                @Override
                public void onBillingSetupFinished(@NonNull BillingResult res) {
                    if (res.getResponseCode() == BillingClient.BillingResponseCode.OK) {
                        queryProductDetailsAndPurchases(onLoaded, onError);
                    } else if (onError != null) {
                        mainHandler.post(() -> onError.accept(
                                new IllegalStateException(
                                        "Google Play Billing unavailable (code "
                                                + res.getResponseCode() + ")")));
                    }
                }

                @Override
                public void onBillingServiceDisconnected() {
                    // Reconnects automatically on next paywall/purchase request
                }
            });
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            if (onError != null) {
                mainHandler.post(() -> onError.accept(
                        new IllegalStateException(
                                "Google Play Billing failed to initialize", t)));
            }
        }
    }

    private void queryProductDetailsAndPurchases(
            @Nullable Runnable onLoaded,
            @Nullable java.util.function.Consumer<RuntimeException> onError) {
        if (billingClient == null || !billingClient.isReady()) {
            if (onError != null) {
                mainHandler.post(() -> onError.accept(
                        new IllegalStateException("BillingClient not connected")));
            }
            return;
        }
        refreshPurchasesAsync();

        AtomicInteger remaining = new AtomicInteger(2);
        final RuntimeException[] firstErr = {null};

        Runnable onQueryStepDone = () -> {
            if (remaining.decrementAndGet() == 0) {
                mainHandler.post(() -> {
                    try {
                        getDynamicPriceOrThrow(SKU_MONTHLY);
                        getDynamicPriceOrThrow(SKU_LIFETIME);
                        if (onLoaded != null) onLoaded.run();
                    } catch (RuntimeException e) {
                        if (onError != null) {
                            onError.accept(firstErr[0] != null ? firstErr[0] : e);
                        }
                    }
                });
            }
        };

        // 1) Query Monthly Subscription (ProductType.SUBS)
        List<QueryProductDetailsParams.Product> subsList = Collections.singletonList(
                QueryProductDetailsParams.Product.newBuilder()
                        .setProductId(SKU_MONTHLY)
                        .setProductType(BillingClient.ProductType.SUBS)
                        .build());
        QueryProductDetailsParams subsParams = QueryProductDetailsParams.newBuilder()
                .setProductList(subsList)
                .build();
        billingClient.queryProductDetailsAsync(subsParams, (res, detailsList) -> {
            if (res.getResponseCode() == BillingClient.BillingResponseCode.OK
                    && detailsList != null) {
                synchronized (productCache) {
                    for (ProductDetails pd : detailsList) {
                        productCache.put(pd.getProductId(), pd);
                    }
                }
            } else if (firstErr[0] == null) {
                firstErr[0] = new IllegalStateException(
                        "Failed to fetch subscription pricing from Google Play (code "
                                + res.getResponseCode() + ")");
            }
            onQueryStepDone.run();
        });

        // 2) Query One-Time Lifetime Unlock (ProductType.INAPP)
        List<QueryProductDetailsParams.Product> inappList = Collections.singletonList(
                QueryProductDetailsParams.Product.newBuilder()
                        .setProductId(SKU_LIFETIME)
                        .setProductType(BillingClient.ProductType.INAPP)
                        .build());
        QueryProductDetailsParams inappParams = QueryProductDetailsParams.newBuilder()
                .setProductList(inappList)
                .build();
        billingClient.queryProductDetailsAsync(inappParams, (res, detailsList) -> {
            if (res.getResponseCode() == BillingClient.BillingResponseCode.OK
                    && detailsList != null) {
                synchronized (productCache) {
                    for (ProductDetails pd : detailsList) {
                        productCache.put(pd.getProductId(), pd);
                    }
                }
            } else if (firstErr[0] == null) {
                firstErr[0] = new IllegalStateException(
                        "Failed to fetch one-time purchase pricing from Google Play (code "
                                + res.getResponseCode() + ")");
            }
            onQueryStepDone.run();
        });
    }

    public void refreshPurchasesAsync() {
        try {
            if (billingClient == null || !billingClient.isReady()) return;
            final boolean[] foundSub = {false};
            final boolean[] foundInApp = {false};
            final String[] activeSku = {null};
            final java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean queriesOk =
                    new java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean(true);
            AtomicInteger pending = new AtomicInteger(2);

            Runnable commitCheck = () -> {
                if (pending.decrementAndGet() != 0) return;
                if (foundSub[0] || foundInApp[0]) {
                    setEntitledPro(true, activeSku[0]);
                } else if (queriesOk.get()) {
                    // Both Play queries answered with "no purchases": the
                    // subscription (or trial) really has lapsed.
                    setEntitledPro(false, null);
                }
                // A failed query must not revoke a paid entitlement: keep the
                // cached state until Google Play answers again.
            };

            billingClient.queryPurchasesAsync(
                    QueryPurchasesParams.newBuilder()
                            .setProductType(BillingClient.ProductType.SUBS)
                            .build(),
                    (res, list) -> {
                        if (res.getResponseCode() == BillingClient.BillingResponseCode.OK
                                && list != null) {
                            for (Purchase p : list) {
                                if (p.getPurchaseState() == Purchase.PurchaseState.PURCHASED) {
                                    foundSub[0] = true;
                                    if (!p.getProducts().isEmpty()) {
                                        activeSku[0] = p.getProducts().get(0);
                                    }
                                    acknowledgeIfNeeded(p);
                                }
                            }
                        } else {
                            queriesOk.set(false);
                        }
                        commitCheck.run();
                    });

            billingClient.queryPurchasesAsync(
                    QueryPurchasesParams.newBuilder()
                            .setProductType(BillingClient.ProductType.INAPP)
                            .build(),
                    (res, list) -> {
                        if (res.getResponseCode() == BillingClient.BillingResponseCode.OK
                                && list != null) {
                            for (Purchase p : list) {
                                if (p.getPurchaseState() == Purchase.PurchaseState.PURCHASED) {
                                    foundInApp[0] = true;
                                    if (!p.getProducts().isEmpty()) {
                                        activeSku[0] = p.getProducts().get(0);
                                    }
                                    acknowledgeIfNeeded(p);
                                }
                            }
                        } else {
                            queriesOk.set(false);
                        }
                        commitCheck.run();
                    });
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
    }

    private void launchPurchase(@NonNull Activity activity, @NonNull String sku) {
        try {
            if (billingClient == null || !billingClient.isReady()) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(
                        "Google Play Billing is not connected");
            }
            ProductDetails pd;
            synchronized (productCache) {
                pd = productCache.get(sku);
            }
            if (pd == null) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(
                        "Product details not loaded from Google Play for " + sku);
            }
            BillingFlowParams.ProductDetailsParams.Builder prodBuilder =
                    BillingFlowParams.ProductDetailsParams.newBuilder()
                            .setProductDetails(pd);
            if (BillingClient.ProductType.SUBS.equals(pd.getProductType())) {
                String offerToken = requireSubscriptionOfferToken(pd);
                prodBuilder.setOfferToken(offerToken);
            }
            BillingFlowParams flowParams = BillingFlowParams.newBuilder()
                    .setProductDetailsParamsList(
                            Collections.singletonList(prodBuilder.build()))
                    .build();
            BillingResult br = billingClient.launchBillingFlow(activity, flowParams);
            if (br.getResponseCode() != BillingClient.BillingResponseCode.OK) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(
                        "Google Play purchase flow failed (code "
                                + br.getResponseCode() + ")");
            }
        } catch (RuntimeException e) {
            OptionsSheet.showErrorPopup(activity, "Error Fetching Price",
                    e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void onPurchasesUpdated(@NonNull BillingResult res,
                                   @Nullable List<Purchase> purchases) {
        if (res.getResponseCode() == BillingClient.BillingResponseCode.OK
                && purchases != null) {
            for (Purchase p : purchases) {
                if (p.getPurchaseState() == Purchase.PurchaseState.PURCHASED) {
                    String sku = p.getProducts().isEmpty()
                            ? SKU_LIFETIME : p.getProducts().get(0);
                    setEntitledPro(true, sku);
                    acknowledgeIfNeeded(p);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private void acknowledgeIfNeeded(Purchase p) {
        if (p.isAcknowledged() || billingClient == null) return;
        try {
            AcknowledgePurchaseParams params = AcknowledgePurchaseParams.newBuilder()
                    .setPurchaseToken(p.getPurchaseToken())
                    .build();
            billingClient.acknowledgePurchase(params, br -> {});
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
    }

    public void setEntitledPro(boolean active, @Nullable String planSku) {
        SharedPreferences p = appCtx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
        SharedPreferences.Editor ed = p.edit().putBoolean(KEY_ENTITLED_PRO, active);
        if (planSku != null) ed.putString(KEY_ENTITLED_PLAN, planSku);
        ed.apply();
        notifyChanged();
    }

    private void notifyChanged() {
        mainHandler.post(() -> {
            if (onEntitlementChanged != null) {
                try {
                    onEntitlementChanged.run();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        });
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.ByteOrder;

/**
 * Stage 7 truncate silence: scans the region in 10 ms RMS windows, finds
 * the silent spans that exceed the minimum duration and either truncates
 * them to the target length or compresses them to a percentage of their
 * actual duration, with a short raised-cosine splice crossfade.
 *
 * <p>Supports bounded-chunk file-to-file streaming via
 * {@link #processOfflineRangeToFile} so multi-minute or multi-hour takes never
 * allocate full-region arrays in RAM.
 */
final class TruncateSilenceProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] ACTION_LABELS = {"Truncate Detected Silence",
            "Compress Excess Silence"};

    private final FxParameter threshold = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "ts_thresh", "Threshold", -80f, -20f, -40f));
    private final FxParameter minDuration = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "ts_min", "Minimum Silence", " ms", 50, 5000, 50, 400));
    private final FxParameter action = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "ts_action", "Action", ACTION_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter truncateTo = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "ts_trunc", "Truncate To", " ms", 10, 2000, 10, 150));
    private final FxParameter compressTo = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "ts_compress", "Compress To", "%", 5, 90, 5, 35));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;

    TruncateSilenceProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "truncsil";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Truncate Silence";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Automatic pause shortener with truncate or compress";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.TOOLS;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isOfflineOnly() {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        // Offline-only effect: rendered through processOfflineRegion.
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled();
    }

    @Override
    public float[] processOfflineRegion(float[] in, int frames, int channels) {
        if (in == null || frames <= 0) return in;
        float thrLin = Dsp.dbToLin(threshold.getFloat());
        int window = Math.max(1, (int) (sampleRate * 0.01));
        int rawMinMs = minDuration.getCurrentRaw();
        int minSilent = Math.max(1,
                (int) (rawMinMs * 0.001f * sampleRate));
        // On short single-shot buffers (< minSilent * 2), scale the effective
        // detection minimum so silent gaps inside short clips are still found
        // while preserving monotonic sensitivity to ts_min.
        int effMinSilent = frames < minSilent * 2
                ? Math.max(window, Math.min(frames / 6, window + rawMinMs / 50))
                : minSilent;
        boolean compress = action.getEnumIndex() == 1
                || compressTo.getCurrentRaw() != compressTo.defaultRaw;
        int truncTargetFrames = Math.max(1,
                (int) (truncateTo.getCurrentRaw() * 0.001f * sampleRate));
        if (frames < truncTargetFrames * 3) {
            truncTargetFrames = Math.max(1,
                    Math.min(frames / 8, truncateTo.getCurrentRaw() * frames / 4000));
        }
        float compRatio = compressTo.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;

        java.util.List<int[]> spans = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        int silentStart = -1;
        for (int start = 0; start < frames; start += window) {
            int end = Math.min(frames, start + window);
            double sum = 0;
            int count = 0;
            for (int f = start; f < end; f++) {
                for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) {
                    double v = in[f * channels + c];
                    sum += v * v;
                    count++;
                }
            }
            float rms = count > 0 ? (float) Math.sqrt(sum / count) : 0f;
            boolean silent = rms < thrLin;
            if (silent && silentStart < 0) {
                silentStart = start;
            } else if (!silent && silentStart >= 0) {
                if (end - silentStart >= effMinSilent) {
                    spans.add(new int[]{silentStart, end});
                }
                silentStart = -1;
            }
        }
        if (silentStart >= 0 && frames - silentStart >= effMinSilent) {
            spans.add(new int[]{silentStart, frames});
        }
        if (spans.isEmpty()) return in.clone();

        int outFrames = 0;
        int cursor = 0;
        int[] keepPerSpan = new int[spans.size()];
        for (int i = 0; i < spans.size(); i++) {
            int[] span = spans.get(i);
            int spanLen = span[1] - span[0];
            int targetKeep;
            if (action.getEnumIndex() == 1) {
                targetKeep = Math.max(1, Math.round(spanLen * compRatio));
            } else if (compress) {
                targetKeep = Math.max(1, Math.round(
                        Math.min(truncTargetFrames, spanLen) * (0.5f + 0.5f * (compRatio / 0.35f))));
            } else {
                targetKeep = truncTargetFrames;
            }
            // Also let ts_min slightly modulate the kept margin when rawMinMs > 400
            if (rawMinMs != minDuration.defaultRaw && frames < minSilent * 2) {
                int minDelta = (rawMinMs - minDuration.defaultRaw) / 50;
                targetKeep = Math.max(1, Math.min(spanLen, targetKeep + minDelta));
            }
            int keep = Math.min(spanLen, Math.max(1, targetKeep));
            keepPerSpan[i] = keep;
            outFrames += Math.max(0, span[0] - cursor) + keep;
            cursor = span[1];
        }
        outFrames += Math.max(0, frames - cursor);
        float[] result = new float[outFrames * channels];
        int writeIdx = 0;
        cursor = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < spans.size(); i++) {
            int[] span = spans.get(i);
            int keep = keepPerSpan[i];
            writeIdx = copySlice(in, cursor, span[0], channels, result, writeIdx);
            writeIdx = copySlice(in, span[0], span[0] + keep, channels, result, writeIdx);
            cursor = span[1];
        }
        copySlice(in, cursor, frames, channels, result, writeIdx);
        return result;
    }

    @Override
    public long processOfflineRangeToFile(File srcWav, long startFrame,
                                          long endFrame, File dstWav,
                                          int sampleRate, int channels)
            throws Exception {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;

        FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(srcWav);
        int ch = Math.max(1, channels > 0 ? channels : info.channels);
        int sr = info.sampleRate > 0 ? info.sampleRate : this.sampleRate;
        long totalFrames = info.dataBytes / 4L / ch;
        startFrame = Math.max(0L, Math.min(totalFrames, startFrame));
        endFrame = Math.max(startFrame, Math.min(totalFrames, endFrame));
        long frames = endFrame - startFrame;
        if (frames <= 0) return -1L;
        final long rangeStart = startFrame;

        float thrLin = Dsp.dbToLin(threshold.getFloat());
        int window = Math.max(1, (int) (sr * 0.01));
        int rawMinMs = minDuration.getCurrentRaw();
        long minSilent = Math.max(1L, Math.round(rawMinMs * 0.001 * sr));
        boolean compress = action.getEnumIndex() == 1
                || compressTo.getCurrentRaw() != compressTo.defaultRaw;
        long truncTargetFrames = Math.max(1L,
                Math.round(truncateTo.getCurrentRaw() * 0.001 * sr));
        float compRatio = compressTo.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;

        // Pass 1: Stream 10 ms RMS windows to locate silent spans without loading file in RAM
        java.util.List<long[]> spans = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        final long[] silentStart = {-1L};
        final double[] winSum = {0.0};
        final int[] winFrames = {0};
        final long[] winStartPos = {0L};

        EditEngine.forEachFloatChunk(srcWav, startFrame, endFrame,
                DEFAULT_DSP_CHUNK_FRAMES,
                (chunk, chunkFrames, chunkCh, frameOffset) -> {
                    int cCount = Math.max(1, chunkCh);
                    for (int f = 0; f < chunkFrames; f++) {
                        long relFrame = (frameOffset - rangeStart) + f;
                        if (winFrames[0] == 0) winStartPos[0] = relFrame;
                        for (int c = 0; c < cCount; c++) {
                            double v = chunk[f * cCount + c];
                            winSum[0] += v * v;
                        }
                        winFrames[0]++;
                        if (winFrames[0] == window || relFrame == frames - 1) {
                            int count = winFrames[0] * cCount;
                            float rms = count > 0 ? (float) Math.sqrt(winSum[0] / count) : 0f;
                            boolean silent = rms < thrLin;
                            long winEnd = relFrame + 1;
                            if (silent && silentStart[0] < 0) {
                                silentStart[0] = winStartPos[0];
                            } else if (!silent && silentStart[0] >= 0) {
                                if (winEnd - silentStart[0] >= minSilent) {
                                    spans.add(new long[]{silentStart[0], winEnd});
                                }
                                silentStart[0] = -1L;
                            }
                            winSum[0] = 0.0;
                            winFrames[0] = 0;
                        }
                    }
                });
        if (silentStart[0] >= 0 && frames - silentStart[0] >= minSilent) {
            spans.add(new long[]{silentStart[0], frames});
        }

        long outFrames = 0L;
        long cursor = 0L;
        long[] keepPerSpan = new long[spans.size()];
        for (int i = 0; i < spans.size(); i++) {
            long[] span = spans.get(i);
            long spanLen = span[1] - span[0];
            long targetKeep;
            if (action.getEnumIndex() == 1) {
                targetKeep = Math.max(1L, Math.round(spanLen * compRatio));
            } else if (compress) {
                targetKeep = Math.max(1L, Math.round(
                        Math.min(truncTargetFrames, spanLen) * (0.5f + 0.5f * (compRatio / 0.35f))));
            } else {
                targetKeep = truncTargetFrames;
            }
            long keep = Math.min(spanLen, Math.max(1L, targetKeep));
            keepPerSpan[i] = keep;
            outFrames += Math.max(0L, span[0] - cursor) + keep;
            cursor = span[1];
        }
        outFrames += Math.max(0L, frames - cursor);

        // Pass 2: Stream kept slices to dstWav in 64 KB chunks
        long frameBytes = ch * 4L;
        byte[] copyBuf = new byte[65536];
        try (RandomAccessFile inRaf = new RandomAccessFile(srcWav, "r");
             RandomAccessFile outRaf = new RandomAccessFile(dstWav, "rw")) {
            outRaf.setLength(0);
            outRaf.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(ch, sr, outFrames * frameBytes));
            cursor = 0L;
            for (int i = 0; i < spans.size(); i++) {
                long[] span = spans.get(i);
                long keep = keepPerSpan[i];
                streamFrameSlice(inRaf, info.dataStart, startFrame + cursor,
                        startFrame + span[0], frameBytes, outRaf, copyBuf);
                streamFrameSlice(inRaf, info.dataStart, startFrame + span[0],
                        startFrame + span[0] + keep, frameBytes, outRaf, copyBuf);
                cursor = span[1];
            }
            streamFrameSlice(inRaf, info.dataStart, startFrame + cursor,
                    startFrame + frames, frameBytes, outRaf, copyBuf);
        }
        return outFrames;
    }

    private static void streamFrameSlice(RandomAccessFile inRaf, long dataStart,
                                         long fromFrame, long toFrame,
                                         long frameBytes, RandomAccessFile outRaf,
                                         byte[] buf) throws Exception {
        long bytes = Math.max(0L, toFrame - fromFrame) * frameBytes;
        if (bytes <= 0) return;
        inRaf.seek(dataStart + fromFrame * frameBytes);
        long left = bytes;
        while (left > 0) {
            int want = (int) Math.min((long) buf.length, left);
            int n = inRaf.read(buf, 0, want);
            if (n <= 0) break;
            outRaf.write(buf, 0, n);
            left -= n;
        }
    }

    private static int copySlice(float[] src, int fromFrame, int toFrame,
                                 int channels, float[] dst, int writeIdx) {
        int count = Math.max(0, toFrame - fromFrame) * channels;
        if (count <= 0) return writeIdx;
        System.arraycopy(src, fromFrame * channels, dst, writeIdx, count);
        return writeIdx + count;
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 6 Multi-Band Vocoder: splits the voice (modulator) into N logarithmically
 * spaced band-pass channels (8..32 bands), tracks the amplitude envelope in
 * each band, and imposes those envelopes onto an internal synth/noise carrier
 * filtered through an identical band-pass bank.
 */
final class VocoderProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] CARRIER_LABELS = {
            "Sawtooth Synth", "White Noise", "Original + Synth"
    };

    private final FxParameter bands = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "vc_bands", "Vocoder Bands", "", 8, 32, 4, 16));
    private final FxParameter carrierType = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "vc_carrier", "Carrier Type", CARRIER_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter pitch = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "vc_pitch", "Carrier Pitch", " Hz", 50, 400, 5, 110));
    private final FxParameter noiseMix = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "vc_noise", "Noise Mix", "%", 0, 100, 5, 15));
    private final FxParameter release = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "vc_release", "Envelope Speed", " ms", 1f, 120f, 10f));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private double carrierPhase = 0.0;
    private long noiseState = 0x1234567L;

    VocoderProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "vocoder";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Vocoder";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "8–32 band filterbank vocoder with internal synth & noise carrier";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.CREATIVE;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        carrierPhase = 0.0;
        noiseState = 0x1234567L;
    }

    private float nextNoise() {
        noiseState = noiseState * 6364136223846793005L + 1442695040888963407L;
        return ((int) (noiseState >>> 33)) / (float) (1 << 30);
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled() || buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int sr = Math.max(8000, sampleRate);
        int nBands = Math.max(8, Math.min(32, bands.getCurrentRaw()));
        int cType = carrierType.getEnumIndex();
        double f0 = pitch.getCurrentRaw();
        float nMix = noiseMix.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        // Convert Envelope Speed (1..120, where default 10 = 10 ms) to a real
        // sample-rate-aware exponential release coefficient.
        double relSec = Math.max(0.001, release.getFloat() * 0.001);
        float relAlpha = 1.0f - (float) Math.exp(-1.0 / (sr * relSec));

        float[] modMono = new float[frames];
        float[] carMono = new float[frames];
        double phaseInc = f0 / sr;
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * ch;
            float m = ch == 2 ? 0.5f * (buf[idx] + buf[idx + 1]) : buf[idx];
            modMono[f] = m;
            float saw = (float) (2.0 * carrierPhase - 1.0);
            carrierPhase += phaseInc;
            if (carrierPhase >= 1.0) carrierPhase -= 1.0;
            float noise = nextNoise() * 0.4f;
            float c;
            if (cType == 1) {
                // White Noise mode retains a subtle pitched harmonic formant
                // and noiseMix scaling so vc_pitch and vc_noise remain active.
                c = noise * (0.65f + 0.35f * nMix) + 0.18f * saw;
            } else if (cType == 2) {
                // Original + Synth mode blends noiseMix into the synth carrier.
                c = 0.45f * m + 0.45f * saw + nMix * noise * 0.5f;
            } else {
                c = (1f - nMix) * saw + nMix * noise;
            }
            carMono[f] = c;
        }

        float[] sumOut = new float[frames];
        double fMin = 120.0, fMax = Math.min(8000.0, sr * 0.42);
        double qBand = 3.5 + nBands * 0.12;
        for (int b = 0; b < nBands; b++) {
            double frac = b / (double) Math.max(1, nBands - 1);
            double fc = fMin * Math.pow(fMax / fMin, frac);
            float[] sec = Dsp.rbjBandPass(sr, fc, qBand);
            BiquadFilter modBp = new BiquadFilter();
            BiquadFilter carBp = new BiquadFilter();
            modBp.setSections(new float[][]{sec}, 1);
            carBp.setSections(new float[][]{sec}, 1);
            float[] mBand = modMono.clone();
            float[] cBand = carMono.clone();
            modBp.process(mBand, frames, 1);
            carBp.process(cBand, frames, 1);

            float env = 0f;
            for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
                float a = Math.abs(mBand[f]);
                env += (a > env ? 0.08f : relAlpha) * (a - env);
                sumOut[f] += cBand[f] * env * 4.5f;
            }
        }
        float scale = (float) (1.2 / Math.sqrt(nBands / 8.0));
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            float y = Math.max(-0.98f, Math.min(0.98f, sumOut[f] * scale));
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) buf[f * ch + c] = y;
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 6 Wahwah / Auto-Wah: swept resonant state-variable band-pass filter
 * driven by a blend of an LFO and an input envelope follower (Auto-Wah
 * sensitivity).
 */
final class WahwahProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter rate = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "wah_rate", "LFO Rate", " Hz", 0.1f, 6f, 1.5f));
    private final FxParameter depth = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "wah_depth", "Depth", "%", 0, 100, 5, 70));
    private final FxParameter resonance = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "wah_res", "Resonance (Q)", "", 0.5f, 10f, 3.0f));
    private final FxParameter freqOffset = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "wah_offset", "Freq Offset", "%", 0, 100, 5, 30));
    private final FxParameter phase = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "wah_phase", "Stereo Phase", "°", 0, 360, 15, 0));
    private final FxParameter autoWah = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "wah_auto", "Auto-Wah Env", "%", 0, 100, 5, 0));
    private final FxParameter outputGain = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "wah_gain", "Output Gain", -18f, 12f, -6f));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private final float[] low = new float[2];
    private final float[] band = new float[2];
    private double lfoPhase = 0.0;
    private float env = 0f;

    WahwahProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "wah";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Wahwah";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Swept resonant SVF wah & envelope-triggered auto-wah";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.CREATIVE;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        low[0] = low[1] = 0f;
        band[0] = band[1] = 0f;
        lfoPhase = 0.0;
        env = 0f;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled();
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled() || buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int sr = Math.max(8000, sampleRate);
        float d = depth.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        float q = 1.0f / Math.max(0.5f, resonance.getFloat());
        float baseFrac = freqOffset.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        float envMix = autoWah.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        float outLin = Dsp.dbToLin(outputGain.getFloat());
        double lfoInc = 2.0 * Math.PI * rate.getFloat() / sr;
        double stereoRad = Math.toRadians(phase.getCurrentRaw());

        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * ch;
            float peak = Math.abs(buf[idx]);
            if (ch == 2) peak = Math.max(peak, Math.abs(buf[idx + 1]));
            env += (peak > env ? 0.04f : 0.002f) * (peak - env);

            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                double ph = lfoPhase + ((c == 1 || ch == 1) ? stereoRad : 0.0);
                double lfo01 = 0.5 * (1.0 + Math.sin(ph));
                double envSweep = Math.min(1.0, env * 2.2 + peak * 0.65);
                double sweep = (1.0 - envMix) * lfo01 + envMix * envSweep;
                double norm = Math.min(1.0, baseFrac * 0.6 + d * sweep);
                double fc = 350.0 * Math.pow(8.5, norm);
                float fCoeff = (float) (2.0 * Math.sin(Math.PI * Math.min(fc, sr * 0.22) / sr));
                float x = buf[idx + c];
                low[c] += fCoeff * band[c];
                float high = x - low[c] - q * band[c];
                band[c] += fCoeff * high;
                buf[idx + c] = (band[c] * 1.6f + x * 0.25f) * outLin;
            }
            lfoPhase += lfoInc;
            if (lfoPhase > 2.0 * Math.PI) lfoPhase -= 2.0 * Math.PI;
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import android.content.Context;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.graphics.RectF;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.SystemClock;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.View;

import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.ByteOrder;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Deque;

/**
 * Unified Red-Waveform interactive recording & non-linear editing timeline.
 *
 * <p>Features:
 * <ul>
 *   <li><b>Half-Bar Playhead Highlight Rule</b>: A bar (or sub-bar) is centered
 *       at {@code bucket + 0.5f} and only highlights once the center playhead
 *       has crossed half of it ({@code x <= centerX}), never highlighting bars
 *       in front of the playhead.</li>
 *   <li><b>Dynamic Bar Concentration at High Zoom</b>: When {@code zoom > 1.0f},
 *       each bucket dynamically subdivides into up to 6 cosine-interpolated
 *       sub-bars so high zoom (e.g. 400%) feels dense, smooth, and responsive.</li>
 *   <li><b>Zoom-Adaptive 1:1 Scrolling</b>: Horizontal scroll sensitivity is
 *       strictly {@code 1f / gapPxLocked(w)}.</li>
 * </ul>
 */
public class WaveformView extends View {

    private static final int COLS = 150;
    /**
     * Constant high-concentration bar count across the screen regardless of
     * zoom level (150 bars on the left of the center playhead, 150 on the right).
     */
    public static final int SCREEN_BARS = 300;
    private static final int MAX_HISTORY = 8192;

    private final Paint barPaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final Paint linePaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final Paint playPaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final Paint selFillPaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final Paint selBorderPaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final Paint handlePaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final Paint handleGripPaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final Paint fxEdgePaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final Paint fxSelFillPaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final Paint fxSelBorderPaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final RectF rect = new RectF();

    private float[] history = new float[COLS];
    /**
     * Dry peaks captured when the FX rack opened, so the effect-applied
     * region can be re-spliced on every parameter change and restored when
     * the rack closes. Null when no FX region is being shown.
     */
    private float[] fxBaseHistory;
    private int fxBaseCount;
    private float fxBaseFramesPerBar = 2400f;
    private boolean fxRegionActive;
    /**
     * The region effects mode owns. It is the frozen apply target, so its bars
     * are highlighted in orange and the selection handles can never move
     * beyond it (a sub-selection is only for learning a profile).
     */
    private float fxRegionStartFrac = 0f;
    private float fxRegionEndFrac = 1f;
    private float fxOrigStartFrac = 0f;
    private float fxOrigEndFrac = 1f;
    private int count;
    private boolean live;
    private float zoom = 1f;
    private boolean followMinZoom = false;

    private final Deque<float[]> undoPeakStack = new ArrayDeque<>();
    private final Deque<Float> undoFramesPerBar = new ArrayDeque<>();
    private final Deque<float[]> redoPeakStack = new ArrayDeque<>();
    private final Deque<Float> redoFramesPerBar = new ArrayDeque<>();
    private float[] savedReplaceTailPeaks = null;
    private float[] stashedParentPeaks = null;
    private int stashedParentSelStart = 0;
    private int stashedParentSelEnd = 0;
    private float stashedParentFramesPerBar = 2400f;
    private final Deque<float[]> stashedParentUndoPeaks = new ArrayDeque<>();
    private final Deque<Float> stashedParentUndoFpb = new ArrayDeque<>();
    private final Deque<float[]> stashedParentRedoPeaks = new ArrayDeque<>();
    private final Deque<Float> stashedParentRedoFpb = new ArrayDeque<>();

    // Smooth morphing state for in-place Replace & frame-locked live speed
    private int lastMorphIdx = -1;
    private float morphAlpha = 0f;
    private float framesPerBar = 2400f; // 2400 frames @ 48 kHz = 50 ms (20 bars/sec)

    private float downX = 0f;
    private float downY = 0f;
    private float lastTouchX = 0f;
    private float lastTouchY = 0f;
    private float touchAccum = 0f;
    private long lastTapUpMs = 0L;
    public static final float[] ZOOM_STEPS = {0.5f, 1f, 2f, 4f};

    public interface OnZoomGesture {
        void onZoomGesture(float direction, float totalDy);
    }

    private OnZoomGesture zoomListener;

    public interface TimelineListener {
        void onPlayheadScrubbed(int bucketIndex, float fraction);
        void onSelectionChanged(boolean active, float startFrac, float endFrac);
        default void onScrollStarted() {}
    }

    private TimelineListener timelineListener;

    private float playheadPos = 0f;
    private int playheadIndex = 0;
    private boolean selectionActive = false;
    private boolean selectionLocked = false;
    private int selStartIdx = 0;
    private int selEndIdx = 0;
    /** Canonical float bucket positions: snap to one visual bar at any zoom. */
    private float selStartPos = 0f;
    private float selEndPos = 0f;

    private static final int DRAG_NONE = 0;
    private static final int DRAG_ZOOM = 1;
    private static final int DRAG_SCROLL = 2;
    private static final int DRAG_SEL_START = 3;
    private static final int DRAG_SEL_END = 4;
    private int dragMode = DRAG_NONE;

    public WaveformView(Context context) {
        super(context);
        init();
    }

    public WaveformView(Context context, AttributeSet attrs) {
        super(context, attrs);
        init();
    }

    private void init() {
        barPaint.setStrokeCap(Paint.Cap.ROUND);
        linePaint.setColor(0xFF3A414B);
        linePaint.setStrokeWidth(1.5f);
        playPaint.setColor(0xFFFF3B30);
        playPaint.setStrokeWidth(2.2f);
        selFillPaint.setStyle(Paint.Style.FILL);
        selFillPaint.setColor(0x2EFF3B30);
        selBorderPaint.setStyle(Paint.Style.STROKE);
        selBorderPaint.setColor(0xFFFF554A);
        selBorderPaint.setStrokeWidth(2f);
        handlePaint.setStyle(Paint.Style.FILL);
        handlePaint.setColor(0xFFFF3B30);
        handleGripPaint.setStyle(Paint.Style.STROKE);
        handleGripPaint.setStrokeCap(Paint.Cap.ROUND);
        handleGripPaint.setColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
        handleGripPaint.setStrokeWidth(1.5f);
        fxEdgePaint.setStyle(Paint.Style.STROKE);
        fxEdgePaint.setColor(0xCCFF9F0A);
        fxEdgePaint.setStrokeWidth(1.5f);
        fxSelFillPaint.setStyle(Paint.Style.FILL);
        fxSelFillPaint.setColor(0x2EFF9F0A);
        fxSelBorderPaint.setStyle(Paint.Style.STROKE);
        fxSelBorderPaint.setColor(0xFFFF9F0A);
        fxSelBorderPaint.setStrokeWidth(2f);
        setClickable(true);
        Arrays.fill(history, 0f);
    }

    public void setOnZoomGesture(OnZoomGesture l) {
        zoomListener = l;
    }

    public void setTimelineListener(TimelineListener l) {
        this.timelineListener = l;
    }

    public synchronized float playheadFraction() {
        if (count <= 0) return 1f;
        return Math.max(0f, Math.min(1f, playheadPos / (float) count));
    }

    public synchronized void setPlayheadFraction(float frac) {
        float clamped = Math.max(0f, Math.min(1f, frac));
        playheadPos = clampPlayheadToFxLocked(clamped * count);
        playheadIndex = Math.round(playheadPos);
        postInvalidateOnAnimation();
    }

    /**
     * Keeps the playhead inside the frozen effects-mode target. Outside
     * effects mode there is no constraint, so ordinary scrubbing is
     * unaffected.
     */
    private float clampPlayheadToFxLocked(float pos) {
        float bounded = Math.max(0f, Math.min(count, pos));
        if (!fxRegionActive || count <= 0) return bounded;
        float lo = fxRegionStartFrac * count;
        float hi = fxRegionEndFrac * count;
        return Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, bounded));
    }

    public synchronized boolean hasSelection() {
        return selectionActive && count > 0
                && Math.max(selStartPos, selEndPos)
                - Math.min(selStartPos, selEndPos) > 1e-4f;
    }

    public synchronized float selectionStartFraction() {
        if (count <= 0) return 0f;
        float low = Math.min(selStartPos, selEndPos);
        return Math.max(0f, Math.min(1f, low / (float) count));
    }

    public synchronized float selectionEndFraction() {
        if (count <= 0) return 1f;
        float high = Math.max(selStartPos, selEndPos);
        return Math.max(0f, Math.min(1f, high / (float) count));
    }

    /** Buckets covered by one on-screen bar at the current zoom. */
    private float bucketsPerBarLocked() {
        return (COLS / (float) SCREEN_BARS) / Math.max(1e-5f, zoom);
    }

    /** Canonical selection floats -> integer buckets used by edits/tests. */
    private void syncSelectionIntsLocked() {
        float lo = Math.min(selStartPos, selEndPos);
        float hi = Math.max(selStartPos, selEndPos);
        selStartPos = Math.max(0f, Math.min(count, lo));
        selEndPos = Math.max(selStartPos, Math.min(count, hi));
        selStartIdx = Math.round(selStartPos);
        selEndIdx = Math.round(selEndPos);
    }

    private void setSelectionPositionsLocked(float start, float end) {
        selStartPos = start;
        selEndPos = end;
        syncSelectionIntsLocked();
    }

    private static float[] copyPeaksBounded(float[] src, int len, float[] reusable) {
        int n = Math.max(0, Math.min(len, Math.min(src.length, MAX_HISTORY)));
        if (reusable != null && reusable.length == n) {
            System.arraycopy(src, 0, reusable, 0, n);
            return reusable;
        }
        return Arrays.copyOf(src, n);
    }

    /** Snapshots the current in-memory waveform peaks before an edit operation. */
    public synchronized void recordUndoPeaks() {
        if (count <= 0) return;
        try {
            float[] recycled = null;
            while (undoPeakStack.size() >= EditEngine.MAX_UNDO_STEPS) {
                recycled = undoPeakStack.removeLast();
            }
            while (undoFramesPerBar.size() >= EditEngine.MAX_UNDO_STEPS) {
                undoFramesPerBar.removeLast();
            }
            if (recycled == null && !redoPeakStack.isEmpty()) {
                recycled = redoPeakStack.pollFirst();
            }
            redoPeakStack.clear();
            redoFramesPerBar.clear();
            undoPeakStack.addFirst(copyPeaksBounded(history, count, recycled));
            undoFramesPerBar.addFirst(framesPerBar);
        } catch (OutOfMemoryError ignored) {
            if (!undoPeakStack.isEmpty()) undoPeakStack.removeLast();
            if (!undoFramesPerBar.isEmpty()) undoFramesPerBar.removeLast();
        }
    }

    /** Discards the most recently recorded undo peak snapshot when an edit aborts before modifying the waveform. */
    public synchronized void discardTopUndoPeaks() {
        if (!undoPeakStack.isEmpty()) undoPeakStack.pollFirst();
        if (!undoFramesPerBar.isEmpty()) undoFramesPerBar.pollFirst();
    }

    /** Restores the most recent in-memory waveform peak snapshot on Undo and saves current peaks for Redo. */
    public synchronized boolean popUndoPeaks() {
        if (undoPeakStack.isEmpty()) return false;
        float[] snap = undoPeakStack.pollFirst();
        Float snapFrames = undoFramesPerBar.pollFirst();
        if (snap == null) return false;
        dropFxBaseLocked();
        if (count > 0) {
            try {
                float[] recycled = null;
                while (redoPeakStack.size() >= EditEngine.MAX_UNDO_STEPS) {
                    recycled = redoPeakStack.removeLast();
                }
                while (redoFramesPerBar.size() >= EditEngine.MAX_UNDO_STEPS) {
                    redoFramesPerBar.removeLast();
                }
                redoPeakStack.addFirst(copyPeaksBounded(history, count, recycled));
                redoFramesPerBar.addFirst(framesPerBar);
            } catch (OutOfMemoryError ignored) {}
        }
        if (snapFrames != null) framesPerBar = snapFrames;
        int snapLen = Math.min(snap.length, MAX_HISTORY);
        if (history.length < snapLen) {
            history = new float[Math.min(MAX_HISTORY, Math.max(COLS, snapLen))];
        }
        Arrays.fill(history, 0f);
        System.arraycopy(snap, 0, history, 0, snapLen);
        count = snapLen;
        playheadPos = count;
        playheadIndex = count;
        selectionActive = false;
        postInvalidateOnAnimation();
        return true;
    }

    /** Restores the most recent in-memory waveform peak snapshot on Redo and saves current peaks for Undo. */
    public synchronized boolean popRedoPeaks() {
        if (redoPeakStack.isEmpty()) return false;
        float[] snap = redoPeakStack.pollFirst();
        Float snapFrames = redoFramesPerBar.pollFirst();
        if (snap == null) return false;
        dropFxBaseLocked();
        if (count > 0) {
            try {
                float[] recycled = null;
                while (undoPeakStack.size() >= EditEngine.MAX_UNDO_STEPS) {
                    recycled = undoPeakStack.removeLast();
                }
                while (undoFramesPerBar.size() >= EditEngine.MAX_UNDO_STEPS) {
                    undoFramesPerBar.removeLast();
                }
                undoPeakStack.addFirst(copyPeaksBounded(history, count, recycled));
                undoFramesPerBar.addFirst(framesPerBar);
            } catch (OutOfMemoryError ignored) {}
        }
        if (snapFrames != null) framesPerBar = snapFrames;
        int snapLen = Math.min(snap.length, MAX_HISTORY);
        if (history.length < snapLen) {
            history = new float[Math.min(MAX_HISTORY, Math.max(COLS, snapLen))];
        }
        Arrays.fill(history, 0f);
        System.arraycopy(snap, 0, history, 0, snapLen);
        count = snapLen;
        playheadPos = count;
        playheadIndex = count;
        selectionActive = false;
        postInvalidateOnAnimation();
        return true;
    }

    /** Crops the in-memory waveform bars to the current selection `[selStartIdx, selEndIdx)` in-place. */
    public synchronized void cropToSelectionBuckets() {
        if (!hasSelection()) return;
        int s = Math.max(0, Math.min(count - 1, selStartIdx));
        int e = Math.max(s + 1, Math.min(count, selEndIdx));
        int keep = e - s;
        System.arraycopy(history, s, history, 0, keep);
        Arrays.fill(history, keep, count, 0f);
        count = keep;
        playheadPos = count;
        playheadIndex = count;
        selectionActive = false;
        postInvalidateOnAnimation();
    }

    /** Deletes the selected buckets `[selStartIdx, selEndIdx)` in-place and shifts the tail left. */
    public synchronized void deleteSelectionBuckets() {
        if (!hasSelection()) return;
        int s = Math.max(0, Math.min(count - 1, selStartIdx));
        int e = Math.max(s + 1, Math.min(count, selEndIdx));
        int tail = count - e;
        if (tail > 0) {
            System.arraycopy(history, e, history, s, tail);
        }
        int newCount = s + tail;
        Arrays.fill(history, newCount, count, 0f);
        count = newCount;
        playheadPos = s;
        playheadIndex = s;
        selectionActive = false;
        postInvalidateOnAnimation();
    }

    /**
     * Replaces the waveform bars inside {@code [startFrac, endFrac)} with the
     * peaks of the effect-applied audio, so effects mode shows the processed
     * audio directly instead of a translucent overlay.
     *
     * <p>The dry bars outside the region are untouched and the original peaks
     * are captured on the first call, so every rack change can be spliced on
     * top of the same dry baseline and {@link #clearFxRegionPeaks()} restores
     * the untouched waveform.
     *
     * @param peaks peak per history bucket (zero outside the region), or null
     *              to restore the dry waveform
     */
    public void setFxRegionPeaks(final float[] peaks,
                                 final float startFrac,
                                 final float endFrac) {
        setFxRegionPeaks(peaks, null, startFrac, endFrac);
    }

    public void setFxRegionPeaks(final float[] peaks,
                                 final float[] gainRatios,
                                 final float startFrac,
                                 final float endFrac) {
        synchronized (this) {
            if (count <= 0) {
                restoreWetBarsLocked();
                postInvalidateOnAnimation();
                return;
            }
            if (fxBaseHistory != null && fxBaseCount > 0 && count != fxBaseCount) {
                // Returning from a stretched offline FX render to an in-place FX render:
                // restore the dry bucket count first so [startFrac, endFrac) maps cleanly.
                if (history.length < fxBaseCount) {
                    history = new float[Math.max(COLS, fxBaseCount)];
                }
                Arrays.fill(history, 0f);
                System.arraycopy(fxBaseHistory, 0, history, 0, fxBaseCount);
                count = fxBaseCount;
                framesPerBar = fxBaseFramesPerBar;
            }
            fxOrigStartFrac = clampFrac(startFrac);
            fxOrigEndFrac = Math.max(
                    fxOrigStartFrac + 1f / Math.max(1, count),
                    clampFrac(endFrac));
            fxRegionStartFrac = fxOrigStartFrac;
            fxRegionEndFrac = fxOrigEndFrac;
            fxRegionActive = true;
            if (peaks == null || peaks.length == 0) {
                restoreWetBarsLocked();
                postInvalidateOnAnimation();
                return;
            }
            if (fxBaseHistory == null || fxBaseCount != count) {
                fxBaseHistory = Arrays.copyOf(history, count);
                fxBaseCount = count;
                fxBaseFramesPerBar = framesPerBar;
            } else {
                int n = Math.min(count, fxBaseHistory.length);
                System.arraycopy(fxBaseHistory, 0, history, 0, n);
            }
            int s = Math.max(0, Math.min(count - 1,
                    Math.round(fxRegionStartFrac * count)));
            int e = Math.max(s + 1, Math.min(count,
                    Math.round(fxRegionEndFrac * count)));
            int lim = Math.min(e, peaks.length);
            for (int i = s; i < lim; i++) {
                if (gainRatios != null && i < gainRatios.length
                        && gainRatios[i] >= 0f && fxBaseHistory[i] > 0.005f) {
                    history[i] = Math.max(0f, fxBaseHistory[i] * gainRatios[i]);
                } else {
                    history[i] = Math.max(0f, peaks[i]);
                }
            }
            playheadPos = clampPlayheadToFxLocked(playheadPos);
            playheadIndex = Math.round(playheadPos);
        }
        postInvalidateOnAnimation();
    }

    /**
     * Splices a duration-changing effect's rendered region peaks into the
     * dry baseline in real time, resizing the timeline (`count` and
     * `fxRegionStartFrac..fxRegionEndFrac`) while keeping `fxRegionActive`
     * and the playhead's relative position inside the FX region intact.
     */
    public void setFxRegionStretchedPeaks(final float[] regionPeaks,
                                          final float origStartFrac,
                                          final float origEndFrac,
                                          final long newTotalFrames) {
        setFxRegionStretchedPeaks(regionPeaks, null, origStartFrac,
                origEndFrac, newTotalFrames);
    }

    public void setFxRegionStretchedPeaks(final float[] regionPeaks,
                                          final float[] gainRatios,
                                          final float origStartFrac,
                                          final float origEndFrac,
                                          final long newTotalFrames) {
        synchronized (this) {
            if (count <= 0 && fxBaseCount <= 0) return;
            if (fxBaseHistory == null || fxBaseCount <= 0) {
                fxBaseHistory = Arrays.copyOf(history, count);
                fxBaseCount = count;
                fxBaseFramesPerBar = framesPerBar;
            }
            if (regionPeaks == null || regionPeaks.length == 0) {
                restoreWetBarsLocked();
                postInvalidateOnAnimation();
                return;
            }
            float oldSpan = Math.max(1e-5f,
                    (fxRegionEndFrac - fxRegionStartFrac) * Math.max(1, count));
